izzyondroid:com.CasparvdBroek.bletomqtt.name: BLEtoMQTT
izzyondroid:com.CasparvdBroek.bletomqtt.summary: Android BLE to MQTT bridging service
izzyondroid:com.CasparvdBroek.bletomqtt.description:
BLEtoMQTT is an Android foreground service to provide a bidirectional bridge between BLE devices and an MQTT broker. A setup.json file defines MQTT parameters and BLE MAC addresses to scan for.
 For each BLE device detected BLEtoMQTT will discover all exposed services and characteristics creating MQTT topics for each. Those characteristics which are writeable will automatically be 'subscribed' from the MQTT broker.
 The author uses this application to connect remote custom ESP32 devices to his Home Assistant server via a Zerotier VPN. The app's source repository contains an example setup.json and a prebuilt apk used to monitor/control a boat on a mooring or at anchor. It also has more detailed setup instructions.

izzyondroid:com.aicodix.assempix.name: Assempix - Decode COFDMTV
izzyondroid:com.aicodix.assempix.summary: A coded OFDM update to SSTV to receive digital images over SSB, AM and FM radio
izzyondroid:com.aicodix.assempix.description:
*Assempix* decodes COFDMTV encoded audio signals to images and is based on open-source software.
COFDMTV is based on COFDM (coded orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing) technology:
- 160 ms long OFDM symbols
- 6.25 Hz per sub-carrier
- 1/8 guard interval
- differentially encoded PSK (phase-shift keying) modulation
- systematic polar codes for forward error correction
Following modes are supported:
Using SPC(64800, 43072):
Mode 6: 8PSK, 2700 Hz BW and about 10 seconds long
Mode 7: 8PSK, 2500 Hz BW and about 11 seconds long
Mode 8: QPSK, 2500 Hz BW and about 16 seconds long
Mode 9: QPSK, 2250 Hz BW and about 18 seconds long
Using SPC(64512, 43072):
Mode 10: 8PSK, 3200 Hz BW and about 9 seconds long
Mode 11: 8PSK, 2400 Hz BW and about 11 seconds long
Mode 12: QPSK, 2400 Hz BW and about 16 seconds long
Mode 13: QPSK, 1600 Hz BW and about 24 seconds long
Payload must be smaller or equal to 5380 bytes.
JPEG, PNG and WebP image formats are supported.
Width and height are limited to between 16 and 1024 pixels.

izzyondroid:com.crazyunicorn.simplequizf.name: Simple Quiz FR

izzyondroid:com.crazyunicorn.simplequizf.description:
Simple Quiz FR is a quiz application available in French only, designed to provide a simple, accessible, and ad-free experience.
 The app lets users answer multiple-choice quizzes by selecting various criteria such as category and difficulty level. The questions are provided by the « Simple Quiz API » (https://quizzapi.fr/)
 Users can also create and submit their own questions directly from the app, contributing to the community effort by enriching the shared question database.
 Main features:
 Quizzes in French
 Category selection
 Difficulty level selection
 Reporting of malformed quizzes
 Creation and submission of questions
 Works offline
 Modern UI based on Material Design
 Light and dark themes
 Dynamic colors based on Material You
 Free and without ads
 The app is built using a modern architecture based on Jetpack Compose and adheres to Android's best practices. User preferences are stored locally on the device.
 The Internet permission is used only to communicate with the quiz API. No other permissions are required.
 Simple Quiz FR is free and open-source software. The source code is publicly available, allowing anyone to review, modify, or improve the application.

Currencies is a simple and straightforward currency converter.It is not intended to be used for realtime financial business, rather to be a handy companion e.g. on vacations.

fdroid:com.Colota.name: Colota - GPS Location Tracker
fdroid:com.Colota.summary: Self-hosted GPS tracker. Open source, geofencing, offline mode, no telemetry
fdroid:com.Colota.description:
Colota is an open-source GPS tracking app that sends your location to your own server over HTTP(S). It works offline, supports geofencing, and doesn't share any data except with your configured backends.
 Features 
 Self-Hosted - Works with Dawarich, GeoPulse, Home Assistant, OwnTracks, Overland, PhoneTrack, Reitti, Traccar or any custom backend that accepts JSON over HTTP
 Privacy First - No analytics, no telemetry, no third-party SDKs. Licensed under AGPL-3.0
 Works Offline - Fully functional without a server. Locations are queued locally and synced when connectivity returns. Export as CSV, GeoJSON, GPX or KML
 Offline Maps - Download map areas to the device for use without an internet connection
 Scheduled Export - Automatic daily, weekly or monthly exports to a local directory with file retention management
 Location History - Daily summaries, trip segmentation, manual trip merge and split, per-point notes, calendar with activity dots and per-trip export
 Import Your History - Bring in existing tracks from GeoJSON, Google Timeline, GPX, KML or CSV
 Encrypted Backup - Password-protected archives of locations, settings and geofences
 Reliable Tracking - Foreground service, auto-start on boot and exponential backoff retry
 Geofencing - Pause zones that automatically stop recording locations
 Tracking Profiles - Automatically adjust GPS interval, distance filter and sync settings based on conditions like charging, Android Auto, Wi-Fi, a Bluetooth device, speed or stationary detection
 Flexible Sync - Instant, batch or offline modes. Restrict sync to Wi-Fi, a specific SSID or VPN
 App Shortcuts - Long-press the app icon to start or stop tracking directly from the home screen. Compatible with automation apps like Tasker and Samsung Routines
 Quick Setup - Configure devices via colota://setup deep links or QR codes
 Authentication - Basic Auth, Bearer Token, client certificates (mTLS) or custom headers
 Dark Mode - Full light and dark theme support
The FOSS variant uses Android's native LocationManager and has no Google Play Services dependency.

fdroid:com.ispindle.plotter.name: iSpindle Plotter
fdroid:com.ispindle.plotter.summary: Collect and plot fermentation data from an iSpindel hydrometer.
fdroid:com.ispindle.plotter.description:
iSpindle Plotter is a self-hosted companion app for the iSpindel — an open-hardware floating hydrometer used by home brewers to track specific gravity through a fermentation. The app runs a small HTTP server on your phone that the iSpindel posts its readings to over your local Wi-Fi network, then stores, charts, and analyses those readings without ever sending your data to a third-party cloud service.
Pairing and configuration:
* Auto-pair flow that joins the iSpindel's configuration access point, sets the phone as the HTTP target (Generic HTTP / selAPI=3), reads the device's existing cubic calibration polynomial off the firmware, and reconnects to your home network — without losing pre-existing fields like the calibration on subsequent saves.
* mDNS-style hostname discovery so the iSpindel can find your phone again after either device's IP changes.
* Pushes the app's own calibration polynomial back to the iSpindel when you re-calibrate.
Calibration:
* Fit cubic / quadratic / linear polynomials from your own sucrose-dilution measurements.
* Imports the iSpindel's pre-installed factory calibration on first pairing.
* Setup guide with a sucrose-step-dilution recipe for 1.000–1.080 SG.
Plotting and analysis:
* Tilt angle, temperature, specific gravity, and battery voltage charts with a 24h / 7d / 30d / All time-window switcher.
* Potential-alcohol secondary axis on the SG chart.
* Robust phase classifier (Lag / Active / Slowing / Conditioning / Stuck / Cold crash) using a modified-Gompertz Levenberg-Marquardt fit (Zwietering et al. 1990), with fallback to an attenuation-prior when the data is too early to constrain the asymptote.
* Predicted final gravity overlaid on the chart with a tapering uncertainty band derived from short-time noise estimation and the calibration polynomial's residual.
* Battery runway estimate: linear discharge fit projecting time-to-cutoff at the current sample rate.
* Trim-before-date-and-time to drop pre-fermentation noise; CSV export via the system file picker.
Privacy:
* No analytics, no telemetry, no third-party network connections.
* Data is held only on your phone and only sent to your iSpindel's local IP for configuration writes.
* The app's HTTP server listens on the phone's local network address only.
Hardware: built and tested with an MTB iSpindel PCB 4.0; should work with any iSpindel firmware that supports the Generic HTTP target.

fdroid:com.sshborg.name: SSHBorg

fdroid:com.sshborg.description:
SSHBorg is a powerful SSH and SFTP client for Android. Manage your servers securely from your phone with key authentication, encrypted storage, and biometric lock.
FEATURES
• Full SSH Terminal — Interactive terminal with VT100/xterm emulation, full UTF-8 support, and multiple concurrent sessions.
• Mosh Support — The terminal survives a change of network and a sleeping phone: no reconnection, nothing lost. Requires mosh-server on the server.
• SFTP File Manager — Browse, upload, download, rename, and delete files on your servers with an intuitive file manager.
• SSH Key Auth — Generate Ed25519, ECDSA, and RSA keys directly on your device. No passwords needed.
• Jump Host Support — Connect through one or more bastion hosts with transparent tunnelling. Full SSH agent forwarding.
• Biometric Lock — Protect access to your servers with fingerprint or face unlock. Configurable timeout.
• Multilingual — Available in English, Italian, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Ukrainian, Russian, Chinese, and Japanese.
• Dark & Light Theme — Follows the system theme or let you choose. Fully readable in any lighting condition.
• Multiple Sessions — Keep several SSH and SFTP sessions open simultaneously. Switch between them instantly.
PRIVACY FIRST, BY DESIGN
SSHBorg never collects your data. Everything stays on your device — your credentials, your keys, your connections.
• No ads
• No tracking
• No cloud
• Open source — GPL v3
• No third-party SDKs
• Android Keystore encryption
sshborg.com

fdroid:dev.konraditurbe.osmosis.name: Osmosis
fdroid:dev.konraditurbe.osmosis.summary: Copy photos and videos off DJI Osmo cameras over Bluetooth and Wi-Fi
fdroid:dev.konraditurbe.osmosis.description:
Osmosis is a third-party media client for DJI Osmo action and gimbal cameras. It browses the camera's memory, previews clips, and copies photos and videos to the phone's gallery. It needs no DJI SDK, no account, no activation and no companion service.
Features:
* Media grid with thumbnails pulled straight off the camera, grouped by capture date.
* Low-resolution streaming preview, so a clip can be scrubbed before it is downloaded.
* In-preview trimming: set in and out points and download only that slice of the high-resolution clip, as a keyframe-accurate stream copy in the original quality.
* Resumable download queue that writes high-resolution files into the phone's gallery.
* Live camera status: battery, charge state, shooting mode and storage use for internal memory and SD card.
* Multi-camera support: saved cameras are remembered and the list shows which ones are currently in range.
* Mark media as favourite on the camera, and filter the grid to favourites, photos or videos.
* GPS sync: a foreground service streams the phone's location into the camera using the accessory protocol, so recordings carry a GPS track for later telemetry overlays.
Supported hardware, verified on real devices: Osmo Nano, Osmo Action 5 Pro, Osmo Action 6 and Osmo Pocket 3. The same protocol is used by the Xtra-branded rebadges of those cameras (Atto, Edge, Edge Pro, Muse). Other cameras in the Osmo line are handled on a best-effort basis, and support for DJI drones using Quick Transfer is in progress.
Privacy: Osmosis talks to the camera at 192.168.2.1 and to nothing else. There are no analytics, no accounts, no activation servers and no cloud upload; media never leaves the phone and the camera. The bundled network security configuration restricts cleartext traffic to the camera's local address.
Requirements: Android 10 or newer, Bluetooth LE, and permission to use nearby devices (Bluetooth scan and connect) plus Wi-Fi state changes. Location permission is used for Bluetooth scanning on older releases and for the optional GPS sync feature.
Osmosis is an independent project and is not affiliated with, authorized by, or endorsed by DJI. "DJI" and "Osmo" are trademarks of their respective owners.

fdroid:net.ibbaa.keepitup.name: Keep it up
fdroid:net.ibbaa.keepitup.description:
Keep it up checks the availability and reachability of network services via Ping, TCP Connect, HTTP/HTTPS Download, and SNMP periodically. Each check is logged with its result and duration, and notifications can be sent on failure or on status changes.
 Features 
- Create multiple independent network tasks, each monitoring one network service at a configurable interval
- Supported types: Ping, TCP Connect, HTTP/HTTPS Download, SNMP (v1/v2c)
- A can perform multiple attempts per execution. All results are logged including duration
- SNMP queries the system group at each interval and supports per-interface monitoring with alerting on status changes
- Downloaded files can automatically be deleted after a successful download or be kept
- Notifications on failure, or when a service goes down or comes back up
- Tasks can be restricted to WiFi connections to avoid unnecessary mobile data usage
- Configurable suspension intervals for battery saving
- Configuration can be exported and imported as JSON
 Permissions 
- RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED for restarting running networks tasks on device boot
- ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE for checking network accessibility
- INTERNET for accessing the internet
- WAKE_LOCK to keep the device awake while executing a task
- FOREGROUND_SERVICE to start the foreground service for running tasks
- FOREGROUND_SERVICE_DATA_SYNC to use the foreground for task scheduling
- FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SPECIAL_USE to use the foreground for task scheduling (Android 14+)
- USE_EXACT_ALARM to start networks tasks after expiry of intervals (Android 13+)
- SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM to start networks tasks after expiry of intervals (Android 11 and 12)
- POST_NOTIFICATIONS for sending notifications

fdroid:net.pufstudio.fieldsurvey.name: Field Survey
fdroid:net.pufstudio.fieldsurvey.summary: Your field logbook, on your phone - build any survey, powered by your device.
fdroid:net.pufstudio.fieldsurvey.description:
Your field logbook, on your phone - build any survey, powered by your device.
• Fits almost any field survey — define your own sections and variables with a simple template
• Let your device do the work — automatic timestamps, one-tap GPS, and photos attached right to each record
• Capture once, export clean — your data goes straight into an accurate, analysis-ready spreadsheet
• Private by default — your data stays on your device, no account or third-party cloud required
── How it works ──
1. Get a template — a .yaml file that defines your survey's structure
2. Import it — paste a URL, scan a QR code, or open a local file
3. Collect data in the field — quickly log each new observation
4. Export when done — get an XLSX or ODS spreadsheet for analysis
Step-by-step walkthrough:
https://pufstudio.net/apps/field_survey/get_started
── Design your own survey ──

apple-macos:6794257189.name: Clash - Rule Based Proxy
apple-macos:6794257189.description:
Clash - Rule based proxy utility is now on iOS. 
Clash is a rule-based network proxy utility. Its core builds on the open-source mihomo project and powers the app's NetworkExtension runtime on Apple platforms. The app is built natively with SwiftUI for iPhone and iPad — not a web wrapper and not a port.
Bring your existing Clash or mihomo profile URL. Clash then decides how each connection should be handled: direct, through a selected proxy, or rejected by your rules. Clash ships with no servers and no proxy lines; you supply your own configuration or profile URL.
GETTING STARTED
1. Import — paste a profile URL, scan a QR code, open a YAML configuration, Share one from another app, or start with a blank profile.
2. Choose — refresh policy groups, test latency, and select the route you want.
3. Connect — connect from Home, Control Center, or Shortcuts, then switch routing modes whenever needed.
RULE-BASED ROUTING
• Rule / Global / Direct modes, switched in one tap
• Match domains, suffixes, keywords, IP-CIDR, GEOIP, GEOSITE, ports, network types, and more
• Add custom rules with a visual editor — no YAML by hand
• Update remote rule providers on a schedule
• Every connection shows the rule it matched and the node it took
NODES AND POLICY GROUPS
• select, url-test, fallback, load-balance, and relay policy groups
• Refresh nodes, test latency, and change selections quickly
• Create nodes manually with a field-level editor, configure proxy chains, or use nodes from an imported profile
• Read mihomo-format YAML configurations and remote profiles directly
• Accepts ss / ssr / vmess / vless / trojan / hysteria2 / tuic / anytls share links and Base64 node lists
DNS
• Resolver lists, per-domain policies, Fake-IP and real-IP modes
• DNS over HTTPS, TLS, QUIC, and UDP
• Local DNS mapping: pin a domain to an address you choose, ahead of any resolver
• DNS self-checks, cache controls, and resolution-path diagnostics
A VISIBLE NETWORK
• Live upload and download speed with cumulative traffic
• Current connections, request history, matched rules, and outbound routes
• Runtime logs, core status, and resource usage
• Network quality testing, STUN, and NAT type detection
BUILT FOR IPHONE AND IPAD
• A sidebar with two-column detail on iPad; ⌘1 through ⌘9 jump to the sidebar sections
• Light and Dark Mode, Dynamic Type, and VoiceOver throughout
• Control Center control for one-tap connect
• Shortcuts and Siri actions for connect, disconnect, toggle, and routing mode
• Share extension: send a configuration from any app to import it
• On Demand rules for automatic takeover on selected networks
• Local and iCloud Drive configuration backup and restore
• Localized in English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese
SUPPORTED OUTBOUND PROTOCOLS
HTTP, SOCKS, Shadowsocks, ShadowsocksR, Snell, VMess, VLESS, Trojan, AnyTLS, Mieru, Sudoku, Hysteria, Hysteria2, TUIC, ShadowQUIC, GOST Relay, WireGuard, Tailscale, ZeroTier, SSH, MASQUE, TrustTunnel, OpenVPN
PRIVACY
• No data collected
• No ads, third-party analytics, or tracking SDKs
• Configurations and credentials use iOS Data Protection; optional backups use your own Apple/iCloud account.
• Logs and diagnostics stay local unless you choose to share them.
• Network traffic flows only between your device and the services you configure
OPEN-SOURCE CORE
The Clash core source is public for audit. Issues are welcome. The core is built on the open-source mihomo project.
To connect, you need a Clash or mihomo configuration — bring your own, or create and edit one in the app — and a network service you control or are authorized to use.
Clash source: https://github.com/ProjectClash/Clash
Privacy Policy: https://clash.md/privacy
Terms of Use: https://clash.md/terms
Support and Documentation: https://clash.md/

Psychology is the science of mind and behavior. Psychology includes the study of conscious and unconscious phenomena, as well as feeling and thought. It is an academic discipline of immense scope. Psychologists seek an understanding of the emergent properties of brains, and all the variety of phenomena linked to those emergent properties, joining this way the broader neuro-scientific group of researchers. As a social science, it aims to understand individuals and groups by establishing general principles and researching specific cases.
Psychologists explore behavior and mental processes, including perception, cognition, attention, emotion, intelligence, subjective experiences, motivation, brain functioning, and personality. This extends to interaction between people, such as interpersonal relationships, including psychological resilience, family resilience, and other areas. Psychologists of diverse orientations also consider the unconscious mind.[3] Psychologists employ empirical methods to infer causal and correlational relationships between psychosocial variables. In addition, or in opposition, to employing empirical and deductive methods, some—especially clinical and counseling psychologists—at times rely upon symbolic interpretation and other inductive techniques. Psychology has been described as a "hub science" in that medicine tends to draw psychological research via neurology and psychiatry, whereas social sciences most commonly draw directly from sub-disciplines within psychology.

fedora-packages:catharsis-cormorant-font.description: Cormorant is an original design for an extravagant display serif font family inspired by the Garamond heritage, hand-drawn and produced by Catharsis Fonts. While traditional Garamond cuts make for exquisite reading at book sizes, they appear clumpy and inelegant at larger sizes. The design goal of Cormorant was to distill the aesthetic essence of Garamond, unfetter it from the limitations of metal printing, and allow it to bloom into its natural refined form at high definition. Cormorant is characterized by scandalously small counters, razor-sharp serifs, dangerously smooth curves, and flamboyantly tall accents. While many implementations of Garamond at small optical sizes already exist (including the open-sourced EB Garamond by Georg Duffner), Cormorant aims for the sparsely populated niche of display-size counterparts that exploit the high resolution of contemporary screens and print media to the fullest. Cormorant is made for large sizes; the larger, the better. However, it works well as a text face in high-resolution environments. Cormorant is a native 21st-century typeface making ample use of OpenType technology. Some OpenType features are applied automatically while you type, subtly improving the flow of the text. This includes kerning, standard ligatures, and contextual alternates. Other features are intended to be activated manually by the user, such as discretionary ligatures, stylistic alternates, small capitals, and alternate figure sets. In Cormorant Infant, the letters “a g y” and their derivatives are replaced by gentle schoolbook-style single-storey shapes.

fedora-packages:erlang-setup/erlang-setu.name: erlang-setup
fedora-packages:erlang-setup/erlang-setu.summary: Generic setup utility for Erlang-based systems
fedora-packages:erlang-setup/erlang-setu.description: While Erlang/OTP comes with many wonderful applications, including the Mnesia DBMS, there is no standard or convention for installing a system. Erlang/OTP provides tools for building a boot script, and rules for setting environment variables, etc., and Mnesia offers an API for creating and modifying the database schema. However, with no convention for when these tools and API functions are called - and by whom - application developers are left having to invent a lot of code and scripts, not to mention meditate over chapters of Erlang/OTP documentation in order to figure out how things fit together. This utility offers a framework for initializing and configuring a system, with a set of conventions allowing each component to provide callbacks for different steps in the installation procedure. The callbacks are defined through OTP application environment variables, which can easily be overriden at install time.

fedora-packages:faust/faust.description: Faust AUdio STreams is a functional programming language for real-time audio signal processing. Its programming model combines two approaches : functional programming and block diagram composition. You can think of FAUST as a structured block diagram language with a textual syntax. FAUST is intended for developers who need to develop efficient C/C++ audio plugins for existing systems or full standalone audio applications. Thanks to some specific compilation techniques and powerful optimizations, the C++ code generated by the Faust compiler is usually very fast. It can generally compete with (and sometimes outperform) hand-written C code. Programming with FAUST is somehow like working with electronic circuits and signals. A FAUST program is a list of definitions that defines a signal processor block-diagram : a piece of code that produces output signals according to its input signals (and maybe some user interface parameters)

fedora-packages:gfs-fleischman-fonts/gfs.summary: GFS Fleischman, a majuscule Greek font family
fedora-packages:gfs-fleischman-fonts/gfs.description: As it is known, the Greek alphabet was used in majuscule form for over a millennium before the minuscule letters gradually replaced it until they became the official script in the 9th century A.D. Thereafter, majuscule letters were confined to sparse use as initials or elaborate titles until the Italian Renaissance. The new art of Typography, as well as the need of the humanists to mimic the ancient Greco-Roman period brought back the extensive use of the majuscule letter-forms in both Latin and Greek typography. Greek books of the time were printed using the contemporary Byzantine hand with which they combined capital letters modeled on the Roman antiquity, i.e. with thick and thin strokes and serifs. At the same time the Byzantine majuscule tradition, principally used on theological editions, remained alive until the early 19th century. GFS Fleischman was cut by Johann Michael Fleischman, type cutter of the Dutch Enschedé foundry and follows the baroque style of the mid-18th century aesthetics. It has been designed by George D. Matthiopoulos.

firefox-addons:784722.name: Dark Theme for Google™
firefox-addons:784722.summary: A highly customizable dark theme for Google products (search, images, translate, and contacts)
firefox-addons:784722.description:
"Dark Theme for Google" extension brings a customizable dark theme to some of the Google services such as Google Search and Google Images. The extension supports all localized Google domains.
Extension Preview:
 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3lan4mQKxBk 
Using this extension you can customize many colors including background and link colors on the options page of the extension if you don't like the default configuration. 
Features:
1. You can define a period for the extension to automatically activate the dark theme
2. You can append your custom CSS rules to the default dark theme from the options page
3. You can ask the extension to automatically follow the system color scheme (turn dark theme on when the preferred color scheme is dark and turn it off when not) (this feature uses the JavaScript's matchMedia method to install a listener for prefers-color-scheme).
Some of the Supported hostnames
1. Google Search ( www.google.com )
2. Google Images ( images.google.com )
3. SSL Google Search ( encrypted.google.com )
The extension also supports localized Google domains like www.google.fr for the Fr version of Google Search.
Please make sure you don't have the Stylish extension with styles installed that might conflict with this add-on.
--
This extension is an independent open-source project and is not related to Google Inc in anyways.

firefox-addons:2612181.name: Shopping Cart Share For Amazon
firefox-addons:2612181.summary: Shopping Cart Share is the go-to tool for easy online shopping. Our extension lets you compile carts from all Amazon stores and with just one click, you can share this cart and have others import it to their own account or simply save it.
firefox-addons:2612181.description:
Shopping Cart Share is the go-to tool for easy online shopping. Our extension lets you compile carts from all Amazon stores and with just one click, you can share this cart and have others import it to their own account or simply save it for another time. 
Key features:
- Create a single cart across multiple retailers.
- Share your unified cart or individual carts using a unique cart ID.
- Import shared carts from various retailers.
- Save a multi-store cart for later.
- Easy to manage carts and print as needed. 
Shopping Cart Share doesn't execute any purchasing actions on your behalf. Our platform streamlines the transfer of items from the originator's shopping basket to that of the recipient's - the ultimate transaction process (e.g. checkout) must be undertaken by the user themselves. 
Please note, Shopping Cart Share operates as an autonomous entity, with no official endorsements or authorizations from Amazon.
Start shopping smarter and sharing easier today with Shopping Cart Share!

bluejetty:00048059:android.summary:
Devotional bhajans & videos of Shiv, Ganesh, Krishna, Ram, Hanuman, Sai Baba, Lakshmi, Saraswati, Shabad Gurbani.
Saregama Bhakti is your destination to find peace & inner strength in all the times when you are faced with challenges & diff
bluejetty:00048059:android.description:
Devotional bhajans & videos of Shiv, Ganesh, Krishna, Ram, Hanuman, Sai Baba, Lakshmi, Saraswati, Shabad Gurbani.
Saregama Bhakti is your destination to find peace & inner strength in all the times when you are faced with challenges & difficult situations. It's a one stop for bhajans, granth, aartis, mantras, Stotrams, bhakti geet & videos.
This app features:
A. 8 dedicated channels of Ram & Hanuman, Shiv, Ganesh, Krishna, Sai, Devi, Shabad Gurbani, Nirgun
• Each channel offers a combination of audio, video bhajans
• Audio bhajans offer both on demand content like bhajans, chalisa as well as curated editor’s choice channels that play back to back bhajans along with small stories, facts about revered temples & other interesting information
• Video bhajans are presented in on-demand format as well as TV format. The TV format presents a curated list of bhajans that play back to back
• Wallpapers can be saved to the photo gallery on your phone
B. 10 scriptures including Shri Sai Satcharitra Granth, Sai jeevani, Tulsi Ramayan, Geeta Govinda, Sampoorna Sunderkand & more
• Each scripture is presented in short chapters & can be bookmarked too
• The bookmark feature lets you tune in from the point you left off the last time
C. 20+ powerful daily mantras such as Om Namah Shivay, Gayatri Mantra, Shanti Mantra, Mahamritunjay...
• Listen to them on-demand or create your playlist for easy chanting
D. 52 aartis including Om Jai Jagadish, Jai Ganesh & Aarti Kunj Bihari Ki 
• Aartis are available in on-demand format so that you can play them at your convenience. Use the filter option to search for your favourite aarti
E. 20+ Stotram across Devi, Hanuman, Shiva and many more deities
- Listen to Stotrams on demand
F. A new shloka everyday
- Start your day on a positive note with the “Shloka of the day”
- Share the shloka wallpaper with your friends & family
Our content collection features bhajans, mantras, aartis sung by Anup Jalota, Anuradha Paudwal, Lata Mangeshkar, Suresh Wadkar, Jagjit Singh & others.
Other Features:
- Link up to 2 mobile devices using the same login ID
- Offline both audio & videos to listen to your favourite Bhajans, Aartis, Mantras, Stotram, granth or watch videos even without being connected to the internet
- Create a playlist of your favourite audio bhajans, discourses, granth, stotram, mantras & aartis with the playlist feature
- Listen to the songs recommended by our editor under the Recommendations section
- No ads, just back to back bhajans
Supported by:
* Android: 10 and above

* Like us on Facebook: www.facebook.com/saregamabhakti 
* Follow us on Twitter: www.twitter.com/saregamaindia
* Please help us improve your experience by emailing to feedback.bhakti@saregama.com
* Don’t forget to rate the app & also write a review

bluejetty:00163873:ios.description:
Abu Dhabi Taxi Booking App. Get a taxi in less than 10 mins.
Abu Dhabi Taxi is a user friendly application that offers convenience to book a taxi in Abu Dhabi & Al Ain region of UAE from your current location, determined by the phone GPS.
What’s more? 
Request:
Book a taxi from the selected location by clicking Ride Now.
Favorites:
Bookmark your favorite addresses and experience accelerated access for your future taxi bookings.
Booking Status:
Added in app PUSH notification for all taxi bookings.
And also an SMS notification to the registered local number.
Track Taxi:
Locate your taxi for confirmed taxi booking. Tracking available for current bookings and tracking available from the time of confirmation and track his movement towards you.
Cancel booking:
You can cancel the booking by calling the call center or from your app using cancel option.
Feedback:
We value your feedback. You may share your taxi experience with us via “Send a Suggestion” feature from About us.
 تطبيق حجوزات أجرة أبو ظبي. احصل على مركبة أجرة في أقل من 10 دقائق.
تطبيق أجرة أبو ظبي، هو تطبيق سهل الاستخدام، يوفر الراحة في حجز مركبة أجرة في مدينتي أبو ظبي والعين من الامارات العربية المتحدة من موقعك الحالي، والتي يحددها نظام المواقع الجغرافية في هاتفك الذكي.
ماهو غير ذلك؟
الطلب:
احجز مركبة أجرة في الوقت الحالي من المكان الحالي بالضغط على خيار "حدد موقعي".
الأماكن المفضلة:
أضف عناوينك المفضلة لديك وقم بتجربة الوصول السريع لعناوينك المفضلة للحجوزات المستقبلية.
حالة الحجز:
أضيف ألى التطبيق خدمة "أعلام عن حالة الطلب" لجميع الحجوزات، وكذلك نقوم بإرسال رسالة نصية قصيرة للرقم المحلي المسجل لدينا.
تتبع مركبة ألاُجرة:
حدد موقع مركبة ألاجرة المخصصة لك. التتبع متاح للحجز الحالي و كذلك في وقت تأكيد الحجز ويكون بتتبع حركة مركبة ألاجرة بأتجاهها نحوكم.
إلغاء الحجز:
يمكنكم ألغاء الحجز عن طريق ألاتصال بمركز الحجوزات أو عن طريق التطبيق الخاص بك بالضغط على خيار " إلغاء".
أقتراحكم يهمنا:
نحن نقدر ملاحضاتكم. تستطيع أخبارنا عن تجربتك في استخدام أجرة أبو ظبي عن طريق خيار "أرسل اقتراحك" الموجود داخل خيار "معلومات عن مركز تنظيم النقل بسيارات ألاجرة".

bluejetty:00186562:ios.description:
Indic Keyboard – Type in 21 Languages
Type in English letters. Express yourself in your native script.
Indic Keyboard makes typing in Indian languages as easy as texting in Manglish, Hinglish, or Tanglish. Simply type phonetically using standard English letters, and watch your words instantly convert into authentic native scripts. No complex layouts to memorize—just type how it sounds.
SUPPORTED TRANSLITERATION MODES (21 LANGUAGES)
Hindi (Hinglish): Type "Namaste" -> नमस्ते
Malayalam (Manglish): Type "Namaskaram" -> നമസ്കാരം
Tamil (Tanglish): Type "Vanakkam" -> வணக்கம்
Telugu (Tenglish): Type "Namaskaram" -> నమస్కారం
Kannada (Kanglish): Type "Namaskara" -> ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ
Bengali (Bonglish / Banglish): Type "Nomoshkar" -> নমস্কার
Marathi (Maranglish): Type "Namaskar" -> नमस्कार
Gujarati (Gujlish): Type "Namaste" -> નમસ્તે
Punjabi (Punglish): Type "Sat Sri Akal" -> ਸਤਿ ਸ਼੍ਰੀ ਅਕਾਲ
Urdu (Roman Urdu / Urdish): Type "Adaab" -> آداب
Assamese (Asminglish), Odia (Odglish), Nepali (Neplish), Sinhala (Singlish), Konkani (Konkglish), Sanskrit (Sanglish), Kashmiri (Koshur English), Sindhi (Sindhglish), Maithili (Maithglish), Bodo (Bodoglish), and Manipuri (Meiteiglish).
KEY FEATURES
Smart Transliteration: Instant phonetic-to-script conversion powered by on-device machine learning.
Offline Support: Works without internet
Intelligent Word Predictions: Real-time next-word suggestions keep your typing fast and fluid.
Universal App Support: Works seamlessly across WhatsApp, Instagram, iMessage, Gmail, Notes, and Safari.
Native iOS Look and Feel: Familiar layout with fast one-tap globe switching.
Custom Stickers and Fonts: Create custom photo stickers and style your messages with expressive fonts.
Terms of use & Privacy Policy
https://reeba256.github.io/privacypolicy/

bluejetty:00177322:ios.description:
Can you describe an APPLE without using the words RED, FRUIT, PIE, CIDER or CORE?
Taboo is the ultimate brain-teasing, word-twisting adult party game. Play with video chat and throw a house party on your phone! Split into two teams and take it in turns to describe the words on the cards. Your team has to guess as many as possible before the timer runs out. 
If you use a taboo word by mistake, the other team will buzz and you’ll lose a point. 
Think fast and talk your way to victory!
HOW TO PLAY TABOO: 
1. Start a game and invite your friends. 
2. Split into two teams and name your team.
3. The app chooses a Clue-giver for each team. Each team then takes their turn!
4. The Clue-giver draws a card. The Clue-giver must describe the word without saying any of the words on the card.
5. Team B will buzz if the Clue-giver says a taboo word!
6. Your team must guess as many words as possible before the time runs out.
FEATURES
- FULLY CUSTOMISABLE – Decide the number of players, rounds, how many turns per round and how many skips are allowed.
- AD-FREE GAME – Have fun with zero ads to distract you.
- COMPLETE STARTER CARD DECK – Includes cards from the original game. Expand your game further with additional themed decks!
- FULLY TRANSLATED – Available in English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Turkish, Greek, Polish and Hindi.
Get the perfect party game on your mobile now!

bluejetty:00145807:ios.description:
Mobvoi application connects Mobvoi devices (including TicWatch, TicPods, TicBand, TicLife smart plug, etc) to your mobile phone. It manages devices, extends functions, synchronizes activity data and provides additional visualization and analysis.
Following features are provided to help manage your devices:
1. TicWatch ( includes TicWatch Pro & Pro3, TicWatch GTX, TicWatch Kids, etc)
a. Synchronize and Keep track of your activity and health records
b. Provide functions in addition to watch such as watch face management, audio recording transcription, etc.
c. Manage watch and account settings, permissions, profiles, etc.
d.You can sync health data to Apple health
2. TicPods ( includes TicPods 2 Standards, TicPods Pro, TicPods 2 Pro+, TicPods Free, etc)
a. Manage TicPods settings and preferences
b. Provide instant translator over voice & text input (English & Chinese)
Notice:
Mobvoi APP has been connected to HealthKit which allows users to synchronize motion recording, heart rate and sleep data to "Health".

bluejetty:00094782:ios.summary:
Easy Chair Workout & Exercises for Seniors, Men, and Women.
Welcome to ChairFit, the premier app for gentle chair workout and exercises, built especially for men, women, and seniors. Every chair workout session is fully seated, combining e
bluejetty:00094782:ios.description:
Easy Chair Workout & Exercises for Seniors, Men, and Women.
Welcome to ChairFit, the premier app for gentle chair workout and exercises, built especially for men, women, and seniors. Every chair workout session is fully seated, combining easy exercises and supportive guidance to help men, women, and seniors build strength and flexibility. Our 30-day chair workout program delivers one new workout and exercises routine per day for men and seniors. Each workout features clear videos, calm voiceovers, and step-by-step exercises — no standing, no floor work, just a sturdy chair. Men, women, and seniors can pause or replay any workout or exercises sequence, making every chair workout achievable at any pace.
What’s Inside:
• 30-Days Chair Workout Exercises Guided by Expert Wellness Coach
Simple daily exercises and a new workout each day for men, women, and seniors
• Fully Seated, Step-by-Step Guidance
All exercises are performed while seated, with calm pacing and easy-to-follow movements suitable for different comfort levels.
• Daily Sessions with Purpose
Each day is structured with a balance of breathing, movement, and focus—some days start gently, others bring energy. Some include cool-downs, others finish with a stretch or a moment of rest.
• Supportive Voiceovers
Every movement is paired with a friendly voiceover, helping you feel guided and reassured as you go.
• No Equipment Required
You’ll never need resistance bands, weights, or props. All sessions are designed to be done using just a sturdy chair.
• Pause or Play Anytime
Take a break or revisit a section whenever you like. There’s no timer pressure—just gentle guidance you can follow at your own pace.
• Simple Progress Tracking
Keep track of your streaks, total workouts, minutes moved, and more. You’ll see how consistently you’ve shown up—no pressure, just encouragement.
• Feel-Good Finishes
Every completed session ends with a cheerful screen and a gentle celebration because showing up matters.
Who It’s Made For:
• Men seeking easy chair workout exercises
• Seniors who want safe exercises without standing
• Women looking for easy chair workout exercises
• Beginners looking for gentle workout and chair exercises
• Anyone wanting low-impact chair workout and exercises
Benefits:
• Establish a daily chair workout habit for men, women, and seniors
• Improve circulation, posture, and mood with gentle exercises
• Build confidence through accessible workout routines
• Enjoy a no-equipment workout and easy exercises from a chair
• All you need is a sturdy chair, ten minutes, and a desire to start simple exercises for men and seniors.
• Support your posture, flexibility, and body awareness
• Enjoy a peaceful routine without loud music or fast transitions
• Move with confidence, at your own pace, in your own space
• Reduce stiffness and promote better circulation
• Feel accomplished with every completed session
• No pressure to perform—just encouragement to keep showing up
• A calming way to reconnect with your body, one day at a time
You’ll Only Need:
• A sturdy chair (with no wheels)
• 10 minutes a day
• A bit of curiosity to begin
Move gently. Show up consistently. Go at your own pace.
Download ChairFit now to begin your first chair workout, follow guided exercises, and embrace a healthier routine designed for men and seniors.

Terms of Use: https://www.notion.so/Terms-of-Use-1dd7052abbb480a08c67fefc060755b4
Important Medical Notice:
This app is developed for informational purposes only. Always consult your physician or doctor before starting any new fitness program.

bluejetty:00133730:android.description:
Dive into the exciting world of cricket with Cricket Championship! Step up to the crease and take control of your batsman in this immersive and addictive cricket game. Experience the thrill of batting, strategic play and the quest for cricketing glory.
If you love sports games, you're going to love this cricket game! Play and test your skills against legendary teams. In this batting focused cricket, with intuitive controls and quality graphics, you'll feel like you're in the middle of the action. Hit hard and run fast to reach the target score and win.
It's your time to swing the bat at the right time to win games and earn coins. With your winnings you can customize your batter with a wide selection of outfits, bats and accessories or better features, and much more!
Whether you are a fan of sports games in general or a die-hard cricket fan, Cricket offers you an accessible and engaging cricket experience that you can enjoy anytime, anywhere. Launch yourself to victory and become the ultimate cricket superstar.
CUSTOMIZE TO YOUR LIKING
Have fun customizing the players' appearance as well. In this game you choose! Pick the style and color of the uniforms you like the most. You can even change the physical appearance of the cricketer to make it look the way you want. 
FEATURES 
・Fun Cricket Championship
・Ideal for cricket and sports games lovers
・Get your country to win against teams from all over the world
・Choose the uniform and look of the players that you like the most
・Simple design and intuitive gameplay
・Official game of Coolmath Games
Download now Cricket Championship and begin your journey to cricketing greatness.

bluejetty:00150586:ios.description:
Welcome Home.
 With the new STRATIS Mobile App, Residents, Staff, Visitors, and Vendors can seamlessly use mobile passes for all electronic access points including elevators, parking garages, common areas, amenity areas, and of course, apartment units. Users have the ability to remotely control their smart devices in the unit (including thermostats, lighting, and more!), submit service requests, request access for visitors, and much more!
CHECK OUT OUR LIST OF COMPATIBLE DEVICES: https://stratisiot.com/connected-solutions/. Your property must have these types of devices installed and connected to STRATIS in order to work with the mobile app. Check with your property manager if you have any questions!
We make smart apartment living easier.
Residents with accounts immediately gain access to any and all devices and access points they have permissions for. When a Resident moves off the property, they immediately lose access to that unit, and the devices revert back to property management control. Backed by our property-wide networks for device connectivity and our SOC 2 Type 2 audited security focus, Residents and Staff users can rest at ease that their devices, data, and units are safe and secure.
STRATIS is Intelligent Buildings, not just shiny bells and whistles that typically come with the term “IoT.” We focus on security, energy management, asset protection, and efficiencies. We are installed in over 350,000 apartments in the U.S., and more than 30,000 apartments internationally.
This new STRATIS Mobile App is a scalable and flexible foundation that we continue to grow on, so don’t be surprised when you see cool new features every couple of months!
With STRATIS, you can:
* Customize your home dashboard with devices and scenes that you use the most
* Unlock your unit lock and other access points from your mobile device
* Control all devices in your apartment from anywhere in the world
* Create schedules and scenes for intelligent device control and management 
* Enable location-based triggers through geofencing
* Receive alerts for leaks, door & window openings, motion, etc.
* See and save energy and water consumption over time!*
* Control your devices through our Alexa and Google voice integrations
* Seamlessly interact with even the largest of devices, like window shades!
* Control and manage your water heater from the STRATIS Mobile App!**
* and so much more!
**If on a compatible energy metered, water metered, or water heater property. STRATIS integrates with the following devices: https://stratisiot.com/connected-solutions/
STRATIS – Smart Apartments. Intelligent Buildings.

bluejetty:00088960:ios.description:
StockNanny is a unique app that keeps investors connected to their stock portfolio. We provide you with proprietary information above and beyond what is available in current online brokerage apps. Our alerts are preconfigured and do not require manual setup. Our system monitors your stocks in the pre-market, during regular market hours, and in the post-market trading sessions.
Let StockNanny babysit your stocks when you can’t watch them! 
As a PAID Subscriber of StockNanny, you will receive the following real-time proprietary push alerts notifying you when:
> When your stock is declining rapidly in price to help mitigate losses
> When your stock is spiking in price
> Unusual volume levels in a stock
> Unusual post-market activity
> Bearish and Bullish Options activity in your stock
> Large Block Trades, Unusual Dark Pool activity and Insider Buying in your stock
> Trading halts
> Earnings Releases
> Premium Market News that corresponds to all alerts
and many other alerts you can choose from to stay informed about your portfolio whenever and wherever you are!
StockNanny’s Key Features that you will receive as a PAID Subscriber:
1) Alert Log – real-time proprietary AI alerts and news on stocks in your portfolio and custom watchlist. These may be filtered to see specific symbol alerts or alert criteria.
2) Watchlist – create your custom watchlist to track potential stock opportunities
3) Broker Connect – connect to your broker to allow StockNanny to monitor all of your positions
We use proprietary algorithms and AI to continually monitor over 10,000 NYSE and NASDAQ stocks multiple times per second to keep you connected and up to date on your portfolio. We also allow you to set up a watchlist for stocks you want on your radar.
SUBSCRIPTION AND TERMS:
StockNanny offers auto-renewing subscription options for access to the app’s premium features and content. Your subscription will automatically renew at the end of each term and payment will be charged through your iTunes account. You can turn off auto-renew at any time from your iTunes account settings but refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term. To avoid renewal, you must cancel at least 24 hours before your subscription or trial ends. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited if you purchase a subscription.

bluejetty:00159417:ios.description:
Stress-free weight loss without calorie counting! Enjoy game-like quests and establish lifelong healthy habits. Try it now!
Start your wellness journey with DAYDI, your gamified companion for building healthy habits and weight management. Say goodbye to calorie counting and hello to a fun, effective approach to a better you. Discover the joy of healthier living, one day at a time, with DAYDI!
Experience the revolution in wellness with DAYDI, an innovative mobile application designed to assist you in establishing beneficial habits for weight loss, muscle gain, fitness maintenance, or overall wellness. This intuitive app takes a novel approach to health, removing the grind and stress of calorie counting in favor of engaging in daily tasks designed for better living. 
Prepare meals using our carefully planned recipes, meet your step goals, stay hydrated, and earn points for every action you complete. The beauty of DAYDI lies in its positive reinforcement system. Instead of creating guilt and anxiety around numbers like calories, proteins, fats, and carbohydrates, DAYDI allows you to accumulate bonuses for every healthy action. These bonuses can then be spent on small diet indulgences – a bottle of wine, a delicious dessert, or even a carefree weekend away from your diet plan! This positive stimulus not only motivates you in the short term but also encourages the formation of lifelong healthy habits.
With DAYDI, customization is key. Create your own recipes, add personalized exercise routines, and share your unique dietary advice. Plus, DAYDI simplifies grocery shopping by generating lists based on your planned dishes. We don't promote fad diets or unproven health trends. Instead, DAYDI stands for a balanced approach to nutrition and fitness. This gamified wellness journey not only aids you in achieving your goals but ensures that you maintain your results for a lifetime. Experience the joy of healthy living with DAYDI!
In the DAYDI app, you can enjoy a variety of features:
- Positive Reinforcement: Earn bonuses for healthy actions, which can be spent on small diet indulgences. This creates a motivating, guilt-free wellness journey!
- No Calorie Counting: Forget the stress of tracking calories, proteins, fats, and carbs. Just cook according to the planned recipes and observe the portion size!
- Gamified Wellness: Gain experience, level up, and have fun on the journey toward a healthier you! 
- Simplified Meal Planning: DAYDI offers carefully planned recipes and generates shopping lists based on your planned meals. It’s never been easier to stay healthy!
- Workout Routines: Access routines from renowned fitness influencers to complement your diet and boost your fitness journey!
- Healthy Recipes: Discover a catalog of delicious, healthy recipes that support your unique and exciting wellness journey!
- Integrating with Apple Health (HealthKit): we compile your fitness data (steps taken, calories burned) to provide accurate progress tracking.
- Balanced Approach to Nutrition: DAYDI offers customized nutrition plans for your unique journey – you always receive a balanced diet catered to you!
- Lifelong Healthy Habits: The app's unique approach encourages the formation of healthy habits that will stay with you for a lifetime!
With a paid renewable subscription, you will have access to a personalized 3-month wellness plan, which is updated monthly based on your individual progress.
Whether your goal is to lose weight, gain muscle, or simply maintain a healthy lifestyle, DAYDI is here to support you every step of the way. Don't wait another day to transform your life. Download DAYDI now and start building a better, healthier you today!

bluejetty:00062649:ios.description:
Your Rutgers day in one app: your next class, the buses heading your way and what's for dinner, all on one screen.

BUSES
• Live arrival times for every stop, with the closest stops first
• See the buses moving along their route on the map
• Set a reminder for 10, 5, 4, 3, 2 or 1 minute before your bus arrives
• Star the stops you use and see every route that serves them
RIDE ALONG (NEW)
• With the Bus tab open on a Rutgers bus, RUMobile notices and asks "On the LX?"
• Ride along and other students see a rider count on your bus, never your name
• Say how full it is: Seats, Standing or Packed
• Show your avatar on the map, or keep it hidden
• Your Rutgers map on your profile colors in every route you ride
• Anyone can see riders and crowding on the stop map; riding along needs an account
• Location is used only while the app is open, never in the background

• Breakfast, lunch, dinner and takeout menus for the next five days
• Flag the allergens you avoid and see at a glance which dishes contain them

CLASSES
• Search the Schedule of Classes and save your sections
• My Schedule shows your week by day or by week, with reminders before each class
• Add your own classes, and edit rooms and times
RUTGERS GLOBAL
• One chat room for the whole campus, with each student's major and year
• Report or block anyone in two taps; messages disappear after 5 days
• Create an account with your email to post and set up your profile
LINKS
• myRutgers, Canvas, library hours, the Targum and more, one tap away
EVERY CAMPUS
• Pick New Brunswick, Newark or Camden and buses, dining and classes follow your campus
RUMobile is an independent app. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Rutgers, The State University of New Jersey.

豆瓣阅读是一个活跃的创作者与读者交流的社区。在这里，可以与更多豆瓣好友进行深入的讨论与交流。对喜欢的作品和作者，可以关注、订阅、评论、送花。
在豆瓣阅读里，你可以——
读到优质小说
• 悬疑、女性、幻想、文艺、历史五大频道，拥有豆瓣评分 8.0 以上的优质小说，经过豆瓣读者数据检验。
• 绝对原创，每月新作 9000+，超过半数作品免费阅读。来自当下最优秀的青年创作者。
• 近 10 万种经过精细排版的正版电子图书，包括中信、读客、果麦、磨铁等多家著名出版社。
订阅作者长篇连载
• 订阅：专栏和连载有更新，第一时间提醒。
• 送花：给你爱的作品送花，帮助它成为花神。
• 批注：可以对书中的任何一个细节进行批注。豆瓣阅读每月新增批注 60000+，读到书友们令人叫绝的批注，是使用豆瓣阅读特有的乐趣。
• 评论：在豆瓣阅读评论，可以得到作者第一时间的回复。豆瓣阅读每月新增评论 15000+，作者与读者之间碰撞出的思维火花，和小说本身一样好看。 
• 赠书：支持送书给朋友，可一对一赠送，也可以一次购买多本送给多个朋友，还可以写赠言。
找到你想读的电子书
• 按热门程度、按更新字数、按好评程度……各种榜单实时更新，帮助选出最好看的作品。
• 按作品分类、按价格区间、按热门程度、按发表时间……多种作品筛选和排序方法，帮助选出最想看的作品。
• 个性化小说推荐，猜中你的喜好；编辑精选主题书单，提供最专业的选书视角。
享受细腻的阅读体验
• 精致的书籍内容排版，最优美的细节呈现，支持在阅读中批注、划线、添加书签，免费试读所有作品，可下载作品到本地，随时离线阅读。
• 已购作品、阅读进度、书签、笔记等可在多个设备间实时同步。
成为作者，来写作和发表第一部作品
• 开放写作平台：原创作品自出版平台，开放接受投稿（请在电脑上访问 https://read.douban.com/submit/ ），为作品提供在线售卖、运营和推广服务。
• 版权运营：为作品提供可信赖的版权运营服务，包括影视改编、纸书出版等版权业务。已有多部原创作品成功售出影视改编权，涵盖女性、职场、都市、悬疑、幻想等多个题材。已经将近百本纸质书陆续出版。
• 征文大赛：连续主办六届的大型赛事，分组别竞赛，职场爱情、生活悬疑、幻想小说、文艺小说等每组都选出青年获奖作者。已经成为国内青年作者最重要的出道比赛。
更多精彩
• 精彩原创：《装腔启示录》、《雪盲》、《双宿时代》、《天下刀宗》、《小敏家》、《贤媛》、《滚尘》、《美人余》、《她和她的群岛》、《盘锦豹子》、《欢迎光临兔子直播间》、《这里没有善男信女》、《孤独实验室》、《找到她》、《差一点少女》、《海葵》。
• 畅销佳作：《月亮与六便士》、《流浪地球》、《哈利波特》、《拉普拉斯的魔女》、《无人生还》、《飘》、《基督山伯爵》、《危险的维纳斯》、《活着》、《古董局中局》、《原来你也在这里》。
• 好评作者：东野圭吾、J·K·罗琳、刘慈欣、阿加莎·克里斯蒂、马伯庸、紫金陈、顾漫、八月长安、阿耐、刘玥、叶小辛、易难、翼走、双翅目、郭沛文、伊北、王平常。
• 言情、女性、悬疑、推理、科幻、幻想、青春、都市、文艺等众多分类书籍等你发现。

自动续费协议：https://read.douban.com/membership/auto_renewable

bluejetty:00064407:ios.summary: Introducing Wordox, the ultimate multiplayer word game that will challenge your brain and test your vocabulary skills like never before! In Wordox, you'll unscramble letters and compete against your friends to create words and steal points
bluejetty:00064407:ios.description:
Introducing Wordox, the ultimate multiplayer word game that will challenge your brain and test your vocabulary skills like never before! In Wordox, you'll unscramble letters and compete against your friends to create words and steal points from your opponents. Whether you're a crossword puzzle enthusiast or simply looking for a fun and engaging word game, Wordox is the perfect choice for you!
START PLAYING
► Create your own game and challenge your friends or players across the world to an exciting showdown. Find the perfect opponent and test your skills in a classic game of words and letters.
WHY IS WORDOX UNIQUE?
►In Wordox, you compete against another player in a 1-on-1 match on a game board. Your goal is to take turns composing words from the letters on your easel. But that's not all! It's not enough to make a long word to win! In fact, you will have to master word stealing: by adding letters to a word placed by your opponent, you will "steal" the points of this word. Your opponent's score will then be reduced! You will learn to play with suffixes, prefixes, declensions, and you will discover that one letter can turn the game around! Use your strategy to be the best!
TRAIN YOUR VOCABULARY IN AI CHALLENGE
► Take on the word puzzle challenge and battle an AI. With increasing levels of difficulty as you progress, these word search games against an AI will put your spelling skills to the test. Take the opportunity to improve your wordplay, or simply play at your own pace.
PARTICIPATE IN WEEKLY EVENTS
► Every week there are animations waiting for you to discover a new atmosphere, to win coins and to take part in competitions. Encounter thousands of players in competitive crossword games and progress each week and become the master of words.
JOIN THE WORDOX COMMUNITY
► Whether you're a seasoned word game veteran or just starting out, Wordox is the perfect game for anyone looking to challenge their brain. You can also meet new people, Wordox has a vast community of passionate players.
If you are a fan of multiplayer board games and anagram, try Wordox, the best word app for everyone ! Download Wordox today and join the ultimate showdown!
FOLLOW US & SPEAK TO US
Twitter: https://twitter.com/WordoxGame
Wordox is a free multiplayer word game with advertising and in-app purchases.

listings.description:
Introducing Wordox, the ultimate multiplayer word game that will challenge your brain and test your vocabulary skills like never before! In Wordox, you'll unscramble letters and compete against your friends to create words and steal points from your opponents. Whether you're a crossword puzzle enthusiast or simply looking for a fun and engaging word game, Wordox is the perfect choice for you!

START PLAYING
► Create your own game and challenge your friends or players across the world to an exciting showdown. Find the perfect opponent and test your skills in a classic game of words and letters.

WHY IS WORDOX UNIQUE?
►In Wordox, you compete against another player in a 1-on-1 match on a game board. Your goal is to take turns composing words from the letters on your easel. But that's not all! It's not enough to make a long word to win! In fact, you will have to master word stealing: by adding letters to a word placed by your opponent, you will "steal" the points of this word. Your opponent's score will then be reduced! You will learn to play with suffixes, prefixes, declensions, and you will discover that one letter can turn the game around! Use your strategy to be the best!

TRAIN YOUR VOCABULARY IN AI CHALLENGE
► Take on the word puzzle challenge and battle an AI. With increasing levels of difficulty as you progress, these word search games against an AI will put your spelling skills to the test. Take the opportunity to improve your wordplay, or simply play at your own pace.

PARTICIPATE IN WEEKLY EVENTS
► Every week there are animations waiting for you to discover a new atmosphere, to win coins and to take part in competitions. Encounter thousands of players in competitive crossword games and progress each week and become the master of words.

JOIN THE WORDOX COMMUNITY
► Whether you're a seasoned word game veteran or just starting out, Wordox is the perfect game for anyone looking to challenge their brain. You can also meet new people, Wordox has a vast community of passionate players.

If you are a fan of multiplayer board games and anagram, try Wordox, the best word app for everyone ! Download Wordox today and join the ultimate showdown!

FOLLOW US & SPEAK TO US
Twitter: https://twitter.com/WordoxGame

Wordox is a free multiplayer word game with advertising and in-app purchases.

bluejetty:00036844:ios.description:
Your Future Made Simple.
Encourage is a free, all-in-one college and career planning app and your go-to middle school and high school app for figuring out what’s next. Made just for students in grades 7–12, it helps you discover who you are, explore what’s possible, and take real steps toward your future. Thinking about college, a career, or just figuring it out? Wherever you're headed, Encourage is here to support you.
You can use Encourage to:
• Match with colleges that fit your goals and needs
• Explore college admissions, costs, student life, and more
• Find scholarships that match your interests
• Learn about college costs and financial aid, including the FAFSA
• Get college application help and semester-by-semester guidance
• Plan each semester of high school with a personalized checklist
• Explore over 900 career paths with details on salaries and skills
• Build your college checklist and stay organized from start to finish
• … and more
My Journey
My Journey is your personal roadmap. Set goals, complete grade-level tasks, and track your progress. Whether you're exploring majors, applying for scholarships, preparing for college, or exploring careers, My Journey keeps you organized and ready for graduation and beyond. It is your all-in-one student planner for high school success.
My Colleges
Search thousands of schools based on what matters to you, like location, cost, campus vibe, majors, and more. Save your favorites, compare your options, and use Encourage as your personal college list builder.
My Majors
Not sure what to study? Take a quiz that matches your strengths and interests to real majors. Then explore what you would learn, which schools offer it, and how it connects to future careers and degrees.
My Careers
Take just one quick quiz to find careers that align with your personality and interests. Learn what they pay, how to get there, and what day-to-day life is like. It is the perfect tool to explore all types of careers.
My Scholarships
My Scholarships is your go-to scholarship finder. No more endless Googling or wondering if a scholarship is real. With over 80,000 verified scholarships for students, you can find opportunities that actually match your background and goals. Save your favorites, keep track of deadlines, and manage your applications all in one place.
My Library
My Library is your go-to resource hub full of helpful articles and videos. Search everything from college admission help and guidance to tips on paying for college and planning strategies for high school and beyond. Use My Library to explore content that matches your interests and goals, and dive into support whenever you need it.
Your future starts now! Let Encourage help you build it. Download now and start exploring.

bluejetty:00141673:ios.description:
WeRise is the all-in-one strength training App for women ready to take their body to the next level, sharpen their mind, and own their power.
Led by renowned trainer Senada Greca, WeRise combines strength training, nutrition, mindfulness, and community to help you build unshakeable confidence and long-lasting strength.
We've packed everything into one centralized place – a complete suite of workouts (strength training, Pilates, glute-focused sessions, upper body sculpting, yoga flows, and HIIT), flexible nutrition, mindset courses, cycle syncing, and a community of thousands that rises with you.
Personalized Workout Plans
Follow Senada's signature training methods with structured programs or grab-and-go workouts for all levels. Choose from gym workouts where you log your own sets and reps, or follow-along video workouts where Senada guides you through every move in real-time - perfect for at home.
Senada's Expert Coaching on Every Exercise
Watch detailed video demonstrations where Senada guides you through proper form, breathing cues, and exactly how to execute each movement. See color-coded muscles worked diagrams showing which areas you're targeting.
Cycle Syncing For Smarter Training
Track your menstrual cycle and get recommendations for adjusting your workout intensity throughout the month. Train harder when your hormones support it, ease back when your body needs recovery.
Progress Tracking That Keeps You Motivated
Log every workout - reps, sets, weights lifted. Watch the numbers climb week after week. Visual dashboards and personalized home screens show exactly how much stronger you're getting.
Custom Meal Planning & Nutrition
Pick from flexible meal plans for Vegan, Vegetarian, Pescatarian, or Standard diets. Browse a nutrient-rich recipe library with full macros and prep times. Select your weekly meals and auto-generate your shopping list. Track your nutrition and personalize your weekly meal plan at the touch of your fingertips.
Mindfulness & Self-Development
Build mental strength with expert-led content that helps you grow in all aspects of your life. Explore topics like confidence, breaking free from restrictive diets, navigating relationships, and achieving career success. Because true strength isn't only physical - it's about feeling powerful in every area of your life.
Join The WeRise Community
Connect with thousands of women training alongside you in our highly engaged WhatsApp community. Get support, stay accountable, ask form questions, share meal ideas, and celebrate your progress!
Inside the app you'll be able to…
- Follow Senada Greca's signature training methods
- See exactly which muscles you're working with detailed diagrams
- Sync workouts to your menstrual cycle
- Access over 20 workout programs and hundreds of workouts
- Get personalized meal plans with macro tracking
- Generate automated shopping lists
- Build mental strength with expert courses
- Track your lifts and see your progress over time
- Connect with a supportive community keeping you motivated
WeRise helps you build real strength - the kind you feel in your body and carry in your mind. One workout, one meal, one win at a time.
Start to feel more powerful, confident, and in control of your health. Whether you're looking for the best fitness app for women, a comprehensive nutrition tracker, or expert strength training plans, WeRise is your all-in-one solution for a healthy lifestyle.

bluejetty:00073965:ios.summary:
Write by hand, annotate PDFs and connect your ideas with Prodrafts. Move freely across an infinite canvas, use paged notebooks for structured work, or organize ideas in a mind map. Keep words, drawings and study materials together.
NOTES T
bluejetty:00073965:ios.description:
Write by hand, annotate PDFs and connect your ideas with Prodrafts. Move freely across an infinite canvas, use paged notebooks for structured work, or organize ideas in a mind map. Keep words, drawings and study materials together.
NOTES THAT FIT THE WAY YOU THINK
Capture lecture notes, sketch concepts and work through diagrams without running out of room. Use natural pen tools, shapes, a ruler and a compass for handwritten explanations and geometry notes.
READ, ANNOTATE AND REVISIT
Import PDFs, highlight key passages and add handwritten notes. Bring course slides, reading materials and PDF planners into your notebook. Search PDF text and make supported scanned PDFs searchable with OCR.
SEE CONNECTIONS
Build mind maps with text, handwriting and attachments. Move ideas, fold branches and connect related topics to make a clearer study outline or brainstorm board.
FROM QUICK NOTES TO DOCUMENTS
Write with headings, lists, tasks, tables, links and equations. Import and export Markdown, and export text documents to Word/DOCX. Add images and recordings to your notes. Place web link cards and video on your canvas to keep related material together.
PAPER FOR YOUR NEXT PROJECT
Choose lined, grid and dot paper, Cornell layouts, weekly and monthly planner pages, music staff and guitar tablature paper, or guides for handwriting practice. Use them for a reading journal, study sheets or handwritten planning.
RECORD AND PRESENT
Record classes, meetings and ideas. On supported systems and languages, turn recordings into text. Present your canvas on an external display and guide attention with the laser pointer.
KEEP YOUR WORK CLOSE
Organize documents in folders, enable iCloud sync across your devices, and share notes as PDFs or images.
Some tools, templates and document limits require an in-app purchase. Availability varies by device, system version and language. Audio transcription requires iOS, iPadOS or macOS 26 or later and a supported system language.
The subscription will automatically renew unless canceled, and will be charged through your Apple iTunes account. The price may vary depending on your location.
Prodrafts is a product registered and developed by EMMO Corp.

PlugShare is the world’s largest EV driver community. Drivers contribute station reviews and photos to help the EV community make the most informed charging decisions possible. 
Drivers can filter the PlugShare map by plug type, including CHAdeMO and SAE/CCS, as well as charging speed, including Level 1, Level 2, and DC Fast Chargers such as Tesla Superchargers. You can also filter by charging provider – the PlugShare map includes detailed station information for every major EV charging network in North America, Europe, and much of the rest of the world, including:
- ChargePoint

With PlugShare, you can:
- Find public charging stations compatible with your EV (or EVs if you have multiple electric vehicles)
- See each station’s PlugScore™ rating to quickly gauge charger reliability based on real driver reviews
- Filter for connector type, charging speed, and amenities like food or bathrooms
- Check for station functionality and current availability 
- Link to your favorite navigation app for directions to your selected charger
- Pay for charging with Pay with PlugShare (at participating locations) and monitor your session
- Add new charging stations to the map as you discover them
- Receive notifications when a new charger is installed nearby
- Find all the charging stations along a road trip route with a built-in EV trip planner
- Use PlugShare with Apple CarPlay to browse nearby charging locations, bookmarked locations, and trips you've planned from the built-in display of CarPlay compatible vehicles
- And more! 
PlugShare helps drivers find chargers compatible with any EV, including Tesla Model X, Tesla Model Y, and Tesla Model 3; the Ford Mustang Mach-E, Chevrolet Bolt, VW ID.4, Nissan LEAF, BMW i3, Audi e-tron, Hyundai Kona, Hyundai Ioniq 5, Porsche Taycan, Kia e-Niro, Volvo XC40, Polestar and all other electric vehicles on the market.

bluejetty:00062993:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00062993:ios.description:
OVER 1.6 MILLION DOWNLOADS
Beads Creator is an easy-to-use app that lets you create fuse beads and Perler beads patterns with simple controls.
With pixel art style editing, you can intuitively design your own
bead patterns and bead layouts. Creating patterns using images is also supported.
SIMPLE AND EASY FOR EVERYONE
Thanks to a clean and intuitive UI, even beginners can quickly start creating fuse bead patterns.
The app supports multiple bead brands such as Perler Beads, Hama Beads, and Nano Beads, making it easy to design patterns that match the beads you already use.
It's also great for pixel art creation and cross-stitch pattern design.
RECOMMENDED FOR
- Fans of fuse beads and Perler beads
- Anyone who wants to create bead patterns or bead designs
- Lovers of pixel art and retro games
- Cross-stitch and accessory makers
- People looking for design templates for handmade projects
SUPPORTS 6 BEAD TYPES
- Perler Beads
- Nano Beads
- Midi Fuse Beads (5.0 mm)
- Mini Fuse Beads (2.6 mm)
- Midi Hama Beads (5.0 mm)
- Mini Hama Beads (2.5 mm)
IMAGE-BASED PATTERN CREATION
You can also import images onto a pegboard and use them as fuse bead patterns.
Note: Image-based patterns may not work well on non-square pegboards.
CHECK COLORS AND QUANTITIES WITH THE BEAD LIST
View the colors and required quantities of beads used in your design
with the Bead List feature. This makes preparation for crafting much easier.
PATTERN CREATION LIMITS
- Initial limit: up to 30 patterns
- Watch a video ad: +5 patterns each time
- Increase the limit up to 480 patterns
REMOVE ADS (PAID OPTION)
By purchasing the Remove Ads add-on, you can:
- Hide all ads
- Increase the maximum number of patterns to 480
Note: This is a one-time purchase and can be restored after reinstalling the app.

* Move the liquids until each bottle contains only one color.

* Cat Collection Journal – Track the cats you unlock and discover their stories.
* Decorate Your Sorting Space – Earn cozy backgrounds and accessories to style your game.

* A relaxing puzzle and brain game with just the right splash of charm

bluejetty:00161265:ios.summary:

Arab Therapy is an online mental‑health platform connecting you with licensed psychologists and psychiatrists from across the world. Through confidential video, audio or chat session
bluejetty:00161265:ios.description:
Arab Therapy: Your Online Mental Health Support Platform
Arab Therapy is an online mental‑health platform connecting you with licensed psychologists and psychiatrists from across the world. Through confidential video, audio or chat sessions you can receive professional therapy from the comfort of your home. Our therapists are supervised and trained by Arab psychiatrists in Germany, ensuring high standards of care.
Our mission is to make mental‑health care accessible and stigma‑free. Book sessions for anxiety, depression, stress, addiction, OCD or relationship issues, and others. You can schedule appointments or join support groups. Use journaling, meditation and mindfulness tools built into the app to support your self‑care. In emergencies, chat with a doctor instantly.
All practitioners are licensed and vetted. Your data is encrypted and protected. Whether you need talk therapy, cognitive behavioral therapy, counselling or psychiatric consultation, Arab Therapy provides personalized care in Arabic and English.
Why Choose Arab Therapy?
Affordable Therapy: Flexible pricing based on your selected package.
Easy Booking: Attend psychotherapy sessions from home, office, car, or any private space.
Guaranteed Privacy: Your information remains confidential and inaccessible to any third party, including Arab Therapy.
Continuous Support: Message your therapist anytime throughout the week.
Flexible Scheduling: Choose times that fit your routine.
Therapist Matching: Change your therapist if needed for a better experience.
Dedicated Customer Support: Our team is always ready to assist you.
Cancel Anytime: No long-term commitment—pause or stop your subscription when needed.
Licensed & Trained Therapists
Our expert team includes licensed psychiatrists and therapists/psychologists specializing in various fields, including:
Individual Therapy: Anxiety, depression, stress, tension, phobias, and more.
Child & Adolescent Therapy: Behavioral adjustments and emotional support.
Marriage & Family Therapy: Relationship and family conflict resolution.
All therapists/psychologists hold master’s or doctoral degrees and undergo continuous supervision and training.
How It Works
Enter Your Information: Helps us match you with the right therapist.
Choose a Subscription Plan: Weekly, monthly, or quarterly options.
Secure Payment: Multiple safe payment methods available.
Therapist Assignment: Get matched with a therapist/psychologist within 24 hours.
Start Your Therapy Journey: Schedule your first session and begin your healing process.
Download Arab Therapy now and start your healing journey. Prioritise your mental health, nurture your wellbeing and get the support you deserve.
Get Started Today!

With the Thimble app, you can buy and manage your policy from wherever you are. Make policy changes anytime and get an updated Certificate of Insurance in your inbox, instantly*. 
Thimble offers coverage by the job, month, or year so you can choose the duration that works for you, then upgrade when business really takes off*. 
---
The Thimble app
- Buy a policy in minutes — from anywhere! 
- Get a Certificate of Insurance in your inbox — instantly! 
- Modify your policy duration: 
 - Extend an On Demand policy 
 - Upgrade to an Annual policy 
 - Pause a Monthly policy 
- Add unlimited Additional Insureds 
- Get important policy updates via SMS push notifications 
---
Coverages we offer:
- General Liability Insurance 
- Professional Liability Insurance 
- Business Equipment Protection (Inland Marine) 
- Business Owners Policies 
- Commercial Property Insurance 
- Workers’ Compensation 
- Cyber Insurance 
- Event Insurance

- Handymen + Contractors 
- Landscaping 
- Photo + Video 
- Cleaning Services

- Pet Services 
- Sports + Fitness 
- Hair + Beauty 
- Event Professionals 
- Professional Services 
- Outdoor Guides 
- Retail + Wholesalers 
- Restaurants

- Events

Thimble puts small businesses in control. 
You didn’t start your dream business for the thrill of buying insurance. That’s why we work hard to make insurance easier, faster, and more accessible, whether you’re just starting out or celebrating twenty years in business.

- 550+ activities covered

- BBB accredited business 
---

- Eligibility, pricing, and coverage may vary by state, activity or class, and other factors. 
- Policy details, including the terms and conditions of the policy, are available within the app once the policy is purchased. 
- Verifly Insurance Services, LLC is a licensed insurance broker in all 50 states and the District of Columbia.
