bluejetty:00110700:android.description:
Start your very own Cafe Business / Coffee Shop today, invite the customers to your store in the most awesome way possible - just tap tap tap to make customers flood your store, Expand your cafe and Become the next Cafe Shop Simulation Tycoon!
Opening your own coffee shop / cafe has never been this rewarding!
Where have you been all this time? Manage your own Cafe Restaurant and join the cooking game fever. Create new recipes and sell them to your customers! You can even hire employees and create more recipes and get a cooking high !
Coffee and You have one thing in common, BOTH OF YOU ARE BETTER RICH!
Do you remember your dream about opening your very own coffee Shop or café or becoming a big business tycoon?
Cafe Tycoon shop features: 
:::::BUILD YOUR OWN CAFE BUSINESS:::::
- Tap tap tap to make customers flood your simulator starbooks café store
- Upgrade your shop, the customer will come automatically even when you're idle.
- Hire hardworking kitchen employees and make them work for you either in the café or the kitchen.
- Create your own recipes with unique ingredients and sell the best menu item with these awesome recipes
- Purchase, manage, participate in day to day operations to run the tycoon cafe business
- Upgrade and expand incremental cafe, add more floors to get new customers
- Upgrade your cafe and equipments to unlock lots of food recipes and ingredients
- Unlock awesome furniture to make the cafe business even more attractive!
- Improve your café shop administrator’s skills
Choose between a girl or a boy to train an expert and prepare the richest coffees, Frappuccinos, Lattes, Cupcakes, Pizzas and Hot cakes. The best starbooks simulator game.
:::::BECOME RICH:::::
- Collect money even when you're away!
- Passive income will help you grow even when you’re sleeping
- Grow your business and be RICH! Don't waste your time, there's never been a better time to open cafe shop than today!
:::::BE THE BEST CAFE SHOP BUSINESS OWNER AND TYCOON:::::
- Know your customers better and listen to their stories
- Invite World's Best Baristas to join your simulator coffee shop
- Espresso yourself! Decorate your shop according to your taste!
Download now to start your coffee business, and next week you'll already be a Billionaire!
What can you be in next month?
Multi Billionaire ? Trillionaire ? Multi Billionaire? Or Multi Trillionaire? Even more maybe?
Find out yourself!
Note 1: Cafe Tycoon Idle is an idle tap tap clicking game. Some people also call it a clicker or a clicking game. You just need to tap or click on your phone's screen to invite the customer. When you progress in the game, you can upgrade the items to make customer come automatically even when you're idle or away, you can also create your own recipes and sell them, hire employees, make better recipes, so you won't have to tap or click on the screen too often. (You can still tap or click on the screen to fasten your progress of course!)
Note 2: Cafe Tycoon Idle sometimes use "Idle Game" or "Clicker Game" or “Tap Tap” at the end of the name. But we're still the same game, since both idle game and clicker game define the general gameplay of Cafe Tycoon Idle. But don't worry, we can assure you that Cafe Tycoon Idle is more than just a general idle or clicker or tap tap or regular clicking game. Just give it a try! :)
Note 3: Cafe Tycoon Idle (or Cafe Tycoon Idle clicker game) is a free game but does offer in-app purchases of various kinds.
Got problems? Questions? Or simply want to share some love? Get in touch! info@theholycowstudio.com

bluejetty:00087301:ios.name: Reflection: AI Journal & Diary
bluejetty:00087301:ios.summary:
Reflection is a journal that writes back.
Write or speak about your day, and Reflection's AI Coach replies right inside your entry with a question that helps you go a layer deeper. Over time your journal becomes something you can ask: what
bluejetty:00087301:ios.description:
Reflection is a journal that writes back.
Write or speak about your day, and Reflection's AI Coach replies right inside your entry with a question that helps you go a layer deeper. Over time your journal becomes something you can ask: what has been weighing on you, what brings you joy, how your mood has shifted since spring.
NEW IN REFLECTION 7
A complete redesign. The journal is calmer and more spacious, with nine color themes, a rebuilt Coach, one + button for everything you add to an entry, and Focus Mode for longer sessions. It's faster, too.
A COACH IN EVERY ENTRY
• Instant Chat: press Enter and the Coach replies on the next line.
• Go Deeper, Get Perspective, Coach Me and Action Items when you want more.
• Voice Call (Premium): talk it through out loud. When you hang up, the conversation is written into your entry.
ASK YOUR JOURNAL ANYTHING
Search by meaning, not only by keyword. Ask "What have I been grateful for lately?" and get an answer drawn from your own entries, with the dates you wrote them.
WRITE, SPEAK OR SCAN
• Voice journaling with accurate transcription
• Scan a handwritten page into text
• Add photos, and catch up on missed days from your camera roll
• Templates and daily prompts for when you don't know where to start
SEE HOW YOU'RE GROWING
Mood and emotion insights, writing streaks, and weekly, monthly and annual reviews that show where your head has been.
100+ GUIDED JOURNALS AND PROMPTS
Gratitude, anxiety, self-care, shadow work, relationships, work and more, including multi-day programs like the 14-day Reflect & Reset. A fresh prompt is waiting on your Today page each morning.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your entries are encrypted
• Lock the app with Face ID or a PIN, and keep single entries private
• Your entries are never used to train AI models
• Turn AI off entirely, or exclude any entry from it
• Export your journal as PDF, CSV or JSON whenever you like
EVERYWHERE YOU WRITE
iPhone, iPad, Mac and the web, all in sync.
"This app manages to do what many others in this category don't: make AI features that actually feel useful." (App Store review, July 2026)
FREE TO START
Journal for free, with AI Coach replies each day and insights after every entry. Reflection Premium adds unlimited AI and voice, Voice Call, all 100+ guides, all nine themes, App Lock, export and unlimited sync.
Reflection is a tool for self-reflection. It is not a substitute for professional mental health care.
Questions or feedback: hello@reflection.app
Terms: https://www.reflection.app/tos
Privacy: https://www.reflection.app/pp

bluejetty:00076373:ios.name: Acrostics－Daily Crossword Game
bluejetty:00076373:ios.summary: Want to keep your memory razor sharp and your brain active? Enjoy solving crossword puzzles! You’ve come to the right place! The Acrostics crossword games will surely keep your mind busy, challenge your brain and make you feel good every ti
bluejetty:00076373:ios.description:
Want to keep your memory razor sharp and your brain active? Enjoy solving crossword puzzles! You’ve come to the right place! The Acrostics crossword games will surely keep your mind busy, challenge your brain and make you feel good every time you solve your next logic puzzle 
Acrostics is a perfect mix of your good old style crossword puzzles combined with a unique approach to logic games. How is it unique? You will be deciphering words in logic crosswords by matching letters with pictograms How cute! 
Also, Acrostics will ask you to use antonyms, synonyms, and anagrams in the challenging but yet relaxing brain games. This makes it an even more effective brain-training tool which boosts your knowledge instantly no matter whether you play alone or search for the right word with friends. 
Top Features: 
-Tons of fascinating word puzzles on all kinds of topics
-Challenging hidden proverbs, dazzling quotes, fun historical facts, more!
-Endless crossword puzzles in the most relaxing brain games ever
-Every difficulty level: from very easy to quite challenging crosswords
-An awesomely user-friendly interface with clean graphics
-4 mind-captivating Daily Goals with every new gameplay
-Scoring points are credited with every accomplished goal 
-More scoring points get you ahead of your opponents faster 
The Acrostics word puzzle games work as a powerful brain-training machine that you can take with you anywhere You’ll get tons and tons of dazzling logic puzzles to solve under your fingertips, decipher hidden proverbs, learn famous quotes, and more! 
With Acrostics, you will be solving all kinds of mind-boggling crossword puzzles. This brain teaser game will put your logic skills to the test! As you progress, these brain games will get increasingly harder – be careful not to lose track of time completely 
Here are the steps that will help you decipher puzzles faster 
 Start off by looking over the letters and pictograms in the word puzzle
* Start matching letters with corresponding pictograms accordingly
* Insert letters directly into solution dashes
* Keep on filling the empty dashes in the word list
* Use definitions to solve crossword puzzles
* Do the word search, if you’re stuck and just move ahead
* Once you complete 4 daily goals, don’t stop and keep going 
* Finish some additional topics and break into the lead!
* Have fun on every single level of these brain games 
As you work your way through the levels, you will learn the basics of how to follow clues, decipher word cryptograms, and solve a wide variety of mind-blowing brain games. If you have never played crossword games before, just pick a basic level and dive into it. 
Our relaxing logic games will let you focus on 2 things: solving lots of mind-dazzling word cryptograms and boosting your IQ. The Acrostics app is a perfect one to play if you want to train or improve your logic skills without stressing out about timing. You’ll have just a relaxing gameplay experience for sure Acrostics is one of those fun word puzzle apps which is perfect for anyone who loves crossword puzzles!

bluejetty:00038263:ios.description:
The new Official Crystal Palace App has arrived – with a fresh new look and new features, fit for Champions of Europe.
The new App brings together all the latest Eagles news, matchday coverage and video content in one place, plus the introduction of brand-new Palace Stories, making it easier than ever to stay connected to the club you love.
With notifications tailored to your interests and delivered straight to your phone, it’s also the easiest way to keep track of every Palace announcement – including breaking news, ticketing updates and shop offers – as and when they happen.
New features of the Official Crystal Palace App include:
- Complete visual refresh: A new look fit for European champions.
- New & exclusive Palace Stories: Bite-sized videos and content, including behind-the-scenes Moments you won't find anywhere else, and regular rewinds from the Palace archive.
- The new home of Matchday: An enhanced matchday experience, with in-depth stats, interactive features and multimedia coverage. The second-best thing to being there.
- A new and improved Palace TV: Featuring an upgraded video player, enhanced live streaming, and more live streams than ever before on Palace TV+ (Membership or digital subscription required).
- New navigation: Making it easier than ever to find the news that matters to you.
In addition, the new App continues to provide your daily dose of Palace news and features, live match updates, broadcasts and audio commentary (requires Membership or digital subscription).
The access also includes your Palace TV video library, including highlights of every match, and in-depth details of fixtures, results, league tables and more from Palace Men’s, Women’s and Academy teams.
You can also manage your Palace account within the App, allowing you to access your match tickets (and/or Season Ticket) within the Ticket Wallet and gain entry to Selhurst Park using NFC passes.
Download today to make sure you’re the first to receive ticketing news, important updates, and fresh videos and features – tailored to your interests, and delivered straight to your phone.
Up the Palace.
---
Download and use of this app is subject to:
Terms of use:
https://www.cpfc.co.uk/terms-of-use/ 
Policy privacy:
https://www.cpfc.co.uk/cpfc-privacy-policy/
Please note that supporters who already have the Crystal Palace App will need to update the App on their device.

Professional document management for iOS, with bulk rename, backup and sync tasks. Edit your documents in-place, stream your media files and connect to over 20 different network and cloud storage locations.
“Maximize the potential of what
bluejetty:00014093:ios.description:
Professional document management for iOS, with bulk rename, backup and sync tasks. Edit your documents in-place, stream your media files and connect to over 20 different network and cloud storage locations.
“Maximize the potential of what you can do with files on iOS” - Cult of Mac
“FileBrowser remains the best option” - MacStories
Direct and secure file access to your computers, servers and other storage devices on home or company networks.
Core Features
- Access file servers and cloud storage
- View documents and optionally store them for offline viewing
- Present a video, PowerPoint or Keynote direct from the server
- Copy and move between any type of storage, from single files to whole directories
- Bi-directional automatic sync of network folders to your iPad/iPhone
- Backup local files to a network file server or cloud storage
- Integrates with other apps allowing you to edit, save and share files while on the go
- Integrates with your existing infrastructure, including Active Directory
- Integrates with iOS data protection, utilising hardware-based encryption to secure content
- Pro photographer XMP sidecar file support for rating images
- VPN on-demand support for third-party VPN clients
- Supports Microsoft Distributed File System (DFS)
- Requires no additional software on company servers
Office App Integration
- No more duplication of documents between apps
- Launch an Office app to edit a network document in-place
- Changes are automatically saved to the original document
- Scan documents or images direct to multi page PDF
- Automatic colour and perspective correction of scanned documents
MDM Integration
- Centralised distribution of FileBrowser configuration settings
- Enforced security lockdown
- Conform to corporate Mobile Security Policies
- Prevent users from changing local settings
- Selectively override any local configuration setting
- Distribute file server connection details
- Control whether offline viewing/storage is permitted
- Control whether content can be shared
FileBrowser Professional uses the SMB1, SMB2, and SMB3 network access protocols (also known as CIFS or Windows File Sharing) to connect to:
- Macs
- PCs
- NAS drives
- Windows File Servers (including Windows Server Clusters)
Access local storage
- USB Drives
- SD Cards
- Folders of other apps
- iCloud Drive folders of other apps
- iOS Photo Library
You can also connect to the following cloud storage
- Microsoft OneDrive
- Microsoft OneDrive for Business
- Microsoft SharePoint 2013 or later
- Box.com
- Google Drive (including Shared Team Drives)
- Dropbox (including Dropbox for Business)
- Backblaze B2
- Amazon S3
- Nextcloud
- pCloud
- Digital Ocean S3
- FileBase S3
- Google Cloud S3
- iDrive Cloud S3
- Storj S3
- Wasabi S3
- WebDAV servers
- FTP/FTPS servers
- SFTP servers
Unlike other file manager apps, we never gather any of your data. We also don't require you to create an account or register an email address with us.
For fast friendly support please email support@stratospherix.com. We are happy to receive support emails in any language, but are only able to reply in English.

bluejetty:00185162:ios.description:
Turn your player piano or digital piano into a live concert — any song, any time, with no CDs or floppy disks.
PianoStream streams thousands of real piano performances straight to your piano's keys. Pick a station, press play, and your piano plays itself all day long.
NEW IN 5.0
- Gentle on your piano — built-in volume and note-strength limits help protect your player piano
- Suggested volume settings for Yamaha Disklavier ENSPIRE, PianoDisc and QRS
- Completely rebuilt — faster, cleaner, easier
- Help & Support right in the app: questions, bug reports and song requests
- iPad support with landscape mode
MUSIC FOR EVERY MOOD
- Exclusive performances by MauColi The Pianoman and other world-class pianists
- Golden Hits from the '60s, '70s, '80s and '90s
- Modern favorites and chart-toppers
- Classical masterpieces, jazz, pop and more
- Holiday Magic — our Christmas station is unmatched
- Requested Songs — a station built from listener requests worldwide
- Three brand-new songs recorded every Friday
WORKS WITH YOUR PIANO
- Yamaha Disklavier — Wagon Grand, Mark II/III/IV, e3, DKC-850/800, Enspire
- PianoDisc — iQ, CD, Prodigy I & II, PDS-128+, PDS-228
- QRS
- Pianocorder
- Any digital piano or keyboard with MIDI or USB MIDI (Clavinova, Casio and more)
EASY CONNECTION
- Bluetooth MIDI: connect with a wireless MIDI receiver (WIDI Master or Yamaha MD-BT01) for pure solo-piano sound
- Audio: use a Wi-Fi audio receiver (WiiM Mini) or Bluetooth receiver for PianoDisc iQ/CD, analog Disklaviers and Pianocorder
- USB-only keyboards: use a USB-to-host MIDI adapter
YOUR MUSIC, YOUR WAY
- Save favorite songs and stations
- Build your own playlists
- Repeat and Shuffle remember your choice
- Upload your own MIDI and PianoDisc MP3 files
- Fully licensed: ASCAP-licensed, in-house productions and public-domain works
REAL HELP FROM REAL PEOPLE
Our support is the best in the business — just read our reviews. Join our Facebook group to share requests and hear new releases first.
SUBSCRIPTION
Unlock everything with a monthly ($24.99) or yearly ($179.99) plan.
- Payment is charged to your Apple Account at purchase
- Subscriptions renew automatically unless turned off at least 24 hours before the period ends
- Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple Account settings: https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039
Privacy Policy: https://api.balanceiq.com/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://api.balanceiq.com/terms/
Support: https://api.balanceiq.com/support/

Turn your player piano or digital piano into a live concert — any song, any time, with no CDs or floppy disks.

PianoStream streams thousands of real piano performances straight to your piano's keys. Pick a station, press play, and your piano plays itself all day long.

NEW IN 5.0
- Gentle on your piano — built-in volume and note-strength limits help protect your player piano
- Suggested volume settings for Yamaha Disklavier ENSPIRE, PianoDisc and QRS
- Completely rebuilt — faster, cleaner, easier
- Help & Support right in the app: questions, bug reports and song requests
- iPad support with landscape mode

MUSIC FOR EVERY MOOD
- Exclusive performances by MauColi The Pianoman and other world-class pianists
- Golden Hits from the '60s, '70s, '80s and '90s
- Modern favorites and chart-toppers
- Classical masterpieces, jazz, pop and more
- Holiday Magic — our Christmas station is unmatched
- Requested Songs — a station built from listener requests worldwide
- Three brand-new songs recorded every Friday

WORKS WITH YOUR PIANO
- Yamaha Disklavier — Wagon Grand, Mark II/III/IV, e3, DKC-850/800, Enspire
- PianoDisc — iQ, CD, Prodigy I & II, PDS-128+, PDS-228
- QRS
- Pianocorder
- Any digital piano or keyboard with MIDI or USB MIDI (Clavinova, Casio and more)

EASY CONNECTION
- Bluetooth MIDI: connect with a wireless MIDI receiver (WIDI Master or Yamaha MD-BT01) for pure solo-piano sound
- Audio: use a Wi-Fi audio receiver (WiiM Mini) or Bluetooth receiver for PianoDisc iQ/CD, analog Disklaviers and Pianocorder
- USB-only keyboards: use a USB-to-host MIDI adapter

YOUR MUSIC, YOUR WAY
- Save favorite songs and stations
- Build your own playlists
- Repeat and Shuffle remember your choice
- Upload your own MIDI and PianoDisc MP3 files
- Fully licensed: ASCAP-licensed, in-house productions and public-domain works

REAL HELP FROM REAL PEOPLE
Our support is the best in the business — just read our reviews. Join our Facebook group to share requests and hear new releases first.

SUBSCRIPTION
Unlock everything with a monthly ($24.99) or yearly ($179.99) plan.
- Payment is charged to your Apple Account at purchase
- Subscriptions renew automatically unless turned off at least 24 hours before the period ends
- Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple Account settings: https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039

Privacy Policy: https://api.balanceiq.com/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://api.balanceiq.com/terms/
Support: https://api.balanceiq.com/support/

Subscribe today and let your piano play itself!

bluejetty:00043446:ios.summary:
TuneCraft is an AI music generator and AI song maker that helps you create songs with AI in minutes. Turn ideas, lyrics, or images into music with an all-in-one AI music app designed for beginners, creators, and musicians.
AI SONG GENERATO
bluejetty:00043446:ios.description:
TuneCraft is an AI music generator and AI song maker that helps you create songs with AI in minutes. Turn ideas, lyrics, or images into music with an all-in-one AI music app designed for beginners, creators, and musicians.
AI SONG GENERATOR & AI MUSIC MAKER
Describe an idea, write lyrics, or upload an image - and TuneCraft generates complete songs with vocals, melody, and instruments. Create AI-generated music and turn inspiration into tracks in just a few taps.
IMAGE TO SONG - TURN PHOTOS INTO MUSIC
Upload an image and let AI generate a unique song inspired by its mood and atmosphere. Perfect for social media, storytelling, and creative inspiration.
AI LYRICS WRITER
Write from scratch or turn themes into verses with the built-in AI lyrics generator. Use AI to write lyrics and speed up your songwriting workflow.
PRO CREATE - ADVANCED AI MUSIC GENERATION
Take full creative control over your music generation.
• Generate songs from prompts or lyrics
• Rewrite and improve lyrics with AI
• Adjust creativity levels
• Use negative tags to avoid unwanted styles or sounds
• Create refined song variations instantly
Advanced tools for deeper music customization.
AI BEATS MAKER & INSTRUMENTAL GENERATOR
Create high-quality beats and background music instantly:
• AI beat maker
• AI generated beats
• AI instrumental generator
• background music creation
AI VOCALS & VOICE STYLES
Create original songs and AI-powered covers using built-in AI voices or your own voice recordings.
BOOST YOUR TRACKS
Upgrade your existing songs with Boost.
Change:
• vocals
• genre
• mood
• lyrics
• song title
Use AI prompts and advanced controls to remix and improve your tracks.
MUSIC TOOLS FOR EVERY CREATOR
Pro-level music tools:
• AI stem splitter
• AI vocal isolator
• Vocal remover
• Song and vocal splitter
AI MUSIC CLIPS
Upload photos, select a track, and create short music clips for social media and creative content.
SONGWRITING IDEAS & INSPIRATION
Spark creativity with songwriting ideas, lyric prompts, and the “Surprise Me” feature with ready-to-use prompts and lyrics ideas in multiple languages.
CHOOSE YOUR GENRE & MOOD
Generate music in genres like hip-hop, pop, rock, EDM, lo-fi, country, and more. Set the vibe with mood presets like happy, chill, dreamy, energetic, or dark.
YOUR PERSONAL AI MUSIC STUDIO
Save versions, organize ideas, export tracks, and collaborate. Works as a full music maker app, AI music creator, or songwriting app - depending on how deep you want to go.
How to Create a Song With AI:
1. Enter a theme, lyrics, or idea (or tap Surprise Me).
2. Pick a genre, mood, and vocal style.
3. Generate multiple AI song variations and choose your favorite version.
4. Export and save your track.
5. Share your music anywhere.
Free vs Premium
Free: limited access to AI music generation and core creative tools.
Premium: extended access to AI song generation, Pro Create tools, covers, clips, vocals, beats, instrumentals, lyrics editing, and more.
Subscription & Terms
Premium Weekly Subscription includes a 3-day free trial for new subscribers; try all features at no cost.
After the trial, the subscription continues automatically at the weekly price unless canceled at least 24 hours before the trial ends.
Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation and at renewal.
Subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the period.
Manage or cancel anytime in Settings › Apple ID › Subscriptions.
Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase.
Price may vary by region.
Privacy Policy: https://tunecraftapp.com/privacy_policy.html
Terms & Conditions: https://tunecraftapp.com/terms_and_conditions.html

CCSS Móvil es la aplicación de la Caja Costarricense de Seguro Social, que te permitirá tener acceso desde tu dispositivo inteligente a una serie de trámites financieros.
Mediante esta aplicación podrá solicitar el envío de su Orden Patron
bluejetty:00041924:ios.description:
CCSS Móvil es la aplicación de la Caja Costarricense de Seguro Social, que te permitirá tener acceso desde tu dispositivo inteligente a una serie de trámites financieros.
Mediante esta aplicación podrá solicitar el envío de su Orden Patronal Digital a su correo electrónico registrado, solicitar el envío de un Estudio de Salarios y/o Ingresos del último año a su correo electrónico, consultar la proyección de su pensión del Régimen de Invalidez, Vejez y Muerte, consultar el estado de sus boletas de incapacidad registradas durante el último año, o pagar sus facturas como patrono, trabajador independiente o asegurado voluntario.
Asimismo, la aplicación se mantiene en continua mejora, con la finalidad de agregar nuevas funcionalidades.
¿Qué se requiere para poder utilizar la App?
Se requiere una cuenta que puede ser creada directamente en la App por medio de la opción “Regístrese aquí” que se encuentra en la pantalla inicial o bien, realizar el mismo proceso en la página de la Oficina Virtual CCSS disponible en la web Institucional (www.ccss.sa.cr).
Quienes ya posean una cuenta para utilizar la Oficina Virtual CCSS, podrán utilizar esa misma cuenta para el App.
¿Qué se requiere para crear una cuenta?
El App podrá ser utilizado por todas aquellas personas que tengan una cuenta de acceso a la Oficina Virtual CCSS. De no tener una cuenta registrada, podrán solicitar el acceso en cualquier sucursal de la CCSS o accediendo aquí. 
¿Mis datos pueden ser vistos por otras personas desde el App sin autorización?
Sus datos solo pueden ser vistos en el App haciendo uso de la respectiva cuenta de usuario y su contraseña, razón por la cual, usted debe velar por la privacidad de su contraseña y no facilitarla a nadie.

bluejetty:00095814:ios.description:
Weighing AI: Smart Weight Estimator
Turn your iPhone into a smart digital scale for food, kitchen, postal packages, jewelry, coffee, and even baby items. Take a photo of any object and get instant weight estimates in grams, ounces, pounds or kilograms, powered by advanced artificial intelligence.
Whether you need a quick weight scale for everyday items or a precise digital scale for your kitchen, Weighing AI delivers accurate results in seconds. Unlike traditional digital scales that require physical contact, our scale app uses cutting-edge AI to analyze visual cues and provide reliable weight measurements anywhere, anytime.
Perfect for:
 • Weighing food portions for diets, calories, and meal prep
 • Estimating package weight before shipping (postal & parcel)
 • Measuring jewelry, gold, and small precious items
 • Coffee brewing ratios and recipe portions
 • Checking produce at the market
 • Baby items and small objects when no scale is around
Key Features:
 • Instant weight estimation from photos, no contact needed
 • Supports grams, ounces, pounds, kilograms, milligrams
 • Save and track your weighing history
 • Works with any object: food, packages, jewelry, coffee, gold
 • No calibration or setup required
 • Available in 26 languages
Weighing AI transforms your phone into the ultimate portable scale. Whether you're looking for a food scale, postal scale, kitchen scale, jewelry scale, or general-purpose weight measurement tool, our AI-powered technology delivers when you need it most.
Try it free today and discover why thousands trust Weighing AI as their go-to digital scale app for accurate, convenient weight measurements anywhere, anytime.

bluejetty:00131050:ios.description:
Cleanup - Storage Cleaner is a mobile app designed to help users keep their devices clean and optimized. The app serves as a phone cleaner, storage cleaner, providing users with the ability to clean up unnecessary files and free up valuable storage space.
The application offers four main functions, including cleaning photos, videos, contacts, and calendars:
1. The photo cleaner function enables users to identify and delete unwanted photos, screenshots, and other image files that are taking up valuable storage space.
2. With the video cleaner, users can easily identify and delete unnecessary video clips and recordings.
3. The contact cleaner function helps users to clean up their contact list by identifying and removing duplicate entries, outdated information, and other unnecessary data.
4. The calendar cleaner function assists users in cleaning up their schedule by deleting old appointments and events that are no longer relevant.
5. Photo and video compression. Compress your photo or video files to optimal size quickly and easily.
Phone Cleaner offers several benefits to its users. With its user-friendly interface and powerful cleaning capabilities, Cleaner Pro makes it easy for users to free up storage space.
In summary, Phone Cleaner is an excellent mobile application for anyone who wants to keep their iOS device clean, organized, and performing at its best. With its powerful cleaning functions and easy-to-use interface, users can easily clean up unnecessary files and free up valuable storage space. Whether you're an avid photographer, a video enthusiast, or simply looking to keep your contact list and calendar organized, Cleaner Pro is the perfect app for you.

bluejetty:00162913:ios.description:
YeoTi - Korean Dermatology & Plastic Surgery App, Trusted by 6 Million!
Discover the ultimate all-in-one solution for Korean beauty treatments—no language barriers. 
View real reviews, compare prices, and book consultations in the app!
Real Reviews, Real Experiences
Access over 1.8 million verified reviews from users who have undergone treatments, with 30,000 new reviews added monthly. 
Reviews cover everything from quick treatments like Inmode and peeling to complex procedures like jaw surgery, rhinoplasty, and other plastic surgery options.
YeoTi offers transparent insights to help you choose confidently.
Discover Your Skin, Just for You
Select your skin type, concerns, and preferences to receive a personalized report tailored to your needs.
Have questions? Enjoy the ease of consulting with clinics in English directly through the app!
AI Skin Analysis helps you understand your skin condition, skin age, and key concerns through a simple selfie.
Receive a personalized report based on the analysis.
Transparent Pricing
No extra charges for global users—you pay the same as locals. 
Your treatment cost is confirmed upfront, with no surprises on the day of your visit.
Book, Pay and Earn Rewards
Book consultations and treatments directly in the app.
Complete payment in-app after your clinic visit.
Earn points on qualifying payments and apply them to future bookings.
Safety Care for Greater Peace of Mind
YeoTi provides a Safety Care service designed to help users feel more confident when receiving treatments in Korea.
Eligible users may receive support related to unexpected treatment side effects.
Enjoy K-Shopping Rewards
Get treatments in Korea and earn shopping vouchers worth 5% of your treatment cost.
Enjoy additional rewards while exploring Korea and K-Beauty.
Popular Categories
"Inmode," "oligio," "laser," "peeling," "surgery," "plastic surgery," "facial contouring," and more.
[Optional Access Permissions]
Location: Used to find medical treatment clinics near your current location.
Notification: Used to receive new updates on medical treatment promotions, discounts, and announcements.
Camera: Used to capture photos for skin analysis and reviews, and to record consultation videos.
Photos: Used to upload and save photos.
Microphone: Used to record consultation videos and verify foreign users' passports.
※ Optional access permissions do not affect service usage — you can still use the service normally even if you don't agree to them.
※ You can grant or withdraw these permissions anytime in [Phone Settings > Applications > YeoTi > App Permissions].

▶ YouTube : https://www.youtube.com/@yeoshinticket
▶ Instagram : https://www.instagram.com/yeoti_official

bluejetty:00141352:ios.description:
Hello there!
Chameleon is a fun, engaging, social deduction game that you can play with anyone.
Each player will get a word and a topic but the Chameleon will not know the word, while the Salamander will get a different word.
Everyone will go around and say a description for the word. For example, if the topic is Foods and the word is Burrito, a Player can say "Wrap”.
After everyone says their description, the group decides who they think the Chameleon or Salamander is for elimination!
Find the Chameleon(s) and Salamander(s) before the Players eliminate each other!
This is your moment to manifest your inner Sherlock as a Player, show your cunning, adaptive social Chameleon as a Chameleon, and embrace your deceptive mimicry as a Salamander!
Also, when playing, you don't have to stick to the confines of the topic for any of the descriptions; you can add in some wordplay, nuances, inside jokes, and even be a troll...think outside the box!
Let the games begin!
This game can be played locally and online; playing locally allows for more clues from the non-verbal cues and subtle behaviors while online doesn't require physical presence. There is an additional Moderator mode, where a human Moderator can give out custom words and topics and facilitate the game.
For Local and Moderator modes, everyone can either download the app or share the same device to play; the former would allow the players to have the topic/words on each of their devices while the latter method would allow for a fully offline gameplay.
Feel free to play this game with friends, family, colleagues, strangers or any social circle/groups at gatherings, reunions, kickbacks, events, vacations, parties, and more!
Anytime, anywhere with anyone.
In times when you need help breaking the ice, want to know more about each other, or have run out of things to talk about, Chameleon is there for you.

bluejetty:00115274:ios.description:
Built for women navigating perimenopause and menopause, Menovation is your all-in-one wellness app for this transformative life stage. Whether you’re dealing with energy crashes, sleep disruptions, hot flashes, weight gain, or emotional overwhelm—Menovation meets you where you are and helps you move forward with strength, grace, and science-backed tools.
With your required subscription, you receive:
- Unlimited access to all workout programs
- 200+ workouts (strength, Pilates, barre, yoga)
- Video tutorials and follow along workouts 
- Perimenopause cycle and symptom tracking 
- Menopause physician health and lifestyle tips
- Comprehensive nutrition lessons & 160+ recipes
Why Menovation Works:
Movement That Meets Your Hormones
What worked in your 20s and 30s doesn't work for the midlife woman. Your workouts need to support your hormones. These menopause workouts focus on strength, pelvic health, bone density improvement, balance, and more. 
- 36 Pilates classes
- 33 Yoga classes
- 5 Yoga Nidra classes for deep rest
- 18 Barre classes
- 58 Follow-along strength workouts
- 50 Self-paced strength workouts with exercise swaps
- 5 Core Basics classes for safe foundational movement
Nutrition Without the Nonsense
- 160+ balanced recipes designed for midlife metabolism
- 30 Nutrition lessons on key hormonal health concepts
- 30 Nutrition challenges to help you build sustainable habits
- Grocery guide for hormone-supportive shopping
Mind-Body Insight & Empowerment
- 87 expert health tips focused on midlife wellness
- 11 Professional interviews with doctors, nutrition coaches, and pelvic health physical therapists
- Symptom tracking and cycle insights
- Progress photos and non-scale victory logging
Stay On Track—Your Way
- Workout tracking
- Progress monitoring with real data
- Personalized motivation through goal-based tracking

From the living room to the bedroom, from the kitchen to the bathroom, your home design decisions will shape the look and feel of each space.

Whether you prefer a modern, minimalist look or a cozy, rustic ambiance, "My Story Mansion: House Design" offers endless possibilities to express your creativity.
But what sets "My Story Mansion: House Design" apart in the home design game genre is its commitment to community and sharing. Connect with fellow players, share your home design masterpieces, and gather inspiration from others. Participate in home design challenges, vote on the best-decorated rooms, and climb the leaderboards to become a renowned home designer.
Regular updates keep the game fresh and exciting, introducing new rooms to decorate, new match-3 puzzles to solve, and new stories to unfold. The world of "My Story Mansion: House Design" is ever-evolving, ensuring that your home design journey is endless and ever-engaging.
In "My Story Mansion: House Design," your passion for home design is celebrated and nurtured. With every match-3 puzzle solved, every room decorated, and every story unfolded, you're not just playing a game; you're embarking on a journey of creativity, storytelling, and community.
So, are you ready to match, design, and transform? "My Story Mansion: House Design" awaits your touch to turn a house into a home, a space into a sanctuary, and a game into an experience. Join the adventure and leave your mark in the world of home design!
Remember, in "My Story Mansion: House Design," every match is a step toward creating your dream home. Every design choice paints a picture of your unique style. And every room you decorate brings you closer to becoming a master of home design. Let your creativity run wild, make bold choices, and transform spaces in ways only you can imagine. Welcome to "My Story Mansion: House Design," where your home design journey begins and your match-3 adventure awaits!

日语五十音图APP，一款小而美的日语学习助手，对日语初学者很友好。
由早道教育打造，拥有独特的AI发音打分，为不同基础的日语学习者，提供便利测试日语发音的条件。
在这里，你可以学习假名发音、日语单词、异国文化、学习方法等，还可以进行测试练习，趣味复习，多维度学习日语。
- 什么人适合学日语？
热爱日漫日剧、喜欢追番看生肉，想学日语发音、日语翻译；
想跟喜爱的明星声优说同一种语言、演唱会见面会能听懂日语；
想去旅游看樱花、玩日语游戏；
想要多学一门语言，多一个技能等等；
——主要功能——
【日语学习】
- 学习卡片：听说读写练测，多维度学日语。
- 真人发音：学原汁原味的日语，给去旅游看樱花、旅游日语、追日剧日漫、日语考研、日语听力、日语翻译打基础。
- 手写日语：动态笔顺、假名描红，学习日语50音基础。
- 联想记忆法：趣味日语小口诀、中日汉语联想图。
- 视频教程：详细讲解日语发音口型技巧。
- 闯关模式：把握学习节奏，打牢日语基础。
【日语练习】
- AI练习发音：假名、日语单词、美句日语发音。
- 假名小游戏：假名连连看、拼图小游戏，让你边玩边学日语。
- 假名复习：完整的五十音图表，智能复习提醒。
【日语测验】
- 假名测试：配套题库测验，巩固日语学习。
- 阶段测验：检验日语学习成果。
【知识拓展】
- 日语圈：定期更新日语入门技巧、日语学习难点、日语单词、日语词典、日语翻译、日语输入法、日语语法、标准日语等干货段子。

bluejetty:00144609:ios.summary: O Salão 365 é um aplicativo de gestão para serviços de beleza, criado para ajudar profissionais a organizar atendimentos, gerenciar clientes e organizar as finanças. Com uma interface simples e prática, o app permite controlar sua rotina de
bluejetty:00144609:ios.description:
O Salão 365 é um aplicativo de gestão para serviços de beleza, criado para ajudar profissionais a organizar atendimentos, gerenciar clientes e organizar as finanças. Com uma interface simples e prática, o app permite controlar sua rotina de serviços, manter sua agenda de clientes sempre atualizada e oferecer uma experiência mais profissional para quem faz serviços com você.
Com o aplicativo, você pode registrar agendamentos rapidamente, visualizar sua agenda de salão de forma clara e evitar conflitos de horário. O aplicativo também permite compartilhar um link de agendamento online, para que seus clientes escolham serviços e horários disponíveis sem precisar trocar várias mensagens. Assim, novos agendamentos entram automaticamente na sua agenda, economizando tempo no dia a dia.
Além da organização dos horários, o app ajuda a manter um cadastro de clientes com histórico de atendimentos e informações importantes, facilitando o acompanhamento de quem frequenta seu salão ou barbearia. Isso torna o atendimento mais personalizado e ajuda a fortalecer o relacionamento com os clientes.
O Salão 365 foi pensado para profissionais que precisam de uma agenda digital, uma solução de gestão de clientes e um maior controle do faturamento e das despesas. É ideal para cabeleireiros, barbeiros, manicures, esteticistas e outros profissionais de beleza que desejam mais organização e praticidade na rotina de atendimentos.
Sua gestão na palma da mão!
Caso tenha dúvidas entre em contato conosco pelo email de suporte dev@ideia4it.co.
Termos de uso: https://app.salao365.com/terms

bluejetty:00063861:ios.description:
Get the latest Pennsylvania lottery results within minutes of the draws taking place. This easy-to-use app includes the following lotteries:
- Match 6
- Powerball (including Double Play)
- Mega Millions
- Powerball Xs & Os
- Millionaire for Life
- Cash Pop
- Cash 5
- Pick 5
- Pick 4
- Pick 3
- Pick 2
- Treasure Hunt
Match 6, Powerball, Mega Millions, Powerball Xs & Os, Millionaire for Life, Cash 5 and Treasure Hunt also include a full breakdown displaying the number of winners and amount paid out for each prize level.
The following features are also included:
Ticket Checker
----------------------------
Enter and save your chosen numbers to see if you have won or to see how often they have come up in the past. You can also label your tickets – great if you play multiple lines or if you run a syndicate. The ticket checker also highlights prizes won on each ticket as well as calculating the total for each lottery. Only play lotteries on certain days of the week? Not a problem, you can exclude your checked tickets from draws you do not play.
Customizable Notifications
----------------------------
Get notified instantly when the latest lottery results and prize breakdowns become available. The App allows you to customise notifications for specific lottery games and you can also choose which days of the week you play. Want to know when the jackpot has rolled over or has reached a certain amount? Just head to the Notification section of the app to set up your alerts. There is also the option to set notifications at times that suit you - great for reminding you to purchase tickets before the draw.
Random Number Generator
-----------------------------
Stuck for numbers? Use this handy tool and let the app choose your numbers rather than having to rely on house numbers and anniversary dates!
Results Archive
----------------------------
Access to the full archive of results dating back to the first draw of each lottery.
Settings
----------------------------
Customise which lotteries display in the app and in which order.
Support
----------------------------
If you have any feedback or suggestions on how we can improve this app, please get in touch at contact@lottery.net.

bluejetty:00141997:ios.description:
Translate text, voice, and camera content in 143+ languages including English, Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Chinese, Korean, and Arabic.
Break language barriers with Translate AI - Live Translator, your all-in-one AI translator for text, voice, camera, photo, live conversations, and more.
Whether you're traveling, working internationally, studying, or communicating across languages, Translate AI delivers fast, natural translations powered by advanced AI models for accurate, context-aware results.
▶ How can I translate live conversations instantly?
Have natural two-way conversations with real-time AI voice translation. Speak, listen, and communicate effortlessly in 143+ languages; perfect for travel, meetings, and everyday conversations.
▶ How can I translate photos and live camera content?
Snap a photo or point your camera to translate menus, signs, documents, labels, and other printed text instantly. Use Photo Translator for captured images or Camera Translator for live translation in real time.
▶ How can I translate text via translator keyboard?
Translate while you type with a real-time translator keyboard. Use it in chat apps, email, browsers, and social media. Instantly output translated text and improve writing with built-in grammar correction.
▶ How many languages does Translate AI support?
Translate AI supports 143+ languages for text, voice, camera, and live conversations, including English, Spanish, Chinese, Japanese, French, German, Korean, Arabic, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Turkish, and many more.
▶ How do I translate text in seconds?
Translate messages, emails, documents, websites, and more with fast, accurate AI-powered text translation.
▶ Can I translate content from other apps?
Translate supported content instantly using the Share Extension without leaving your current app.
▶ Can I use earbuds for live translation?
Use compatible earbuds for seamless hands-free live translation during conversations, meetings, and travel. Listen to translated speech naturally while speaking face to face.
▶ Can I customize translated speech?
Choose different voices, adjust speaking speed, and personalize text-to-speech playback for a more natural listening experience.
BUILT FOR TRAVEL & EVERYDAY COMMUNICATION
▶ How can Photo Translator help while traveling?
Use Photo Translator to translate menus, signs, tickets, labels, and travel documents in seconds. Snap a photo whenever you need quick, clear translations on the go.
▶ Can I translate without internet?
Download languages and use Offline Translator whenever you're offline. Perfect for flights, international travel, and areas with limited connectivity.
EXTRA FEATURES
▶ PDF & Document Translator
Translate complete PDFs and documents while preserving readability.
▶ Video Subtitle Generator
Generate subtitles automatically from spoken audio and make your videos more accessible.
WHY CHOOSE TRANSLATE AI?
• AI Translator for Text & Voice
• Live Camera & Photo Translator
• Live Conversation Translator
• Hands-Free Translation with Earbuds
• Live Translation on Apple Watch
• Translator Keyboard with Grammar Correction
• Offline Translator for Travel
• Share Extension
• PDF & Document Translator
• Video Subtitle Generator
PERFECT FOR
• Travel
• Business
• Language learning
• Daily conversations
Download Translate AI - Live Translator today.
SUBSCRIPTION
Some features require a premium subscription. Payment will be charged to your Apple ID Account upon purchase confirmation. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your Apple ID Account Settings. Any unused portion of a free trial will be forfeited upon subscription purchase.

Questions or feedback? We'd love to hear from you.

The Psychic Source app is the only psychic app you’ll ever need. 
• Download and Install the App Today
• The Best Psychic Readings for Over 35 Years
At Psychic Source, we have an Advisor to meet your individualized needs. For over 35 years we have been providing safe, professional, and accurate psychic services through phone, online chat, and video readings. Whether you are looking for a medium, empath, tarot card reader, astrologer, or other psychic specialty, you’ll find more than 250 gifted psychic advisors to choose from. 
• Satisfaction Guaranteed 
Our meticulously screened network of authentic advisors provides supportive listening and insightful guidance to customers worldwide, 24/7. Our service is distinguished by the high quality of our advisors and our Customer Care Specialists who ensure that every experience at Psychic Source is safe, straight forward and satisfying. With our no-risk satisfaction guarantee you can be assured that if you’re not happy with your last paid psychic reading, it’s free. 
An App to Make Your Psychic Source Experience Easier 
For current customers, the Psychic Source app makes getting a psychic reading easier than ever. Download the app to browse available advisors and get a live psychic reading anytime, anywhere. Mini readings is great for those times when you have a quick question. You can opt to receive timely notifications sent directly to your mobile device including: 
• Your position in advisor queues and availability to receive return calls. 
• When your favorite advisors are available. 
• When an advisor has sent you a message. 
• Reminders of upcoming appointments.
In addition to receiving notifications, the app makes it quick and easy for you to manage your availability to accept return calls, view appointment reminders, and take advantage of special offers and promotions. You can always view your favorite advisors’ current availability, and it makes it easier than ever to join or manage your membership rewards. 
All app users receive Free Insights including tarot card readings and personalized horoscopes. You can also access all the Psychic Source content available, including articles by your favorite advisors, infographics, podcasts, videos and more. You can even share content right from the app with friends. 
• Download and Install the App Today 
Live psychic readings, real-time notifications, free insights, daily horoscopes, psychic content, and the answers you seek are waiting. A smoother, faster, life-changing experience is just a download away. Are you ready?

bluejetty:00063627:ios.description:
Tarot Lenormand Love – Discover What the Cards Reveal About Your Heart
Step into a world of mystery, intuition, and guidance with Tarot Lenormand Love. This beautifully hand-drawn deck was created especially to help you explore the questions of the heart—whether you are searching for new love, wondering about a partner’s feelings, or seeking clarity in a relationship.
Let the cards whisper their secrets to you.
Love often leaves us with doubts and questions. Should I open my heart to someone new? Will this relationship grow stronger? Am I truly ready for love? With Tarot Lenormand Love, you can find direction, comfort, and insight into all stages of romance.
Why Tarot Lenormand Love?
 • Clarity for the heart – Every spread is designed to illuminate aspects of your relationships, from fleeting flirtations to deep soul connections.
 • Guidance in love’s crossroads – Unsure about a partner, an ex, or whether to start anew? The cards can shed light on hidden truths.
 • Daily inspiration – Draw your Card of the Day to stay in tune with the energies of love surrounding you.
 • A personal journal of your journey – Save your readings, revisit them, and watch how your story unfolds over time.
21 Love-Focused Spreads
From the quick answer you need in the moment to in-depth explorations of your most profound connections, Tarot Lenormand Love offers spreads such as:
 • Quick Question – When you need an instant insight.
 • Light Flirtation – For the spark of new beginnings.
 • In Search of Love – Guidance for finding the right path.
 • Soul Mate – A glimpse into destined connections.
 • The Ex Partner – Understanding lessons of the past.
 • Are You Ready for Love – Discover if your heart is open for what lies ahead.
Unlock Deeper Insights
For those who wish to dive even further, Advanced Relationship and Advanced Partner Analysis spreads are available through subscription. These powerful tools help you gain profound understanding of your current relationship or the potential with someone new.
A Mystic Companion, Always With You
Whether you’re feeling uncertain, hopeful, or simply curious, your personal deck of Lenormand cards is always ready. Every drawing is crafted with care and carries a touch of the mystical, guiding you gently toward clarity.
------
Subscriptions
Some features, including Advanced Relationship & Partner Analysis, require a subscription. Subscriptions can be managed in your iTunes account after purchase.
-----
Terms & Privacy
We value your trust and privacy. Please review our terms:
Privacy Policy: https://lenormand-love.firebaseapp.com/privacy.html
Terms and Conditions: https://lenormand-love.firebaseapp.com/terms.html
------
The cards are waiting. Are you ready to ask?

bluejetty:00148951:ios.description:
Peter Blackheart was pierced with a harpoon. Scotland Yard blames Oscar's friend. Play this hidden object game and investigate the thrilling crime!
Will you manage to uncover the mystery of Ms. Holmes 7: The Death of Peter Blackheart? Test yourself in solving engaging puzzles, explore unusual locations and learn all secrets of the old captain’s murder. You have a great opportunity to learn what surprises the victim’s grim and lonely house prepared for Sharlotte.
Note that this is a free trial version of the hidden objects game.
You can get the full version by means of an in-app purchase.
Oscar Watson and Sharlotte Holmes's quiet evening is interrupted by an unexpected guest - Harold Kern, accused of murdering Captain Peter Blackheart. All the evidence points against him, but Sharlotte doubts the guilt of Oscar's school friend. To save an innocent person, she has to solve a mystery that has too many inconsistencies. Who could hate the old captain so much that they pinned him to the wall with a harpoon? Maybe the treasure that the victim found shortly before his death is to blame? And why is there so little blood at the murder scene?
FIND OUT WHO KILLED PETER BLACKHEART.
Why did what happened happen? An exciting plot that will be enjoyed by fans of unsolved mysteries games and mystery detective games. 
WHY IS OSCAR WATSON'S SCHOOL FRIEND ACCUSED OF MURDER? 
Help prove the innocence of Watson's friend Harold Kern! Solve engaging puzzles and complete fun mini-games to find out why Scotland Yard is confident in the guilt of the sick boatswain.
FIND OUT IF YOU CAN FIND THE REAL MURDERER AND SURVIVE
Investigate this complicated case to find out who is responsible for this terrible crime! Complete engaging HO scenes and feel the thrill caused by the unexpected plot twists.
FIND OUT WHAT HAPPENED TO SHARLOTTE HOLMES IN THE BONUS CHAPTER!
Help Sharlotte Holmes figure out where the blue carbuncle and the rest of the treasures have gone and enjoy the bonuses of Collector’s Edition! Earn a variety of unique achievements! Tons of collectibles and puzzle pieces to find!
Ms. Holmes 7: The Death of Peter Blackheart is one of the hidden object games where you seek and find hidden items like Sherlock Holmes. Be a detective, investigate the crime, and find out who the murderer is!
Enjoy replayable HOPs and mini-games, exclusive wallpapers, soundtrack, concept art, and more!
Zoom in on the scenes to help find all hidden objects, and use clues if you get stuck.

bluejetty:00186115:ios.description:
Experience TouchChat® Discover, the new, risk-free way to try all the features of the popular TouchChat app before you buy. After downloading, you’ll have the option to start a free 30-day trial OR to explore the WordPower96 English and Spanish lite-tech boards. 
TouchChat is a full-featured Augmentative and Alternative Communication (AAC) solution for individuals who have difficulty using their natural voice. TouchChat is designed for individuals with Autism, Down Syndrome, ALS, apraxia, stroke, or other conditions that affect a person's ability to use natural speech.
TouchChat gives an individual the ability to choose a vocabulary file which consists of pages and buttons that contain words, phrases, sentences, and other functions. Messages are spoken with a built-in voice synthesizer or by playing a recorded message. Various synthesized and custom voice options are available, allowing the user to choose a voice that fits their own personality.
After your 30-day trial ends, you’ll have the option to purchase TouchChat HD w/WordPower®, TouchChat HD, or TouchChat HD Lite. If you don’t make a purchase, you’ll still have access to the WordPower96 English and Spanish lite-tech boards when your trial period ends. 
TouchChat provides multiple language options in a universal app supporting iPhone®, iPod touch® and iPad®.

bluejetty:00154093:ios.description:
Help Anna and Richard deal with the ghosts of the past! 
Play a new hidden object game, solve unique puzzles and dark mysteries!
________________________________________________________________________
Will you manage to unravel the mystery of Grim Tales 26: Prisoners of the Past? Test yourself in solving engaging puzzles, explore unusual locations and learn all secrets of a mysterious person stuck in an asylum. 
Anna Gray receives an anonymous letter asking her to save her stepbrother Thomas who is imprisoned in an asylum. Anna discovers that Thomas Gray was imprisoned there by her late father Richard. Anna has to get the asylum and uncover all the secrets of the mysterious prisoner.
Note that this is a free trial version of the hidden objects game.
You can get the full walkthrough by means of an in-app purchase.
FIND OUT WHY THOMAS ENDED UP IN THE ASYLUM
Why did Richard have to put his stepson in a mental clinic and had to imprison him there? An exciting plot that will be enjoyed by fans of hidden mysteries games and detective games.
LEARN THE TRUTH ABOUT THE PRISONERS OF THE CLINIC 
Solve engaging puzzles and complete fun mini-games to find out why the strange events happen in the asylum and who causes them to happen, and how your late father Richard is related to them.
WILL YOU MAKE IT OUT ALIVE AND SAVE YOUR BROTHER?
Complete engaging HO scenes and feel the thrill caused by the unexpected plot twists. Find missing objects, artifacts, and hidden items!
FIND OUT WHAT HAPPENED TO RICHARD GRAY IN THE BONUS CHAPTER!
Play as Richard and enjoy the bonuses of Collector’s Edition! Earn a variety of unique achievements! Tons of collectibles and puzzle pieces to find! Enjoy replayable HOPs and mini-games, exclusive wallpapers, soundtrack, concept art, and more!
Grim Tales 26: Prisoners of the Past is a mystery detective game where you need to search and find all hidden objects like a detective. Embark on an adventure and find out what surprise this crazy place has in store for Anna Grey. Uncover the mysteries and learn all the secrets of the mystical adventure!
Enjoy replayable HOPs and mini-games, exclusive wallpapers, soundtrack, concept art, and more!
Zoom in on the scenes to help find all hidden objects, and use clues if you get stuck.

bluejetty:00175835:ios.name: Next Up - Interval Timer
bluejetty:00175835:ios.summary:
Customize Your Intervals, Your Way
A fully customizable interval timer:
Create your intervals. Specify reps, sets, colours and sounds. Tailor it to your purpose and needs. Minimal design and easy to use. Options for rep-based intervals and
bluejetty:00175835:ios.description:
Customize Your Intervals, Your Way
A fully customizable interval timer:
Create your intervals. Specify reps, sets, colours and sounds. Tailor it to your purpose and needs. Minimal design and easy to use. Options for rep-based intervals and images.
Display options:
Choose to run your timer in a detailed view that auto-scrolls through intervals or a full-screen mode for a larger, easily visible display. Both modes support portrait and landscape orientations.
Visual details:
In detailed view, running intervals and sets are highlighted, providing a clear visual cue. For intervals with multiple reps, the highlighted area indicates the percentage completed. Set optional background colours on intervals for a visual cue. Light and dark mode versions are available and will adapt to your preferences set on your device.
Quick actions:
Set an interim interval that will automatically be added between intervals. Optionally, end your timer with the interim interval. Skip or backtrack through intervals using intuitive arrow buttons. Swipe actions allow for easy deletion and duplication of intervals and sets.
---
Interval Timer features:
• Interval timers:
Create timers with unlimited intervals.
• Description, Length, and Reps:
Set the details of each interval, customizing it to your precise requirements.
• Interim Intervals:
Quickly set up timers by adding interim intervals that run between each interval.
• Interval Sets:
Group intervals into sets and specify the desired number of set reps.
• Interval Customization:
Differentiate intervals with background colors.
• Time Display:
View countdown of each interval and total remaining time, with an option to display total elapsed time.
• Progress and Highlighting:
View progress with highlighted current intervals and reps completed.
• Start from Any Interval:
Choose which interval to start the timer from, providing maximum control.
• User-friendly Actions:
Effortlessly manage intervals with swipe actions for deletion and duplication. Duplicate button allows for easy copying of intervals, sets, and timers. Arrow buttons enable smooth navigation between intervals.
• Background Notifications:
Run timers in the background and receive alerts for interval changes and timer completion.
• Organize with Folders:
Create folders to organize and easily access your timers.
• Orientation and Display:
Enjoy portrait and landscape orientations, and full-screen mode for a larger timer display.
• Light and Dark Mode:
Seamlessly switch between light and dark mode to suit your preference.
Upgrade features include:
• Unlimited timers:
Create as many timers as you like.
• Sound Options:
Enable countdown beeps, set interval/timer sounds, and/or enable text to speech.
• Rep-based Intervals:
Option to create intervals based on reps instead of time to offer maximum flexibility.
• More Interval Customization:
Differentiate intervals with images/photos and sounds.
• Edit received timers:
Flexibility to modify all timers.
Subscription - syncing and sharing timers:
• Sync and Share:
Sync timers across devices and choose to share timers and folders with other users. Sharing via email includes a direct download link and instructions.
---
Privacy Policy: https://alysha.dev/interval-timer-privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://alysha.dev/interval-timer-terms-of-use

bluejetty:00027385:ios.description:
Awarded “Best App”, Journal is any designers’ dream software. Called “The Future of Sketching” by ArchDaily and “Magic” by Design Milk, Journal combines your dream set of tools with the ability to sketch, write or design anywhere. Welcome to the future of sketchbooks.
WRITE, SKETCH, COLLECT
Never lose an idea again. Whether you sketch daily or occasionally, inspiration strikes us all at the most unexpected moments. Journal allows you to effortlessly record, organize, sketch and brainstorm ideas along with photos, images or text to capture and develop your most important thoughts. With a powerful array of high quality drawing and writing tools including pens, pencils and paint, Morpholio Journal is ideal for designers, architects, photographers, artists, travelers, or members of any creative culture. Its unique book interface affords instant and easy navigation of thousands of pages unlocking infinite potential. Finally, you can keep track of everything you encounter, and find new ways to visualize, test, and explore the world around you.
WHAT YOU CAN DO WITH JOURNAL:
DRAW: Sketch, doodle or scribble pictures
ORGANIZE: Notes, events, and lists
DESIGN: Explore, create and brainstorm ideas
CAPTURE: Travel inspiration and moments anywhere
WRITE: Record thoughts, and annotate images
JOURNAL FEATURES: 
SKETCH: Draw on paper, images or notes
PENS: From precision to markers
BRUSHES: Powerful tools for artists
BOOKS: Create and name multiple Journals
PRIVACY: Log in and out to protect work
FLIP: Quick visual browsing
COLOR: Custom pen palettes for multiple uses 
NOTES: Colorful paper markers
INIFNITY: Create thousands of pages
PAPER: Various templates and types 
TEXT: Label or write in different fonts
SIMPLE: User friendly, clean interface 
IMPORT: From photos, camera and more
PROFILE: Create a personal profile 
SHARE: Effortlessly send or post 
PEOPLE USING JOURNAL:
Architects, Interior Designers, Fashion Designers, Photographers, Event Planners, Graphic Designers, Landscape Architects, Artists, Industrial designers, Tattoo Artists, Web Designers, Professors, Students, Advertising Professionals, Web Designers, Developers & Real-Estate Professionals, Retailers, Teachers, Students, Kids and many more.
Morpholio JournalPro subscription plans are available in the following options: 
•JournalPro monthly for $0.99
•JournalPro annually for $3.99
Subscriptions will be charged to your credit card through your iTunes account. Subscriptions are automatically renewed unless cancelled at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. You will not be able to cancel a subscription during the active period. Manage your subscriptions in your Account Settings after purchase.
Privacy policy: http://www.morpholioapps.com/privacy/
Terms of use: http://www.morpholioapps.com/terms/
We would be thrilled to have Morpholio Journal become a part of your creative process. We hope you enjoy Journal and if there are any specific ways it could be improved for your use, please send us your feedback.

Turn your ideas into AI-generated art, photos, and videos with DaVinci! Enter a prompt, explore different art styles, and create visual content with AI-powered tools.
DaVinci is an AI Photo and Video Maker that helps you turn text prompts and images into digital artwork, photos, and videos. From creative illustrations and AI avatars to tattoo designs, logos, and signatures, DaVinci offers a variety of tools to explore your imagination.
WHAT CAN YOU CREATE WITH DAVINCI?
• AI-generated artwork and illustrations
• AI photos and images
• AI-generated videos
• Tattoo designs
• Signature designs
• Logo concepts
• Personalized AI avatars
• Digital artwork for your home
...and more!
EXPLORE DAVINCI'S FEATURES
AI Art Generator
Turn your ideas into AI-generated artwork. Enter a text prompt or upload an image to create digital illustrations, artistic designs, and creative visuals using AI.
Explore Different Art Styles
Choose from a variety of available art styles, including pencil sketches, digital illustrations, and realistic-looking imagery. Experiment with different styles to find the one that best represents your vision.
AI Photo Generator
Create AI-generated photos and images from text descriptions. Explore different subjects, settings, and visual styles to turn your ideas into detailed images.
AI Video Generator
Bring your ideas to life with AI-generated videos. Use text prompts to describe a scene or upload an image to explore image-to-video creation. DaVinci's AI Video Maker helps you create visual content using AI-powered video generation tools.
AI Tattoo Generator
Explore tattoo ideas with DaVinci's AI Tattoo Generator. Describe your concept and generate tattoo designs inspired by different artistic styles. Experiment with various themes and creative approaches.
Signature Generator
Explore personalized signature designs with DaVinci's AI Signature Generator. Experiment with different lettering styles and create decorative signature artwork.
Logo Generator
Generate logo concepts with DaVinci's AI Logo Generator. Enter your ideas and explore AI-generated logo designs in different visual styles.
AI Avatar Generator
Create AI-generated avatar versions of yourself. Upload your photos, choose from available styles, and explore different artistic interpretations of your appearance.
Create Artwork for Your Space
Looking for creative artwork ideas for your home or room? Describe your vision and use DaVinci to explore digital art inspired by your preferences. Save your favorite creations for personal use.
CREATE WITH DAVINCI
From AI photos and videos to avatars, tattoos, logos, and illustrations, DaVinci brings different AI creative tools together in one app.
Explore your ideas and experiment with AI-powered image and video generation.
Some features and creation options may require a paid subscription or additional purchases.
WE'D LOVE YOUR FEEDBACK
Have suggestions or feedback to help improve DaVinci? We'd love to hear from you! Contact us at support@davinci.ai

bluejetty:00186037:ios.summary:
"Fantastic, customizable tracing practice with fun rewards." 5 Stars - Common Sense Media
500,000+ units sold (including 300,000+ to schools) !
Writing Wizard is designed to help every child learn how to trace letters, numbers, and words
bluejetty:00186037:ios.description:
"Fantastic, customizable tracing practice with fun rewards." 5 Stars - Common Sense Media
500,000+ units sold (including 300,000+ to schools) !
Writing Wizard is designed to help every child learn how to trace letters, numbers, and words through a fun system carefully designed to maintain motivation. 
• Show and enforce how to trace letters correctly
• Letter names and phonics (customizable)
• 16 Fonts available (including 3 most popular in the US)
• Fun tracing using 50+ animated stickers, sound effects and interactive games that animate letters at the end of tracing
• Uppercase & lowercase letters, numbers, and words
• Ability to create your own word lists (and record audio for each word)
• Fully customizable to suit every child’s needs (letter size, difficulty,...)
• Check progress thanks to reports that display what the child has traced
• Shapes tracing activity for toddlers
• Create PDF Worksheets and print them to help your child to write on paper
• Use Apple pencil to write at a very small size 
All the shapes, the first 7 letters, numbers, and words are free. The remaining letters and the ability to add your own words can be unlocked with a one-time purchase or a monthly subscription.
_______
ACCOLADES
• "Writing Wizard is the most complete and intelligent letter tracing app we’ve seen"" AppoLearning.com
• "This brand-new app should be the go-to for every parent, teacher and therapist to work on handwriting" - TOP PICKS - 5 stars - SmartAppsForKids.com
• "Writing Wizard by L’Escapadou is everything a parent wants in a handwriting app, and more." 5/5 - kids-app-reviews.com
• "L’Escapadou has made handwriting fun." AppyMall.com 5/5
• Listed in "20 best educational iPhone and iPad apps for kids of 2013" - appsplayground.com
• Editor's Choice Award for Excellence in Design - Children's Technology Review
_______
PERFECT FOR KIDS
Kids want to have fun, and Writing Wizard offers a lot of fun to keep them motivated in the learning process! 
• They can trace using 50+ animated stickers and sound effects
• Once tracing is complete, they can interact with them on 4 games that animate letters
• They can trace any word - like their name - and record their voice for each word
• They can collect stars in 5-Stars play mode
_______
PERFECT FOR PARENTS & TEACHERS
• Ability to create your own word lists (and record audio for each word)
• Detailed reports provide information on what kids have done, including the ability to replay and export the tracings to view kids' progress
• Share word lists via iCloud Drive or other cloud providers, adhoc network, or email
• Multiple parameters to customize the app according to the child’s current education level (e.g. letter size, difficulty, show/hide model, allow to stop between key points, etc.)
• 3 most popular fonts in the US (ZB, DN & HWT) and 13 international fonts (UK, Scandinavia, Australia, Germany and France)
• Upper and lower case letters, numbers (and word lists)
• Letter names and letter sounds (which can be customized)
• A customizable 5-Stars play mode prompting the child to trace a letter or a word 5 times using different parameters (each step is more challenging)
• Create an unlimited number of users
• Many settings to customize the app (sound, game time limit, black background,...)
• In the A-Z section, special graphics available to match letters (e.g. ant graphic for A/a)
_______
Privacy Policy
KNOW WHAT'S INSIDE
As a Moms with Apps member, we follow the "Know what's inside" best practices for kids’ apps
L’Escapadou takes children’s privacy seriously. We believe you should not have to worry about your kids being tracked by apps or websites. This app:
• Does not collect any user information (we do not use data collection tools)
• External Links : Before accessing a parent section, an operation must be solved so that young kids cannot access it.
Terms of use : https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00030403:ios.name: IP Scanner Ultra
bluejetty:00030403:ios.summary:
IP Scanner: always know what's on your Wi-Fi.
An old phone reconnects while you're out. A laptop joins the office network at 2am. Something you don't recognize appears next to your TV. IP Scanner tells you the moment it happens: a push ale
bluejetty:00030403:ios.description:
IP Scanner: always know what's on your Wi-Fi.
An old phone reconnects while you're out. A laptop joins the office network at 2am. Something you don't recognize appears next to your TV. IP Scanner tells you the moment it happens: a push alert on iPhone and Apple Watch, a morning briefing of overnight changes, and a Network DVR timeline to scrub back through. Remote Scans let you check the current status from anywhere, even on your watch.
IP Scanner Ultra bundles our award-winning Mac, iPhone and iPad apps together with new Apple TV, Apple Watch and Vision Pro versions - 6 apps in one. Scan your local area network to determine the identity of all machines and internet devices on the LAN. Powerful results, yet easy and intuitive to use. It’s like a level 9 detect devices spell for your network!
Key features:
* Home Radar push alerts: know the moment a device joins or leaves your Wi-Fi, on iPhone and Apple Watch
* Network DVR: scrub back through your network's history and see exactly what changed and when
* Remote Scans via iCloud: check your home network from anywhere, straight from your iPhone
* Automatic vendor identification for discovered devices
* Bluetooth device name detection for clearer device identity
* Full IPv6 support
* Extremely fast scan results
* Customizable results - assign your own names and icons to discovered devices
* Save and consult past scans
* PING, Wake on LAN and Port Scan tools built right in
* Option to open a device in browser, VNC or other applications
* Save and import custom device lists, or sync via iCloud
* Sort network list by device name, IP address, MAC address or Last Seen
* System level notifications for newly discovered devices and changes in device state
* Add custom network ranges
* Import/export scan results via email or bonjour
* Clean, professional design that is super easy to use
Whether you’re a casual home user or a network professional, IP Scanner Ultra is all about customizing the way you view and analyze your network. You may apply custom names and icons to the devices on your network and adjust the type and amount of information you see in the network overview; don't need to see the MAC address column... don't display it! Text too small... make it larger! We also include a whitelist feature that lets you filter out known and trusted devices to reveal new or unexpected ones, a great way to easily identify unwanted network visitors.
IP Scanner Ultra can be used in several primary modes such as:
* A quick overview of which devices are currently on the network, including seeing which devices are actively and passively present
* A “Cumulative Mode” that shows network changes over time, including options to display devices which were once present but now no longer visible.
Still not sure if IP Scanner Ultra does what you need?
* Try it out with our FREE version of IP Scanner available in the App Store for macOS & iOS https://apple.co/3WURLXz
* Check out our FAQs at http://10base-t.com
* Or contact us directly with any questions at hello@10base-t.com - we always love hearing from our customers. We use our own tools daily and strive to make the best possible IP Scanning utility available - let us know what features you’d like to see!

bluejetty:00087425:ios.summary:
Manage Your Bookings on the Go!
In the My Booking section of the app, you can manage everything related to your booking — changing the dates, adding another driver, or upgrading your car. You can also see all of the details of your booking
bluejetty:00087425:ios.description:
Manage Your Bookings on the Go!
In the My Booking section of the app, you can manage everything related to your booking — changing the dates, adding another driver, or upgrading your car. You can also see all of the details of your booking and our flexible cancellation policy anytime and anywhere you need.
All the Information You Need
Find all the information about each rental car conveniently in one place — from the fuel and mileage policy to what coverage is included. Don’t forget to check the Rental Conditions before booking to avoid any surprises later on!
Assistance Anytime — Day or Night
Our Customer Support agents are waiting to help you with anything related to your rental anytime that they may come up — from helping you find the perfect rental car for you to solving issues with the rental company after you drop off the car. They speak most of the languages our customers do, too.
Find What You Need Quickly
Looking specifically for a 4x4 vehicle? Use our 4x4 filter to only see 4wd vehicles. Want to make sure you’re safe? Find rental cars that are guaranteed to be disinfected. Want to make sure the rental desk is located at the airport so that you can hit the road as quickly as possible? Use our In Terminal filter to save time. We’ve built a way to find the car you need, in the place you need it, as quickly and effortlessly as possible.
Free Cancellation
Don’t fret if something comes up that causes your plans to change. We offer free cancellation up to 48 hours before your scheduled pick-up time. And you can cancel with the click of a button in the app. You can also see exactly when you must cancel by to receive a refund in the My Booking page — transparency you can trust.
Reliable Rental Company Ratings
Don’t want to spend time looking up each rental company to find out what customers have to say about their experiences? We feel the same. That’s why we’ve asked all of our customers to rate their rental company so that we can give you unbiased ratings right in the search results to make your choice quick and simple.
Excellent Service Award
We’ve gone even further to make sure you have the best experience possible. Look for companies that have provided our customers with service warranting our Excellent Service Award. With these companies, you can be assured that your experience at the rental desk will be second to none.
Trustworthy
Want to know whether you can trust our app? We’ve been in business for over seven years and have received thousands of reviews from our customers. Our Trustpilot rating is 4.5/5 — amongst the top ten in the Car Rental Agency category.
