bluejetty:00186498:ios.description:
Use of this app requires an active account for Lexia® PowerUp Literacy®. If you do not have a username and password, please contact your school for more information.
About Lexia PowerUp Literacy:
Grounded in the science of reading, Lexia PowerUp Literacy is designed to accelerate literacy gains for struggling and non-proficient readers in grades 6-12 (year 7 and above in the UK). With 180 unique placement profiles possible, PowerUp addresses the instructional needs of a wide range of students through adaptive learning paths.
This targeted, personalized instruction prepares students to comprehend and engage with complex texts across a range of genres by focusing on:
• Word Study
• Grammar
• Comprehension
Embedded progress monitoring, actionable data, and scripted lessons empower teachers to deliver the exact instruction each student needs. Developed to address the decades-long gap in reading proficiency across the nation, PowerUp delivers rigorous content and skills instruction through an engaging, personalized approach that helps students become proficient readers and confident learners.
About Lexia:
Lexia®, a Cambium Learning Group company, is the Structured Literacy expert. For nearly 40 years, the company has focused solely on literacy, and today provides science-of-reading-based solutions for both students and educators. With robust offerings for differentiated instruction, personalized learning, assessment, and professional learning, Lexia helps more learners read, write, and speak with confidence.

bluejetty:00145159:ios.description:
Get a digital swim coach to help and guide you through the entire training process.
You will get a personalized swim training plan and never have problems figuring out how and what to swim!
SwimUp offers personalized swim training plans that are tailored to your swim level and goals. Video tutorials help you learn the most important technique elements and avoid the most common swimming mistakes.
+ PERSONAL PLANS
* Create a personal training plan with one of these goals:
Learn to swim, Improve technique, Triathlon swim, Wellness, Swim faster, Get in shape, Full improvement, Improve endurance.
* Set your goals.
* Enjoy your improvement.
+ VIDEO TUTORIALS
Immerse yourself in swimming technique by watching detailed swimming videos. You can either spend a moment in the Video Tutorials section or just take a quick look at the recommended video before your workout. All videos are useful and helpful to make your swimming fast and easy.
+ TRAINING PLANS
You can work out using your personal workout plan, or you can select any other short plan from one of these sections:
* Learn to swim - simple path for beginners
* Freestyle - improvement of freestyle swimming
* Triathlon swim - specialized training sessions for efficient swimming in Triathlon
* Masters - demanding training for experienced swimmers
* Wellness - light swimming sessions for a healthy lifestyle
* Breaststroke - Perfecting breaststroke skills
* Butterfly - Learning to swim butterfly
* Backstroke - Improvement of backstroke swimming
+ APPLE WATCH & GARMIN
Track your workouts on your Apple Watch or Garmin Watch and see your time, heart rate, and arm strokes immediately after each workout. The app connects to your Health app to provide detailed information about your physical condition and improve the usability of the app.
+ SMART ANALYTICS
Track your swimming performance and see your progress with SwimUp:
* Stroke count
* Distance
* Completed workouts
* Calendar statistics
+ THEORY
Reduce your knowledge gaps by exploring our digital library of swimming drills:
* All strokes
* Short instructional videos for each exercise
* Detailed description
+ Apple Health (HealthKit)
The SwimUp app integrates with Apple Health (HealthKit) to read activity data such as heart rate, swim distance, swim strokes, workout time and energy, and display this data in real time to users on Apple Watch.
Website: swimup.io
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCRov0cUAi7dUwHbG6UkSDZg
Support: support@swimup.io
Privacy: https://swimup.io/en/privacy
Terms of Use: https://swimup.io/en/terms

• Share the latest news on Facebook & Twitter

• 3D Touch for iOS Devices
This is the latest version of the i95 Rock app, and many more features are already planned. Please share your feedback from within the i95 Rock app by clicking the “Send App Feedback” link in the menu.

bluejetty:00087745:ios.description:
PREPARE AND PASS THE HSK EXAM WITH CHINESIMPLE
Speak, write, and read Chinese with ease.
Learning Chinese and passing the HSK exam might sound intimidating. But with Chinesimple and our fearless tutor Bingo, you'll get there faster — and have a good time doing it.
WHY CHOOSE CHINESIMPLE – YOUR ALL-IN-ONE CHINESE LEARNING APP
• HSK VOCABULARY YOU CAN ACTUALLY MASTER
Access over 5,000 HSK words (v2) and 11,000 (v3). Your own Chinese dictionary, always in your pocket — no fluff.
• OVER 300 LESSONS. YES, REALLY.
We didn’t just slap together a phrasebook. Chinesimple includes a complete learning path with hundreds of structured lessons. Who else offers that? Exactly.
• LEARN TO WRITE — FOR REAL
Our stroke animations were drawn by actual people, not generated by some fancy AI. Each stroke reflects real handwriting from a native speaker. Because learning how to write Chinese means actually learning how it’s written.
• FLASHCARDS, BUT DONE RIGHT
Every HSK word comes with a flashcard and an image. More than 6,000, all designed to make vocabulary stick. Are we obsessed? A little. But it works.
• MASTER USEFUL CHINESE SENTENCES
Over 4,000 real-life examples — with native audio recorded by the same person who drew all the strokes. Offline. Data-free. Airplane-mode ready.
• SPEAK CHINESE IN REAL CONTEXTS
Practice everyday phrases and build confidence with voice recognition and listening tools that actually help.
• 100% PERSONALIZED LEARNING
Choose what you want to focus on — pronunciation, reading, writing — and we’ll tailor the content to your goals. No pressure, just progress.
• LEARNING THAT’S ACTUALLY FUN
Score points. Unlock challenges. Hit goals. This isn’t gamification as a gimmick — it’s motivation that works.
• CHARACTERS FOR EVERY REGION
Learn both simplified and traditional Chinese characters, so you’re ready for anything — from Beijing to Taipei.
• FLUENCY FROM DAY ONE
Our tools are built for beginners, but scale with you as you grow. Learn Mandarin with confidence, at your pace.
AVAILABLE IN 12 LANGUAGES
English, Spanish, German, Italian, French, Russian, Portuguese, Indonesian, Vietnamese, Thai, Hindi, Arabic.
JOIN OVER 2 MILLION LEARNERS
More than 2,000,000 downloads
300,000+ active learners
Teaching Chinese since 2012
DOWNLOAD CHINESIMPLE HSK AND START LEARNING TODAY
And soon, you’ll be able to learn Japanese and Korean too — with the new apps from Khanji School.

bluejetty:00064651:ios.description:
Descubre Actinver Trade, la misma plataforma pionera de trading en México que conocías como Bursanet, ahora con la fuerza visual y el respaldo institucional de Actinver. Mantén la libertad de invertir por tu cuenta con la misma tecnología, funcionalidad y agilidad de siempre, en una experiencia segura y confiable desde tu celular.
Principales beneficios:
• Misma tecnología, nuevo nombre: Conserva todas las funciones y herramientas con una imagen renovada.
• Consulta completa de portafolio: Revisa tu saldo, historial de movimientos y poder de compra en tiempo real.
• Diversificación desde tu celular: Opera acciones, ETFs, fondos de inversión, divisas, CETES y más.
• Alertas en tiempo real: Notificaciones de compra/venta y noticias clave directamente en tu dispositivo.
• Acceso a contenido educativo: Webinars, tutoriales y análisis respaldados por expertos de Actinver.
• Seguridad institucional: Plataforma regulada por CNBV, SHCP y Banxico; depósitos protegidos por el IPAB.
• Apertura 100% digital: Abre tu cuenta en minutos y comienza a invertir de inmediato.
Por qué elegir Actinver Trade:
• Respaldo de una institución financiera sólida y con más de 30 años de experiencia.
• Acceso a mercados nacionales e internacionales con comisiones competitivas.
• Sin costo por uso de plataforma, consulta o cierre de cuenta.
Novedades recientes:
Actualización de estabilidad, mejoras en rendimiento y optimización de la experiencia visual. 
Invierte con confianza, autonomía y el respaldo de Actinver.

bluejetty:00122422:ios.description:

Everyday banking in the palm of your hand, no matter where you are.
FEATURES INCLUDE
QUICKVIEW
ACCOUNT DETAILS
BILL PAYMENTS
REMOTE DEPOSIT*
SCHEDULED TRANSACTIONS
TRANSFERS
INTERAC® e-Transfer
MESSAGES
ATM LOCATOR
FINANCIAL CALCULATORS 
ACCESS
You log in to the app with the same membership details as online banking and once you log out or close the app, your secure session will end. Learn more about how we keep your information secure.
To take advantage of the full functionality of this app, you must already be registered and have logged in to online banking. If you are not an online banking member, you can still use the Branch/ATM locator, Rates, and our Contact Us information.
SECURITY
Bank securely and with confidence. Our mobile banking app uses the same high level of security as our online banking. For information on security, please see our security section on our website.
PRIVACY
Your privacy is important to us. We never use your information for any other purpose other than delivering financial services to you. For information on our Privacy Policies, and how we keep your information safe, please see our privacy section on our website.
LEGAL
If you install our credit union’s app, then you must review and are subject to the terms and conditions found under the Direct Services Agreement, and the Membership Terms and Conditions that you would have received when your account was opened. If you would like to obtain an updated copy of the Membership Terms and Conditions, please contact us.
By downloading the credit union mobile banking application, you consent to the installation of this app, its future updates and upgrades. You can withdraw your consent at any time by deleting the app.
FEES
There is no charge for the app but mobile data downloading and internet charges may apply. Check with your mobile phone provider for details.

Order food and drink, skip the queues, follow live sport, play games and win prizes with the Greene King app. Get free pints, exclusive food rewards and instant table booking at thousands of UK pubs.
Whether you're meeting friends for a pint, enjoying a family meal or planning a match day, the Greene King app helps make every visit easier, more rewarding and more enjoyable.
GET MORE FROM EVERY VISIT:
- Earn rewards and unlock exclusive offers
- Order food and drink straight to your table
- Find and book the perfect table
- Play games and win prizes
- Discover pubs with beer gardens, play areas and dog friendly spaces
- Reorder drinks with Siri
- Browse menus before you visit
- Pay quickly and securely in app
- Scan your loyalty card at the bar
New to the app? Register and spin the wheel for a guaranteed freebie - from delicious food to crisp, cold pints. No catch, just pure joy.
EXCLUSIVE REWARDS
- Earn rewards and access exclusive offers every time you visit
- Complete Missions to unlock extra discounts
- Save your loyalty card to Apple Wallet for quick scanning at the bar
- Link your CAMRA membership and keep your benefits in one place
ORDER FOOD & DRINK
- Order food and drinks directly from your table
- Skip the bar queues and pay securely in the app
- Check live wait times for food and drink
- Reorder drinks with Siri
FIND PUBS & BOOK TABLES
- Find nearby pubs and restaurants from our brands, including Greene King, Hungry Horse, Farmhouse inns, and Chef & Brewer.
- Filter venues by beer gardens, family facilities and dog-friendly spaces
- Browse menus before you visit
- Book tables for meals, special occasions and live sport fixtures
PLAY GAMES & WIN PRIZES
- Play Pub Catch by tapping drinks in the zone, racking up massive combos, and using power-ups to maximise your high score
- Earn prize draw entries through everyday gameplay and Reward Missions to win free food, drinks, and exclusive vouchers
- Unlock extra turns and boost your chances to win every time you place an order or scan your loyalty card
WATCH SPORT
- View upcoming football, rugby and other live sport fixtures
- Book ahead and secure the best place to watch the match
- Locate one of our venues screening Sky Sports and TNT Sports
Discover our brands:
Greene King pubs, Hungry Horse, Flaming Grill, Farmhouse Inns, Chef & Brewer Collection, Wacky Warehouse, Belhaven, and the Metropolitan Pub Company.

bluejetty:00089067:ios.description:
Calling all sneakerheads and art fanatics!
We introduce to you Custom Kicks, the ultimate sneaker customization app for your inner creative spark.
Create your own custom sneakers to relax or to practice your sneaker designing skills.
Simply pick which sneaker you want to customize, and get creating with our intuitive system that makes designing your own colorways simple and easy.
A number of options create endless combinations and styles to keep you busy, and the inbuilt color wheel gives you the power to make any colorway you see on the shelves. First, choose to brush or spray your sneakers with 5 different brush size and hardness settings. Or if you’re in a rush, use the bucket feature to paint entire panels in just one click. An eraser and an option to skip backward or forwards allow you to edit your creation and get rid of any possible mistakes until you are happy with what you’ve made. Lastly, decide how realistic you want your design to be, with pre-made shading at your disposal on a sliding scale. Different texture options give you the chance to use patterns like carbon fiber and elephant print or mess around with a range of materials from snakeskin to satin.
Once you’re done, your sneaker art can be saved and accessed at any point in the “My Work” section, allowing you to come back to a piece later on and update it or share it with the world. This is also why our app is the perfect tool for sneaker customizers, who can test out their designs first virtually, and then use it as a reference when transferring the design onto a real pair of shoes.
Your own sneaker coloring book in your back pocket, to keep you entertained on long haul flights, or to practice your skills late into the night!

Brought to you by the developer who built the smartest photo scanner app, Photomyne is proud to now offer an AI-powered negative film scanner app that will blow you away. See how those hidden negative memories are instantly revealed and scanned.
IT’S AUTOMATIC - JUST ADD CAMERA FILM NEGATIVES:
1. Open a backlight source on your computer (or use the link provided in the app)
2. Hold the film strip vertically in front of the light
3. Long-press the capture button or simply say “Go” (if voice control is enabled)
4. See negatives magically scanned and images revealed
The app’s scanning algorithm automatically inverts colors and enhances the image so you get the best possible scans of your old film negatives.
OPTIONAL IN-APP UPGRADE:
The first few photos are free. For unlimited use, consider purchasing an optional paid plan (in-app purchase). 
Here are the premium features you get with a paid plan:
* Unlimited scanning
* Unlimited photo saving and sharing
* Photo backup and access on other devices and online.
The app offers an optional paid plan via monthly/yearly auto-renewing subscriptions**, as well as a One-Time plan which is paid for by a single upfront payment (valid for 2 years). These offer unlimited access to the premium mentioned above.
**Payment will be charged to your App Store account at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription will automatically renew itself unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings in the App Store. If offered, if you choose to use our free trial, any unused portion of the free trial period will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Got any questions? We’d love to connect: support@photomyne.com

bluejetty:00131288:ios.description:
Thumbtack is a home services app that connects you with local pros for any project on your to-do list. Get prices, read reviews, message pros, and hire your favorite directly in the app.
Spending hours researching businesses and calling around for estimates? Thumbtack does that hard work for you. Find local contractors, house cleaners, handymen, plumbers, electricians, landscapers, interior designers and much more.
Thumbtack makes finding local professionals and getting any project done, big or small, easy.
HOW IT WORKS
► Select the services you need (or chores you want done).
► We'll show you a list of available local pros near you.
► See cost estimates, compare quotes and detailed business information, and even chat with pros right in the app.
► Then you can compare prices, read reviews and book the pro whose skills match your needs, whether that's a handyman, plumber, electrician, contractor, house cleaner, builder, home designer or all of the above.
TOP PROFESSIONAL SERVICES
► Home improvement and home repair: a handyman, plumbers, electricians, painters, roofers, flooring experts, swimming pool cleaning, lawn care and more
► Cleaning services: house cleaning and deep cleaning for your home or for a business
► Home design: interior designers, home decorators and remodeling experts
► Photography: everything from commercial to wedding photographers
► Business: services like data entry and logo design
► Design and web: software engineering, animation and more
► Pets: dog walking, pet care and other pet services
► Lessons: yoga instructors, math tutors and anything else you want to learn
► Crafts: from custom jewelry artists to songwriters
► Estate planning
► Personal: life coaches, wardrobe consultants and more
► Repair and tech support: for things like equipment repair or data recovery specialists
► Writing, translation, and transcription: editors, content copywriters and more
► Events: caterers, makeup artists, entertainment and all the help you need for the perfect event
► Wedding: officiants, photographers, wedding planning services and other wedding vendors
Thinking about a kitchen or home remodel? Got a construction project that's stalled? Looking for a moving company? With almost 500 different types of top-rated service professionals, you'll find the right local pro for all of your projects, from small repairs to full renovations.
Looking to give your home or house a refresh? We've got pros on hand to help out:
• Outdoor landscaping and design
• Exterior and interior painting
• Interior design and home decor
• Fence and gate installation
• Tree trimming and removal
• Concrete installation
• Floor installation or replacement
• Full-service lawn care
• Deck or porch remodel or addition
• Central air conditioning installation, repair or replacement
• Swimming pool cleaning, maintenance and inspection
• Gutter cleaning and maintenance
Looking to hire a local pro for home services, cleaning, repair or design? Download Thumbtack.
Need help using Thumbtack? Go here: http://help.thumbtack.com

bluejetty:00041472:ios.description:
Track the free Miami Beach Trolley and Miami Beach Water Taxi in real time with live arrival times, ETAs, routes, stops, docks, and maps.
Miami Beach Trolley Tracker is a real-time transit tracker for getting around Miami Beach with less waiting. Check live trolley arrival times, ETAs, route details, stop information, dock locations, and maps for Collins Express, Middle Beach Loop, North Beach Loop, South Beach Loop, and Water Taxi. Whether you are looking for a Miami Beach trolley tracker, trolley arrival times, trolley stops, route info, or Water Taxi service between Miami Beach and Downtown Miami, this app helps you find the next arrival faster.
Use Home Screen widgets to keep your favorite stop one tap away and check arrivals at a glance without opening the app. If you need live Miami Beach trolley routes, stop details, dock information, maps, and Water Taxi ETAs, everything is in one place.
Features:
• Real-time Miami Beach Trolley and Miami Beach Water Taxi arrival times
• Home Screen widgets for quickly checking your favorite stop
• Live ETAs, route details, stops, docks, and map access
• Coverage for Collins Express, Middle Beach Loop, North Beach Loop, South Beach Loop, and Water Taxi
• Filter stops by route or stop number
• Tap any stop or dock to see arrival times, route details, and location
• Open stop and dock locations in Maps for easy navigation
• Free to use, with an optional premium upgrade for an ad-free experience
Important:
This app is for Miami Beach service, including the blue Miami Beach trolleys and Water Taxi. It is not for the orange and green City of Miami trolleys. If you need City of Miami trolley service instead, download the companion app "Miami Trolley Tracker."
Questions or feedback? Email support@onebiteapps.com
Transit data, ETAs, stop information, and vehicle tracking are provided by the transit agency and its partners and may be delayed, unavailable, or inaccurate at times. Miami Beach Trolley Tracker is an independent app and is not affiliated with the City of Miami Beach or its transit partners.
Weekly and yearly premium subscriptions are available for an ad-free experience. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase and renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your Apple Account settings.

Privacy Policy:
https://www.onebiteapps.com/home/privacy-policy

- Progress Visualization. See your evolution with detailed graphs and body maps of your exercise ranks. Instantly spot strengths and weak points.
- Advanced Metrics. If you are a fitness professional—or want to become one—you’ll have all the data needed to monitor every detail of your training.

bluejetty:00023808:ios.description:

bluejetty:00020980:ios.description:
Work your way through all different challenges and solve the brain teaser's house drawings and magnet world coloring puzzle. Create magnetic houses, colorful 3d architecture buildings, and paint different home styles in this metal book for adults. 
Challenging voxel models help you to create a stunning 3D version of famous houses, emojis, and weapons with a magnetic makeover. It's not just an excellent way to pass time but also an amazing design tool that will help you to create pixel art glowing masterpieces. Color by number will help you relieve stress and anxiety by completing a variety of unique anti-stress magnetism artworks. 
Draw, renovate, decorate and follow the numbers - this is the first 3d art book where you can solve the puzzles by coloring models and make home designs It is believed that when you create, color, or look at a mandala, you are silently programming the mind to relax and take on the essence of completion. 
How To Play:
- First of all, choose your favorite coloring puzzle category from five different voxel house styles.
- All houses in the selected category are marked by numbers. 
- Choose magnet colors and zoom in the model to show the numbers easily.
- Rotate the house floor and build a home and paint every single layer in the magnetic style and solve the house puzzle to complete the castle drawings.
- Follow the numbers in each layer and create magnetic houses 
- Choose what you like and finish your masterpiece in this magnetic color theory.
- A video tutorial will help you to solve color quest and paint house designs in 3D dimensions.
- Remove all ads and unlock all new puzzles for one week after purchasing subscription mode.
- Enjoy the background music while constructing a magnet world with different house designs.
- Color Magnet 3d puts your puzzle skills to the test with its unique gameplay and clever concept.
Features:
- Various three-dimensional models to build and decorate with different magnate colors.
- House interior, medieval, castle painting, and classic houses are available for oddly satisfying 3d coloring.
- Creative jigsaw puzzle game with different magnetic art styles of illustrations.
- A relaxing activity to clear the mind and calm the artistic soul.
- Guaranteed hours of pleasure, relaxation, and relief from stress.
- An addictive diy puzzle game that challenges your brain and sharpens your mental skills.
Every colored page comes to life in its uniquely colored way, giving the artist an immediate and special sense of ownership and pride! Not only is the app incredibly fun but it is also a great tool for developing puzzle-solving skills.
In Premium Subscription:
- You can subscribe weekly for $2.99 and get unlimited access to all content including:
 New Images of all categories.

 Unlimited Hints.
 Updated pictures every day.
- Subscription will be charged to your credit card through your iTunes account.

• Current subscription may not be cancelled during the active subscription period; however, you can manage your subscription and/or turn off auto-renewal by visiting your iTunes Account Settings after purchase

bluejetty:00042510:ios.description:
What is Golden Steps? 
Golden steps is the social fitness app that motivates you to stay active in a fun and interactive way!
Earn fantastic prizes for your physical activity!
Walk: Golden Steps uses the motion sensors of your mobile phone in order to detect your movements and track your steps!
Accumulate points: physical activity is converted into Gold Points based on the calories you have consumed (50 calories = 1 Golden Point). Accumulate Golden Points every time you walk, run or cycle! 
Win rewards: with the points accumulated, you can unblock amazing rewards! The chance to win every month!
Get daily tips
Receive daily Fitness workout videos
Locate users around you and chat with them!
Challenge your friends in real-time!
Check your latest score on the leaderboard to see how many points you need to win your next prize!
The most motivated will be the most rewarded! 
Stay in shape with Golden Steps and become a part of the largest Fitness community!
Rules & How to win
There is no lottery or any element of chance. Yes, you can be a winner every month!
Prizes:
Monthly prizes are shown in the leaderboard
1- Each prize has a set number of winners
2- Each prize category requires a certain number of Gold Points to enter
How winners are selected?
Winners are selected at the end of each month. Prizes are awarded to users who achieve the minimum points required in the first position, according to the allotted number of winners accepted.
Where can I check my ranking?
You can see your ranking in real time on the leaderboard. All points are reset to zero at the end of each month.
Where can I check my activity?
You can view your daily activity under the “My Activity” tab
You can check our Privacy Policy and our Terms & Conditions
We use Apple Health Kit to retrieve your activity data.

bluejetty:00145829:ios.summary: Good Vibes brings 3,000+ sounds into one place: binaural beats, healing instruments from around the world, pure noise, nature, ambient, and ASMR. Choose a goal and press play, or open the Composer and build your own mix. With this much to e
bluejetty:00145829:ios.description:
Good Vibes brings 3,000+ sounds into one place: binaural beats, healing instruments from around the world, pure noise, nature, ambient, and ASMR. Choose a goal and press play, or open the Composer and build your own mix. With this much to explore, you never hear the same night twice.
EVERY FREQUENCY, TUNED AND VERIFIED
“…no questioning if its legit frequency, no YT with ads interrupting… just pure frequencies and good music.” - User review
A binaural beat only works if the audio truly contains the tones it promises, and many tracks online don’t. Every Good Vibes soundscape is built and checked by real audio engineers, so the frequencies you choose are genuinely there: clean, accurate, and real.
FALL ASLEEP FASTER, STAY ASLEEP LONGER
“…close your eyes and do couple deep breaths and you ARE ASLEEP.” - User review
Lie awake with a racing mind, or wake at 3 a.m. and can’t drift back? Low Delta and Theta frequencies (0.1–8 Hz) gently slow your brainwaves toward the rhythm of deep, natural sleep, quieting the chatter and helping you stay down all night, so you wake up actually rested.
RELEASE STRESS, FIND YOUR CALM
When anxiety takes hold, your nervous system is stuck in fight-or-flight. Alpha and Theta frequencies (4–14 Hz) can help shift you back to calm from on-edge to at-ease, and into the open, relaxed state where meditation and clarity live.
SHARPEN YOUR FOCUS
Checking your phone every five minutes? Beta and 40 Hz Gamma frequencies (14–100 Hz) help sharpen alertness and working memory, cutting through distraction so you slip into a steady state of flow and finally get the deep work done.
SOUND FOR THE SOUL: HEALING FREQUENCIES
“This is probably the best app I have on my phone… For once, you get what’s advertised!” - User review
Good Vibes also weaves the legendary Solfeggio tones into soundscapes played on real instruments. 396 Hz helps release fear and tension, 432 Hz settles you into a softer, natural calm, 528 Hz works to restore and open the heart, and 639 Hz helps you reconnect with the people who matter. Paired with Tibetan bowls, sitar, and bandura, these are frequencies you don’t just hear, you feel them.
You’ll also find pure white, pink, brown, and green noise to mask distraction, immersive 8D and deep-bass binaural, frequency tracks like Schumann resonance, and soothing soundscapes made for tinnitus.
CUSTOMIZE TO FIT YOUR SOUND ROUTINE
- Composer helps you choose your own frequencies (binaural, monaural, isochronic, or 3D) and stack your own layers of sound.
- ASMR sounds with customizable layers.
- Frequency & volume control to adjust how strong the frequencies feel and fine-tune levels in-app.
FEATURES THAT MATTER
- Offline listening allows you to download any soundscape and play it anywhere, no signal needed.
- Background & Backdrop play to keep Good Vibes running with your podcasts, audiobooks, or playlists.
- Custom timer & sleep modes help set how long you listen and let the sound fade as you drift off.
- Exclusive video content with musicians and sound healers, explaining the sounds and how to use them.
- Clear categories so you find the right sound fast, by goal or by frequency.
- No ads, ever.
START YOUR JOURNEY
Better sleep, calmer days, sharper focus, it can start tonight. Put on your headphones, choose how you want to feel, and let the sound carry you.
SUBSCRIPTION
Choose your plan:
- Monthly — 9.99 USD
- Yearly — 41.99 USD
Pricing may vary by region. Terms of Use & Privacy Policy: https://goodvibesofficial.com/terms-and-condition, https://goodvibesofficial.com/privacy-policy
DISCLAIMER
Good Vibes is a wellness tool, not a medical device, and is not intended to diagnose, treat, or cure any condition. If you feel uncomfortable, stop listening and consult a qualified professional.

 • You can enable/disable or pause tracking anytime

 • See Reviews from Other Truckers – Avoid bad job sites before accepting loads.

Truck drivers face unique challenges when it comes to finding healthcare on the road. With HealthRX, you get affordable virtual healthcare without needing to stop driving.
 • 24/7 Access to Licensed Doctors – Talk to a doctor anytime, anywhere.

bluejetty:00172635:ios.description:
※遊戲簡介※
《無名江湖》是一款以收集百家武學為目標的豎版國風武俠放置卡牌遊戲（RPG）。掛機養成、陣容搭配，在遊戲中體驗完整的俠客人生：拜師學藝、加入門派、闖蕩江湖，一步步成為一代大俠的傳奇故事。在這裏，還有武學卡牌的策略深度與古風武俠氛圍的極致體驗……絕世武林，靜候君啟！
※遊戲特色※
〓武打動作，盡收眼底〓
超高度還原經典武俠劇中的武打動作和招式效果。遊戲裏將一一重現輕功飛行、爆破特效般的經典鏡頭，享受極致的打擊體驗。
〓武學策略，易懂難精〓
擁有上百本武學卻無法問鼎華山？這個江湖可是策略為王！拳掌、劍法、刀法、奇門武功齊上陣，收集秘笈、搭配武功，以弱勝強，不在話下！
〓江湖奇遇，超強劇情，高爆福利〓
親身體驗武俠故事裏最驚心動魄的橋段！闖關同時還可獲得寶物、裝備、武學秘笈等，江湖種種奇遇，等你體驗！也許是唯一一款能在放置、掛機玩法中體驗完整解密劇情的武俠RPG！
〓武林紛爭，跌宕起伏〓
弱肉強食的銅人巷爭奪，恩怨情仇的武林大會，各路幫派入侵。遊戲內眾多多人互動玩法，結識一群行俠仗義的夥伴共闖江湖吧！
〓絕美畫風，匠心製作〓
豎版國漫風、古風武俠畫面接連呈現。遊戲同名主題曲由知名音樂人陳揮之作曲，野火大鴻作詞。遊戲主角人設由2000年SONY發行的PS遊戲《射雕英雄傳》角色設計畫師名角尖親自操刀。

Discord論壇：https://discord.gg/BxZz8E5z3W

bluejetty:00019511:ios.description:
Boy Howdy's Pyramid Solitaire is the best Pyramid Solitaire app ever, and it's 100% FREE!
• Pyramid is a classic solitaire game where you make pairs that add up to 13 in order to clear the pyramid of cards from the board.
• Fast and intuitive controls - Just tap on a pair of cards to remove them!
• Beautiful, easy to read cards!
• No timers at all! Just relax and have fun!
• Unlimited undo support, with no penalties if you want to go back and try things a different way!
• 3 different Game Modes to keep things interesting!
• Fun Mode deals out 3 cards at a time and you can use any of them to make matches
• Hard Mode deals out 3 cards at a time in a stack and you can only use the top one
• Strategy Mode deals out all the cards at the beginning of the game, in 8 stacks of 3, so you can see everything ahead of time and think carefully to make the matches you need
• Global high score leaderboards with Game Center
• Your progress is automatically saved, all the time, so go ahead and take that call or jump out to any other apps - you can come back and pick up playing right where you left off!
• Sounds can be disabled if you want a quiet game
• You can even listen to your own music while you play
Thanks for playing!
Search for Boy Howdy to see all our free games!

bluejetty:00184185:ios.description:
CommerceOne is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with CommerceOne:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements

bluejetty:00026921:ios.name: GOHUNT: Research & Maps
bluejetty:00026921:ios.summary: The only all-in-one hunting app where you can find, filter, navigate, and succeed on your next hunt. Trusted by diehard hunters like Randy Newberg, Brady Miller, and Trail Kreitzer, GOHUNT is the leader in empowering hunters to overcome the
bluejetty:00026921:ios.description:
The only all-in-one hunting app where you can find, filter, navigate, and succeed on your next hunt. Trusted by diehard hunters like Randy Newberg, Brady Miller, and Trail Kreitzer, GOHUNT is the leader in empowering hunters to overcome the challenges that face them in the field.
Our industry-leading hunting research platform helps you find every unit you’re able to draw a tag for. Select the state and species you want to hunt, then filter by your draw odds, the unit’s amount of public land, historical harvest success, and more. Then see a list of all the units that fit your criteria and see them directly in our mapping platform.
Expand your hunting network by exploring our Unit Profiles, which feature write ups, photos, historical data, and user-to-user communication for every unit in the West.
In addition, GOHUNT features GPS mapping is built for the needs of hunters across all 50 states. From the absolute basics like public & private land, waypoints, and roads & trails all the way to advanced 3D and analysis tools, you can access everything there is to know about any piece of land in the United States.
There’s no better platform to experience the power of having all your hunting tools in one place.
RESEARCH TOOLS
-Advanced search and filtering tools
-Draw odds for the west
-Unit profiles for all western states
-User-to-user direct messaging
-Application strategies and deadlines
-Hunting tips and tactics
-Point Tracker for Western States
MAPPING TOOLS
-Public/private land boundaries and ownership
-All 50 states included
-Downloadable offline maps
-Hunt units and zones
-Share waypoints, tracks, and hunts with other GOHUNT users
-Import data & waypoints from other mapping apps (web only)
-Hunt layers including land ownership, government land, species distribution, roads & trails, elevation bands, water, wildfire, and more
-Interactive 3D terrain
-Satellite, hybrid, and topographical basemaps
-Accurate GPS tracking
DESKTOP-ONLY TOOLS
-Terrain analysis tools
-Historical imagery library
-Reward points earned on all eligible purchases in the GOHUNT Gear Shop
Note: GOHUNT is a subscription service and some features listed above are only offered to paid subscribers. Users can try all GOHUNT features free for 7 days upon signup. Terms & conditions: https://www.gohunt.com/terms

bluejetty:00017001:ios.description:
Full-feature Punjabi language radio station providing variety programming ranging from Music, Daily NEWS, Devotional programming - Shabad Gurbani, Talk Shows to special Interviews regarding the latest issues and events. 
Also included are stations for Gurbani Radio, Non-Stop Punjabi and Hindi songs.
Punjabi Radio USA, headquartered in San Jose, California is dedicated to the Punjabi Diaspora living in United State of America and worldwide which yearns to connect to their roots of Punjab culture and heritage. Broadcasting 24/7, the Punjabi Radio USA team prides itself on being the premiere Punjabi language broadcaster in the United States. has been in Punjab media for more than a decade and has significant knowledge of issues involved with community in United States and worldwide.
Punjabi USA App is a user friendly media app that:
1. Allows you to listen to: 
 • Audio Livestreams 
 • Recorded shows (podcasts) – that you can either listen online or offline (after downloading them) without any data usage. 
2. Makes you a part of Punjabi Radio community, giving you access to the most important online communities the broadcaster has:
 • Facebook and the latest Facebook Posts (Integrated in the app) 
 • Twitter posts – just one click apart
 • Website, Instagram, etc… 
3. Gives you an interactive media experience through:
 • Radio Reporter Feature:: you can send pictures, audio, text, and video from your phone to the broadcaster 
 • Notification Feature: you will be able to receive information about the latest news, programs, contests and sport competition results directly from your broadcaster 
 • Flash Poll Feature: let your voice be heard, by answering to the hottest questions and polls the Radio will address to you. 
Download it now! It’s not just a Radio, it’s your next community!

bluejetty:00162567:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00162567:ios.description:
O aplicativo de previsão do tempo de maior confiança do Brasil, está de cara nova e repleto de novidades!
NOVIDADES:
• Para favoritar mais de uma cidade e benefícios, faça o seu cadastro;
• Temperatura do momento e sensação térmica na tela principal;
• Gráfico com previsão horária na tela principal;
• Confira a previsão do tempo navegando facilmente pelas abas do aplicativo;
• Fique atento aos índices que influenciam sua saúde, baseados nas condições do tempo e clima da sua região;
• Consulte o mapa da sua região e personalize seus atalhos;
• Crie seu perfil e configure suas preferências meteorológicas.
APROVEITE PARA BAIXAR AGORA!
Faça como grandes empresas, conte com o nosso serviço meteorológico intuitivo, detalhado, preciso e de alta confiança.
Além de acompanhar as condições atuais sobre o tempo em mais de 5.500 municípios, você consegue facilmente planejar seu dia com informações para o seu bairro e cidade.
Tenha acesso a previsão do tempo para 15 dias de forma mais rápida, fácil e precisa, com um layout simples, moderno, intuitivo e totalmente novo. 
NAVEGUE POR ABAS:
• Agora: informações do tempo na sua cidade;
• Hoje: Previsão do tempo hora | hora;
• 15 dias: Ver a tendência para os 15 dias;
• Saúde: Índices para prevenção à saúde.
FIQUE POR DENTRO DAS MUDANÇAS QUE IMPACTAM SUA SAÚDE ATRAVÉS DO NOSSO APP!
As condições do tempo também influenciam diretamente na saúde das pessoas. Sabendo disso, o aplicativo da Climatempo é o primeiro app brasileiro a contar com índices que monitoram o risco de gripes ou resfriados, condições que causam crises alérgicas, incidência de raios ultravioleta, umidade relativa do ar que influencia no ressecamento da pele e aumento da proliferação de mosquitos.
MAPA INTERATIVO
Previsão detalhada para a sua região através de geolocalização ou busca pela cidade desejada:
• Temperatura
• Chuva
• Acumulado de chuva
• Pressão
• Umidade relativa do ar
• Vento
Mapa do tempo agora com:
• Imagens de satélite;
• Chuva agora;
• Risco de alagamento RMSP
RECEBA ALERTA:
• Você poderá habilitar a função e receber notificações sobre mudanças no tempo e chuva por cidade.
PREFERÊNCIAS METEOROLÓGICAS:
Você poderá traçar suas preferências meteorológicas como frio, chuva ou calor, para que possamos melhorar sua experiência no aplicativo.
Usando inteligência artificial e os principais modelos de previsão do mundo (ECMWF, GFS globais, CFS, e WRF regional), a Climatempo oferece a melhor previsão do tempo. 
Faça chuva ou faça sol, conte com a precisão e confiança dos nossos recursos de previsão do tempo.
As novidades estão apenas começando, mantenha seu aplicativo sempre atualizado para não ficar de fora. 
MANDE SEU FEEDBACK
Sugestões, melhorias, report de bugs para sempre melhorarmos nosso app e criarmos novas soluções. Participe!
SIGA NAS REDES SOCIAIS:
• Facebook: facebook.com/Climatempo.Meteorologia
• Twitter: twitter.com/climatempo
• Instagram: instagram.com/climatempo
• LinkedIn: linkedin.com/company/climatempo
Termos de Uso (EULA): Este aplicativo utiliza o Contrato de Licença de Usuário Final (EULA) padrão da Apple: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00063539:ios.summary:
انفيدر (Invader) أول لعبة استراتيجية مخصصة للمستخدمين العرب في المنطقة العربية، وتحمل الطابع المصري القديم!
قم ببناء مدينتك، درب جنودك، استخدم وحوشك الصغيرة لتحدي الآخرين، واحصل على جنود ووحوش مدمرين، بعد ذلك يمكنك القضاء على الآخرين وهزيمت
bluejetty:00063539:ios.description:
انفيدر (Invader) أول لعبة استراتيجية مخصصة للمستخدمين العرب في المنطقة العربية، وتحمل الطابع المصري القديم!
قم ببناء مدينتك، درب جنودك، استخدم وحوشك الصغيرة لتحدي الآخرين، واحصل على جنود ووحوش مدمرين، بعد ذلك يمكنك القضاء على الآخرين وهزيمتهم باستخدام استراتيجيات وخدع حربية غاية في المكر والدهاء.
شارك في اللعبة الآن واستمتع بالتحديات المثيرة مع أصدقائك، اقهر الوحوش المصرية القديمة، وقم ببناء تحالفك ومملكتك الخاصة وقاتل للوصول للمجد.
الخصائص:
• أول لعبة استراتيجية مخصصة للمنطقة العربية بطابع فرعوني قديم، ومن أفضل ألعاب الاستراتيجية في الشرق الأوسط.
• هنالك تحديات مثيرة في انتظارك مثل الاختبار من الملوك القدماء وحرب بين اللاعبين بالإضافة لفعاليات الوقت الحقيقي الشيقة مثل البطولة الكبرى وكأس المجد التي تصقل مهاراتك في اللعبة وتجعل منك لاعبا مميزا.
• درب جنودك وقاتل أعداءك للحصول على الموارد التي تساعدك في التقدم أكثر في اللعبة.
• كن قائداً لتحالفك واكتسح أراضي الفراعنة القديمة.
• اللعبة ذات واجهة مريحة سهلة الاستخدام، وتحمل العديد من المزايا منها (الشات الذي يساعد في تبادل التكتيكات العسكرية مع الأصدقاء).
لا تتردد في التواصل مع فريق الدعم الفني إذا كان لديك أي سؤال أو استفسار، وسنكون سعيدين بخدمتك، وذلك من خلال البريد الإلكتروني invader.feedback@mozat.com.
الغزاة: لعبة الإستراتيجيات المثيرة، ستقوم ببناء مملكتك الخاصة، وتجهيز جيشك، وخوض التحديات بذكاء وحنكة قتالية.
Invader is the first customized strategy game for Arab players in the Middle East with ancient Egyptian style! 
Build your city and train your soldiers and pets to challenge and gain superior soldiers and monsters, and then you can defeat your opponents with intelligent strategies and tactics! 
Join it now with your friends and conquer the land of ancient Egyptian and establish your kingdom and alliance to fight for glory!
Feature:
• The first customized strategy game for Arab players with ancient Egyptian style, and one of the best strategy games in Middle East.
• The intense PVP and the multivariate PVE systems are the highlight of the game, and the Real-time Combat like Grand Tournament and The Cup of Glory will bring you excellent gaming experience.
• Train your army and fight against your enemies for resources.
• Become the leader of your alliance and conquer the land of ancient Egypt.
• Convenient and user-friendly instant messaging function for chatting and exchanging tactics with friends and other players.
Please do not hesitate to contact our customer service team by sending us an email at invader.feedback@mozat.com if you have any questions or concerns regarding this game.

bluejetty:00134909:ios.summary:

GROW & HARVEST

bluejetty:00134909:ios.description:
Pocket Land is a free-to-play casual mobile farming adventure game built around a simple, satisfying loop: harvest fruits and vegetables, fulfil orders, earn gold, upgrade your crops, and discover new ways to progress.
GROW & HARVEST
Move around your island and collect fruits and vegetables as they appear. Crops are gathered as you move through them, making the farming loop quick, simple, and satisfying.
FULFIL ORDERS & EARN GOLD
Each order asks for specific produce. Gather enough to complete it and earn gold, then put those rewards back into your progression.
UPGRADE EVERY HARVEST
Spend gold to increase how much produce you collect from each crop. As your Per Harvest upgrades improve, a single crop can give you several fruits or vegetables at once.
UPGRADE YOUR CHARACTER & WORKERS
Improve core character stats such as Movement Speed, Collect Range, and Harvest Range. You can also unlock and upgrade workers that help keep crops growing, with worker stats such as planting time and the number of bushes they manage improving as you progress.
COLLECT PETS, MOUNTS & GEAR
Find pets and mounts that grant useful bonuses as you play. Equip different pieces of gear for bonuses such as greater gathering range or faster movement, then upgrade your equipment to make those bonuses stronger. Gear also has its own collection loop: merge duplicate pieces, improve equipment over time, and chase higher-rarity items with stronger effects. Pets can also be merged as your collection grows.
EXPLORE DUNGEONS & CHALLENGES
Dungeons give you different ways to play beyond farming. Some runs focus on wave combat, where you choose temporary attacks, healing, damage boosts, and other upgrades as you progress. Other challenges change the objective completely, such as timed collection runs like Diamond Dungeon. Complete them to earn rewards and return to your wider Pocket Land progression.
PLAY LIMITED-TIME EVENTS
Take part in rotating events with different objectives, themed areas, mini-games, harvest challenges, and special rewards. Event content changes over time, giving you new reasons to return without changing the core farming loop.
DISCOVER MORE
Mine for treasure, unlock new skins, complete quests and challenges, and keep finding new things to collect and improve as Pocket Land opens up.
PLAY AT YOUR OWN PACE
Jump in for a quick harvest, work through a few orders, improve your gear, collect pets and mounts, or take on a dungeon run when you want something more active. Pocket Land keeps the core loop easy to understand while giving you more to discover over time. You can also drop into limited-time events when you want a different objective or reward track. 
Grow crops. Fulfil orders. Upgrade your harvest. Collect pets, mounts, and gear. Take on dungeons. Discover what comes next in Pocket Land. Upgrade workers, play events, and explore new challenges along the way.

This Safari extension offers dark mode
browsing in Safari. Dark Night mode adds
a beautiful theme to every page you visit.
It is based on the Dark Reader open source project
used by over 4,000,000 users.

has been carefully tested.

The built-in Safari dark mode is affordable and 
will stay like that forever with full support for 
all websites for delightful night reading.
YOUR PRIVACY, OUR PRIORITY
The Dark Night extension was built with privacy 
as a no. 1 priority so it doesn't collect any
data from Safari while you're browsing with 
calm eyes. Privacy Policy is linked on the 
store.
CUSTOMIZE IT
This extension can be disabled on a per-site 
basis and configured to follow the system 
dark mode (dark at night, light during the 
day). Just use the Safari extension menu to 
access it.

neonoirapp@gmail.com

get ready to color all sites to your 
liking!
This optional extra is the only place where 
we might charge a small fee and your kind 
contribution will support the development of 
this project. Half of all that income is going 
back to the Dark Reader community project.
BEAUTIFUL NIGHT BROWSING STARTS HERE
You are more than welcome to keep using the app 
for free forever!
What are you waiting for? Your eyes are the 
apples of your eyes!
See you on the other side.

bluejetty:00140869:ios.description:
Start practicing English today and improve your speaking skills.
Toko is an AI English tutor that helps you practice real English conversations anytime, anywhere. Practice English speaking with an AI that responds like a real person—whether you’re on the subway or at home.
Improve your English speaking and conversation skills without pressure. Take your time, make mistakes, and build confidence naturally.
------
Practice real English conversations: Choose from dozens of topics for work and daily life. Practice English conversations you’ll actually use.
Speak with confidence, no pressure: Take your time to respond. Listen again slower or view transcripts and translations anytime.
Build a daily speaking habit: Each conversation takes just 5–10 minutes. Practice English speaking every day, anytime.
Get instant feedback: Toko corrects your grammar and helps you improve your English as you speak.
Realistic AI conversations: Have natural, back-and-forth conversations that feel like talking to a real person.
------
TOKO PREMIUM MEMBERSHIP
Toko offers auto-renewing monthly and annual subscriptions that provide access to premium features and content within the app. Subscription pricing and available plans are displayed within the app and may vary by region. Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at the confirmation of purchase. 
Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, at the price of the selected plan. You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renew at any time by going to your App Store account settings after purchase. If a free trial is offered, any unused portion of the free trial period will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
-------
We’re a small team of MIT engineers who are on a mission to make English learning fun and easy. We are passionate about giving everyone the opportunity to speak English!
Terms and Privacy: http://terms.tokotutor.com

bluejetty:00121554:ios.description:
LEGO® Friends Heartlake Rush invites kids to join a group of best friends in their missions around Heartlake City. Play as Aliya, Autumn, Nova, Leo, Liann, and more. Customize rides, collect treasures, and dodge obstacles! 
Collect and customize with the LEGO® Friends in Heartlake City! Drive through the colorful streets with your favorite characters and their adorable pets. 
• Dodge traffic, roadblocks, and surprises on thrilling missions! 
• Collect coins, ice cream, fruit, flowers, gifts, and more cute surprises! 
• Customize your cars with cool colors, decals, tires, toppers, and trails! 
• Complete exciting missions to unlock amazing rewards and level up! 
• Earn daily rewards to keep the fun going! 
• Transform your car into a jet with Zobo the robot! 
• Unlock new LEGO® Friends characters, each with their unique pet! 
• Mix and match characters and custom cars for endless fun! 
Race, explore, and discover a world full of adventure with LEGO® Friends! 
FEATURES
• Safe and age-appropriate
• Designed responsibly to let your child enjoy screen time while developing healthy digital habits at a young age
• No third-party advertising
SUPPORT

Our mission is to bring the world's most popular characters, worlds, and stories to life for children. We make apps for kids that engage them in well-rounded activities designed to help them learn, play, and grow. Parents can enjoy peace of mind knowing their kids are learning and having fun at the same time.

StoryToys takes children's privacy seriously and ensures that its apps comply with privacy laws, including the Child Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA). If you would like to learn more about the information we collect and how we use it, please visit our privacy policy at https://storytoys.com/privacy.
Read our terms of use here: https://storytoys.com/terms/

Stemify is the ultimate AI tool for all musicians and music lovers. Use AI to extract or remove vocals & instruments from any song and play your favorite music in any key, and at any speed. Stemify is also the best place to listen, share, and organize your work-in-progress music.
Core Features
* AI Audio Separation of Stems
- Easily separate vocals, drums, guitar, bass, piano, strings, and other instruments in any song. Stemify is your vocal remover or backing track maker. 
- AI Lyric Transcription: Convert music into text effortlessly. Supports audio in English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, and Italian. Transcribe the lyrics of your music for the best karaoke track maker.
* AI Mashup
- Mashup Maker: Seamlessly merge songs, auto-match BPM & key. 
- Remix Songs: Create your own edits, remixes, and party mixes. 
- DJ Mixer Tools: Adjust vocals, drums, bass, and instruments. 
- Audio Effects: Add reverb, delay, distortion, lo-fi, and more.
* Smart Metronome
- Instantly generate click tracks that are in sync to the beat of any song.
* AI Key Detection
 - Detect and change the song key and instantly transpose chords to all 12 keys. 
* Collaborative Setlists
- Invite collaborators, fine-tune song elements, and centralize all your musical work for enhanced productivity. 
- Share links to your music with friends. See who listens and manage access to your projects.
- Record and nurture your inspiration whenever it strikes.
- Our encryption is on par with Dropbox and SoundCloud and we are aiming to be the most secure place for unreleased music.
 * Export your mix
 - Share your mix results with your friends
 - Standard format: M4A, CAF
 - HQ format: FLAC, WAV

- Karaoke

And all music amateurs!

bluejetty:00033958:ios.description:
Official FDA drug labels. No ads. No account. No lookup limits.
Read the full prescribing information of every FDA-approved drug as easy-to-read text: a table of contents, tables, pictures and search within the label. The app remembers where you stopped reading, and the original PDF is one tap away. The database is updated every week.
Free for everyone
- Every FDA drug label as text and PDF
- Pill identifier: find a pill by its imprint, color and shape
- Drugs taken off the market: still findable, with the labels from when they were sold
- Liver safety (hepatotoxicity) from the NIH LiverTox database
- Alternatives with the same active ingredient and dosage form
- Bookmarks; the labels of bookmarked drugs are saved on Wi-Fi for reading offline
Drug Guide & Medication Pro
- Browse every drug by active ingredient, generic name or pharmacologic class (mechanism of action or established pharmacologic class)
- Bookmarks on all your devices with iCloud
Manage or cancel your subscription anytime in the app's Settings.
For patients and caregivers: the labels include Medication Guides and Patient Information.
For health care professionals: dosing, pharmacokinetics, adverse reactions, drug interactions, use in specific populations and more, exactly as the FDA label states them.
If you have any feature requests, suggestions or you simply need help, please email us at hda.feedback@gmail.com.
Terms of Use: https://sites.google.com/view/hdatermsofuse/index
Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/hdaprivacypolicy/index
THIS APP DOES NOT OFFER MEDICAL ADVICE, AND NOTHING CONTAINED IN THE CONTENT IS INTENDED TO CONSTITUTE PROFESSIONAL ADVICE FOR MEDICAL DIAGNOSIS OR TREATMENT.

bluejetty:00119650:ios.description:
Remember every detail of every conversation by recording incoming and outgoing phone calls with TapeACall. 
"Whether you're interviewing someone for an upcoming story or taking minutes for a big conference call, you may find yourself having to record a conversation. In three easy steps, TapeACall allows you to securely record any phone call." - Business Insider. 
Lawyer? Document and provide evidence. Journalist? Create easily referenceable material. Any other profession or person that needs to record a call? 
Capture crystal clear recordings, transcribe those recordings with 99% accuracy, and easily download those recordings and transcriptions to your computer. All with a couple of taps in the TapeACall app.
Enjoy these supercharged features with TapeACall: 
* NEW! Automatically record outgoing phone calls (No more call merging!)  
* Quickly transcribe recordings into text with 99% accuracy 
* Remind yourself to follow up on phone calls or recordings with the new voice memo (and transcription) feature 
* Access recordings immediately after hanging up by clicking the push notification to access the recording 
* Easily organize, label, and safely store recordings to quickly reference at a later time 
* Record any phone calls or Zoom meetings of any length, whether incoming, outgoing or in progress 
* Share recordings and transcriptions via email, text, and your favorite apps like DropBox, Evernote, and Google Drive, and transfer recordings to new devices 
Note: Certain features will be available exclusively through in-app purchases.
With over 3+ million users, TapeACall has helped people record 32 million calls and transcribe 255,000 recordings. That’s 272 million minutes of phone calls recorded. 
TapeACall’s advanced call recording features have also been mentioned by these trusted sources: USA Today, 9to5Mac, Business Insider, Readers Digest, Wired, Gizmodo, and Venture Beat.
You can count on TapeACall. We offer customer service from real humans. Our developers care about the customers they serve, and we add new and useful features all of the time.
NOTE: TapeACall requires your carrier supports 3-way calling. SimpleTalk and H2o Wireless do NOT offer this in the US.
Subscribe to have unlimited access to premium features as well.
Subscription payments will be charged to your App Store account at confirmation of your purchase. Subscriptions will automatically renew and you will be charged unless auto-renew is turned off or unless you cancel at least 24 hours prior to the end of the current subscription or trial period. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when you purchase a premium subscription during the free trial period. The cost of renewal depends on the Subscription Plan you choose. 
Subscriptions and auto-renewal may be managed by going to Account Settings after purchase or by contacting Customer Support.
Privacy Policy: https://tapeacall.com/privacy 
Terms of Service: https://tapeacall.com/terms
California Privacy Notice: https://teltech.co/privacy.html

bluejetty:00044443:ios.description:
Gate Sentry is revolutionizing visitor access management for guarded properties by eliminating traditional and costly hardware, such as scanners and computers, which significantly slow down the visitor entry process. Our approach utilizes mobile and tablet software to establish a direct link between users and security personnel, ensuring the most accurate visitor lists.
The app enables users to manage their guest lists from anywhere, at any time, on any device, providing real-time updates to the security guard software for a seamless and efficient access control process. Users receive arrival notifications and can access a visitor history entry list. Furthermore, our security tablet software consolidates all activities into a single, streamlined tool with advanced search capabilities, allowing security staff to quickly locate visitors based on various criteria and dramatically reducing visitor access time to 5 seconds or less.

bluejetty:00081331:ios.description:
1st Century Teaching. 21st Century Delivery.
PTP365 is a church library you will actually use. Let's study the Bible. Wherever. Whenever. 
The Polishing the Pulpit archive goes back for years and contains thousands of high-quality sermons, Bible classes, and training sessions covering a multitude of topics that like Doctrine, Preaching, Church Leadership, History, Apologetics, Marriage, Parenting, Teen, Women, Textual Study of the Old and New Testaments, and more. PTP365 gives you unlimited access to our entire library 24 hours a day, 7 days a week for spiritual growth and enrichment.
New content is added throughout the year from Polishing the Pulpit, PTP Sparks, The Great Smoky Mountain Marriage Retreat, and exclusive PTP365 studio content. 
Search by speaker, topic, Bible book, and more. Download sermons to listen on the go or stream video sermons for Bible classes or sermons.
To access all features and content you can subscribe to Polishing the Pulpit 365 on a monthly or yearly basis with an auto-renewing subscription right inside the app.* Pricing can vary by region and will be confirmed before purchase in the app. In app subscriptions will automatically renew at the end of their cycle.
All payments will be paid through your iTunes Account and may be managed under Account Settings after the initial payment. Subscription payments will automatically renew unless deactivated at least 24-hours before the end of the current cycle. Your account will be charged for renewal at least 24-hours prior to the end of the current cycle.Any unused portion of your free trial will be forfeited upon payment.Cancellations are incurred by disabling auto-renewal.
 Terms of Service: https://watch.polishingthepulpit.com/tos
Privacy Policy: https://watch.polishingthepulpit.com/privacy

bluejetty:00078111:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00078111:ios.description:
The quip app makes it easy to track and improve your oral care routine and earn rewards for good habits! Any toothbrush, floss, or mouthwash can be tracked, with extra points earned for using quip. 
Note: The quip app is designed for ages 13+.
Everyday care
It’s simple: Good habits are the key to better oral health. That means brushing your teeth for two minutes, twice a day, flossing and rinsing regularly, and visiting the dentist every 6 months.
To help you stay on track with your daily routines, we made an app that rewards you every time you treat your teeth right.
How it works
• Pair a quip Smart Brush to auto-track how long & well you brush
• Or manually log your habits with any brush, floss, or mouthwash
• Earn points for tracking good habits & unlocking achievements
• Redeem rewards like free products, retail gift cards, refills, & more
Brush better
Once you pair a quip Smart Brush, it will automatically log every routine (no phone needed!) To review your brush history, open the app with Bluetooth on when it’s close to your brush. Or manually track date and duration with any toothbrush.
Floss & rinse
Cleaning between your teeth at least once a day is recommended by the American Dental Association, alongside a daily refresh with anti-cavity mouthwash. Track both to make your dentist proud and earn points!
Points & rewards
Stack up daily points for brushing 2 minutes, twice a day (1x with any brush, 10x with a quip Smart Brush!), plus flossing and rinsing. You can also earn bonus points for achievements, like logging 100 brushings! 
Redeem rewards 
Turn your points into amazing rewards from quip and our growing list of partners — updated regularly! Popular rewards include free products, retail gift cards, refills, sweepstakes entries, and more.

bluejetty:00178294:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00178294:ios.description:
Are you stressed and agitated? Do you want to channel your negative energies into
something soulful and creatively free till you feel calm? The Fluids and Sounds app can help you - create satisfying, trippy and psychedelic art with your fingertips.
This app helps you to reduce stress and calm down. Now you
can touch on your screen to simulate colorful and luminescent fluids that flow with your
touch movements. Create extraordinary patterns with single touch or multiple touches
on the screen and delve deeper into a world of creative fascination and magical
freedom till you feel the connection to our universe. 
--- Features of Fluids and Sounds ---
- Wonderful and easy fluid art simulation
- Sound reactive fluids (synchronize to your favorite music)
- Dozens of parameters to play around with (color, bloom,
sunrays, resolution, force and more)
- Autopilot included. Let the fluids flow without interacting with the app. You also could stream this to a bigger screen using AirPlay. Please note: Autopilot is not generating sounds.
- Gyrosensor, haptic feedback and force touch are integrated (if you want to use them)
- Realtime sound synthesis for meditating music
- Take screenshots and share them with anyone you like
- Record videos of your fluids (please note: Videos are not including the fluid sounds, only the background music, also video recording excludes the UI, so you'll only record what matters - your art) 
- Save and load your favorite settings using presets
--- Feel Free, Calm and Relaxed --- 
Art is a form of expression and expression helps in catharsis of inexplicable things we
feel every day. If you think you suck at art or expression, this app offers you a safe,
easy and creative outlet to channel your thoughts into wonderful art impressions that
disappear intermittently. Allow yourself to come down and play around with Fluids & Shapes for some minutes to make beautiful expressions on your device’s screen.
--- Seek Awareness and Peace --- 
You feel like the world is too overwhelming and you need to get a bit of awareness?
Protect your peace from getting drowned in a pool of negative emotions such as stress,
anxiety, agitation, depression etc. Seek awareness and peace the minute you open this
app and make the most of your free time with this free, amazing app.
--- Create Wonderful Fluid Art Impressions ---
Use your fingertips to create wonderful forms and shapes on your device. While you do
so, you can listen to relaxing music which is generated in realtime, depending on your
input. Get in tune with the relaxing art and music as you make beautiful patterns on your
screen. Customize the intensity, color dispersion, vortex index, music effects, waves
and other items from the menu to enjoy a more personalized fluid art meditation and
relaxation.
Are you ready to feel the satisfaction of creative freedom and its impact on your mental
wellbeing? The new fluid art meditation and stimulation app is here for you. Enjoy
breathtaking art patterns and soulful music till you feel calm and relaxed. Download and
use Fluids and Sounds today!
Hope you'll enjoy, because we believe you deserve to feel calm and relaxed!
Do you have ideas for new features or improvements? You are not satisfied with this
app?
Feel free to send me a message at info@mkgames.org
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00131094:ios.name: Easy Metronome
bluejetty:00131094:ios.summary:
Easy Metronome is built for musicians of all levels. It helps you keep a steady tempo during practice or live performance. It’s precise, easy to use, and customizable to your preferences.
Music lessons feel simpler with a large visual beat
bluejetty:00131094:ios.description:
Easy Metronome is built for musicians of all levels. It helps you keep a steady tempo during practice or live performance. It’s precise, easy to use, and customizable to your preferences.
Music lessons feel simpler with a large visual beat display. Follow up to 16 beats, each with adjustable emphasis or silence. Enjoy precise tempo control—you can even tap the beat and let Easy Metronome follow your lead.
Teachers and experienced players can quickly select time signatures with a couple of taps, change subdivisions to explore different playing patterns, and tap the tempo to enter a precise value—including decimals—up to 999 BPM.
For a tailored experience, choose from free beat sounds, or unlock additional choices—such as instrument and meditation sounds—with an optional in-app purchase. You can also personalize beat colors with themes.
Group rehearsals run smoothly with the practice timer to control session length. It’s easy for everyone to follow on larger screens, with support for iPad and Mac. Practicing solo? Easy Metronome is also available on Apple Watch with on-wrist control.
Add widgets to keep time from the Home Screen, or adjust beat volume and balance for a monitor-style effect.
Our mission is to make keeping time simple and intuitive so you can focus on your music. We’re committed to thoughtful improvements while keeping the app straightforward to use.
Download Easy Metronome and enjoy precise rhythm.

bluejetty:00072191:ios.summary:

Stop guessing. Use
bluejetty:00072191:ios.description:
Fundstrat Direct gives you exclusive access to Tom Lee's investment research, previously only available to banks and hedge funds. Now available in one easy to navigate platform, with Fundstrat AI to help you explore it.
Stop guessing. Use Fundstrat's data driven research.
What You Get:
 - Daily strategy from Tom Lee and the Fundstrat team, one of Wall Street's most followed analysts
 - Real-time alerts on market-moving events, so you're never caught off guard
 - Curated stock lists tailored to your investment style and goals
 - Crypto & digital assets coverage — daily reports,crypto picks, strategy, and more
 - Live technical analysis on the stocks you own
 - Monthly webinars featuring top ideas and near-term market outlook
 - DirectInsights: the latest analyst commentary and list changes for Macro and Crypto in one place
 - Fundstrat AI: ask questions in plain language and get answers based on Fundstrat research
 - Charts, chartbooks and reports you can search, explore, and download as PNG, JPEG, SVG or PDF
Why Fundstrat Direct?
This research was previously available only to banks and hedge funds. Now you have the same edge on any device, any time.
Whether you're a seasoned investor or just getting started, Fundstrat Direct helps you understand what is noise and what is opportunity.
With Fundstrat AI, you can get to the answer faster by asking questions about the market, sectors, stocks and crypto, and exploring the charts behind the research.
Get instant notifications when fresh research drops. Keep up with the Fed, earnings, macro shifts, and crypto developments — all in one app.
Download Fundstrat Direct and start investing like the pros.
Foreground Service Notice: This app uses a foreground service to support live webinars and video sessions with continuous audio playback. The service runs only during active sessions and stops automatically when the session ends.
Subscription Plans:
Fundstrat Pro (Macro+Crypto): Access to All the reports and research related to stocks and crypto.
Fundstrat Macro: Access to Macro reports and research based on categories.
Fundstrat Crypto: Access to Crypto reports and research based on categories.
Fundstrat Pro + AI: Access to All the reports and research related to stocks and crypto, plus Fundstrat AI.
Fundstrat Macro + AI: Access to Macro reports and research based on categories, plus Fundstrat AI.
Fundstrat Crypto + AI: Access to Crypto reports and research based on categories, plus Fundstrat AI.
Subscription Details:
Subscription Period: Monthly
Payment: The amount will be debited from the iTunes account upon subscription.
Renewal: Apple's iTunes account will be charged within 24 hours prior to expiration.
Unsubscribe:
Solution 1: Open the App Store on your phone, tap the blue avatar icon in the upper right corner, then go to "Subscriptions" -> "Fundstrat Direct" to cancel.
Solution 2: Subscriptions will automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Privacy Policy: https://fundstratdirect.com/privacy-policy/
Terms of Use: https://fundstratdirect.com/terms-and-conditions/

bluejetty:00040563:ios.description:
Homage is your one-stop solution for a holistic range of home and community-based healthcare services.
We currently operate in Singapore, Malaysia and Australia, and have delivered over one million caregiving hours since we started in 2016. Our mission is to care where you are, and enable wellness and recovery through holistic personal care.
Our diverse team of highly qualified care professionals includes caregivers, nurses and therapists who are committed to supporting your healthcare needs, 24/7, wherever you are.
Here are some ways we can support you and your loved ones needs:
- Personal Care including assistance with activities of daily living for the elderly and those requiring disability support
- Nursing Care including procedures such as wound care, stoma care, NGT feeding and change
- Therapy including physiotherapy, speech therapy and occupational therapy (for Singapore and Malaysia)
Here are some reasons families prefer Homage:
- Personalised Care Plans: We can help create a care plan catered to your needs and choices
- Dedicated Care Professionals: Receive quality care from a pool of curated and experienced Care Professionals
- Detailed Care Reports: Receive a visit summary after every visit so you are updated with the care your loved ones have received
- Zero Commitment: Book flexible care solutions from 1 hour with no ongoing commitment required
- Transparent Pricing: Know the exact cost of service before booking a visit
- Prepaid Packages: Achieve cost savings with our long term packages that offer the same quality care at a lower cost
Our services are currently available in:
- Singapore
- Malaysia: Kuala Lumpur, Johor Bahru, Penang and Perak
- Australia: Melbourne, Perth, Adelaide
Find out more about Homage at www.homage.co

bluejetty:00148559:ios.description:
Need to flip a coin? Can't find any change? Or just looking for the most realistic and engaging coin flip app out there? Look no further! Coin Simulator brings the timeless tradition of the coin toss into the 21st century with unparalleled realism and fun.
Forget flat, static animations. Immerse yourself in a truly authentic coin flip experience with stunning 3D graphics, crisp sound effects, and vibrations that mimic a real coin toss. Every outcome is physics-based, influenced by the speed and direction of your swipe, making results genuinely random and satisfyingly unpredictable. Simply swipe your finger across the screen, or even flick your phone upwards, to launch your chosen coin into the air – just like the real thing!
Tired of the same old penny? Explore an extensive collection of iconic coins from around the globe and different eras. From ancient treasures to modern marvels, find your perfect coin to flip. Yes, you can even flip a Bitcoin! Personalize your coin tossing environment with a variety of customizable floors and backgrounds to set the perfect scene for your next big decision.
Whether you're settling a friendly debate, making a tough choice, or just need a reliable randomizer, Coin Simulator is your go-to coin flip solution. No more arguments about fairness – let our realistic physics-based coin flip decide!
Download Coin Simulator for free and start flipping coins today! The app is ad-supported. For an uninterrupted, ad-free experience, unlock all premium content – every coin, every background, every floor, and exclusive features – with a single, one-time purchase to upgrade to Coin Simulator Plus!

bluejetty:00144641:ios.description:
Experience the true power of a portable document scanner on the go with this PDF Scanner app for iPhone. Digitally archive important documents by scanning receipts, invoices, books, contracts, business cards, ID cards, passports, and QR codes, then convert them into high-quality, multipage PDFs.
The intelligent OCR technology recognizes text from scanned images with pinpoint accuracy, making it easy to extract, edit, and share content in seconds.
Key Features of PDF Scanner:
- Support for scanning with a flashlight in low-light conditions
- Scan documents, QR codes, ID cards, and Passports
- Import images via Photo Library, Dropbox, and Wi-Fi sync
- Crop, apply filters, correct, or change the orientation of scanned copies
- Choose from multiple scan filters, including Magic, B&W, Invert, and more
- Inbuilt OCR technology for text recognition and extraction
- Electronic signature support
- Add text to scanned documents
- Compress PDFs to reduce file size
- Lock PDFs with password protection
- Reorder pages in multi-page PDFs
- Scan and export documents as JPG, PDF, DOC, TXT, XLS, Long Image, or in ZIPs
- Convert PDFs to JPG, DOC, TXT, XLS, or a Long Image
- Share scanned documents via Mail, iMessage, and more in just a few steps
Document Scanner
This document scanner app features a smart algorithm for accurate edge detection and low-light scanning. For even better results, manually adjust borders, orientation, and enhance your scans with professional filters, including Magic, B&W, Grayscale, Invert, Color Pop, Vintage, and Crisp Scan.
Advanced OCR & PDF Tools
Optical Character Recognition (OCR) accurately recognizes text from scanned documents and images, making it editable in seconds. Extract text, save documents as TXT files, or cut, copy, and share selected text. Compress large files, lock sensitive PDFs, reorder pages, and convert PDFs to JPG, DOC, TXT, XLS, or Long Image formats. Add text to annotate or complete your documents.
QR Code, ID Card & Passport Scanner
Scan QR codes instantly or create clear digital copies of ID cards and passports. Capture pages with your camera or import images from your Photo Library, then merge multiple scans into a single PDF. It's the perfect PDF scanner and PDF maker for personal and small business use.
Cloud Import & Electronic Signature
Access images stored in cloud services like Dropbox and scan them into PDFs with ease. Complete contracts, forms, invoices, and other important documents by adding your electronic signature, all within a single app.
Keep Files Organized
Create unlimited folders to organize your scanned documents and papers. Label folders according to your workflow and quickly find important files whenever you need them.
Auto-Renewable Subscription Terms:
Subscribe to get unrestricted access to all the features outlined above.

• You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your account settings on the App Store.
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
