bluejetty:00141986:ios.description:
Embark on a Scavenger Hunt with Seek & Find: Hidden Object Game! 
Dive into a fun puzzle hidden object game with intrigue and excitement in Seek & Find: Hidden Object Game, where keen eyes and quick wits reign supreme. This scavenger hunt game invites players of all ages to find hidden objects through beautifully crafted scenes, exploring maps and secrets skillfully concealed within. With a blend of charm and challenge, this fun hidden object game is designed to captivate, entertain, and test your observational skills like never before!
 Dazzling Features Await: 
- Varied and Vibrant Levels: Each level is a masterpiece, designed with unique themes ranging from enchanted forests to bustling beaches. Objects cleverly hidden in plain sight await your discovery.
- Countless Hidden Wonders: Prepare to be amazed by the diversity of objects hidden across our levels! From the whimsical to the everyday, your task is to spot all hidden objects. Our dynamic scenes mean you'll never tire of finding new and unexpected objects.
- Modes for Every Mood: Whether you're in the mood for a leisurely search or a race against the clock, Seek & Find: Hidden Object Game offers a variety of modes to suit your playstyle.
- Unlockable Objects: Your prowess in finding hidden objects will be rewarded! Unlock exclusive content, including daily challenges, bonus levels, and special puzzles.
- Expansive World to Explore: Journey through an ever-expanding universe of maps, from mystical realms to historical wonders. Each location is packed with hidden objects and vibrant detail, offering endless exploration and discovery.
 Why Seek & Find: Hidden Object Game is Your Next Adventure:
- Explore Diverse Worlds: Immerse yourself in a variety of enchanting environments, each with its own set of hidden objects. From the depths of the ocean to the heights of Sky City, every scavenger hunt promises a new adventure.
- Sharpen Your Mind: This hidden object game is not only about fun; it's also a fantastic way to improve your attention to detail, concentration, and observation skills. Challenge yourself to find every hidden object.
- Helpful Hints and Tools: Stuck on a particularly tricky hidden object? Use our hint system to guide you to your next hidden object. Zoom features and swipe controls make searching not just easy, but part of the fun.
 Join the Quest Today: 
Seek & Find: Hidden Object Game is more than a hidden object game; it's a voyage through a universe of wonder, challenges, and maps. Perfect for players seeking to test their observation skills, enjoy a rich narrative, and lose themselves in the beauty of discovery. Ready to prove your prowess and unravel the secrets hidden in plain sight? Download now and let the scavenger hunt begin!
Embark on this captivating scavenger hunt and discover why Seek & Find: Hidden Object Game is your next unmissable adventure in the realm of hidden objects. Your scavenger hunt to uncover the unseen starts now!

bluejetty:00069607:ios.description:
Vont is a simple app that allows you to add text to videos. 
・ More than 400 fonts are available. 
・ You can install other fonts. 
・ Text size is changeable. 
・ Text color is changeable. 
・ Text gradient is changeable. 
・ Text's stroke color is changeable. 
・ Text's shadow color is changeable. 
・ Text's background color is changeable. 
・ Text is rotatable. 
・ Text kerning is changeable. 
・ Line spacing is changeable. 
・ Curved text 
・ URL scheme: vont:// 
Try Phonto app, if you want to add text to photos. Phonto is a free app that is available on the App Store.
--------------------------------
LANGUAGE
--------------------------------
Vont supports only English (US), Chinese and Japanese, so when the priority of Chinese (or Japanese) in your setting was higher than English, Vont would be launched as Chinese (or Japanese) mode.
To solve this problem…
1. Open the Settings app.
2. Choose 'English' in 'General' > 'Language & Region' > 'iPhone Language'.
3. Turn back your 'iPhone Language' to your favorite language.
-------------------------------- 
HOW TO INSTALL FONTS 
-------------------------------- 
Using iTunes, you can copy font files between your computer and Vont on your iOS device. 
1. Select your iOS device from the Devices section of iTunes. 
2. Click the Apps tab and scroll down to the bottom of the page. 
3. Select "Vont" in the "File Sharing" section. 
4. Drag and drop .ttf or .otf font files into "Documents". 
5. Restart Vont. 
More detail about how to install fonts.
https://vont.phon.to/install_fonts

bluejetty:00167933:ios.description:
A personal trainer in your pocket. Workouts for every device and from anywhere. Fitness made simple. You hit "play" and we'll guide you through.
Enjoy strength training, HIIT, cardio, and recovery workouts on your own time and on any device. New workouts each week, all year long. No matter your goals, we have the plan for you. Made with moms in mind for all stages of motherhood. Pregnancy and postnatal guides included.
Come sweat with head trainer, Meg Miles, and join the Wilma Fit community of women who are committing to themselves, taking control of their health and fitness, and strengthening themselves from the inside out.
HOW TO GET STARTED:
1. Download the free Wilma Fit app
2. Sign into the Wilma Fit app securely with your login information
3. Access your workouts and get moving
WHAT YOU'LL FIND WITH THE WILMA FIT APP:
FITNESS and WORKOUTS
HOME PLAN: (plans starting at $9.99/month)
-6 total at-home workouts (20-40 min) each week in both video and written form. You hit "play" and let head trainer Meg Miles guide you through.
-Minimal equipment required: 5 and 10 lb. dumbbells, a heavy resistance band, and a chair/step.
-Follow-along workout videos
GYM PLAN: (plans starting at $9.99/month)
-Go at your own pace with head trainer Meg Miles' gym workouts.
-6 total gym workouts (60 min.) each week in both video and written form.
-Video demonstrations of all exercises to give you confidence.
-Easy-to-follow instructions.
PREGNANCY GUIDE: (plans starting at $12.99/month)
-New pregnancy-safe workouts each week programmed by a pre/post natal fitness specialist and trainer.
-Guiding you from week 13 (second trimester) to week 40 (delivery) of your pregnancy.
-At-home and/or gym pregnancy options.
-Access to head trainer Meg Miles' pregnancy tips and motivation along the way to help you feel your strongest through pregnancy, delivery, and recovery.
ALL PLANS INCLUDE:
-Effectively programmed, tested, and designed for strength, muscle hypertrophy, and endurance.
-Modifiable for any fitness level and easy to follow.
-Programmed for you each week in a total body split to maximize your efforts and lead to greater results.
-A recommended schedule given to you each week.
-Workout tracker to help you reach your goals.
-Join challenges and reach your goals with the Wilma community.
-Access to an additional database of workouts for when you don’t have much time.
· MOTIVATION
A motivational message or workout/nutritional tip each week, giving you just what you need to keep working toward your goals.
· WILMA FIT CHALLENGES
Earn daily medals as you complete mini challenges to keep you motivated along with the Wilma Fit community.
· PROGRESS
Track your progress each week with the workouts you've completed, input your own workouts, and keep a calendar to refer back to.
· WHAT OUR USERS ARE SAYING:
"I'm loving it so far! Things I love:
1. That I can see and hear that you're working hard at the same time as me! It's not just a bunch of "moves" thrown together by an algorithm, like an app I previously subscribed to -- that trainer didn't shed one drop of sweat.
2. The variety! Other [programs] I've tried have been super repetitive.
3. The encouragement! My favorite line so far: 'You can do hard things.'
4. It's challenging! I'm burning more calories than other workouts of the same length."- K.D.
"I found Meg’s app and I have NOT looked back!! She guides you through workouts and has given me such a love for movement and my body postpartum that I never thought I’d have again. I have begun moving just for the love of it and not for what I can get out of it. While I’ve gained muscle definition and lost weight, the greatest thing I’ve gained is self-love and appreciation for a body that is healthy and can move! I cannot recommend this app enough and I look forward to many more months with Meg!" -T.C.
Terms and Conditions: https://www.wilmafit.com/terms-and-conditions
Privacy Policy: https://www.wilmafit.com/privacy

bluejetty:00073383:ios.name: Agapé: Feel Close When Apart
bluejetty:00073383:ios.summary: Using Agapé is as easy as answering just one question a day, but with a new person each time. Each question is based on decades of research and chosen specifically for you. Agapé’s questions are fun, exciting, and sometimes even spicey! But
bluejetty:00073383:ios.description:
Using Agapé is as easy as answering just one question a day, but with a new person each time. Each question is based on decades of research and chosen specifically for you. Agapé’s questions are fun, exciting, and sometimes even spicey! But don’t worry, we will only send a spicy question if you're matched with your partner.
Our questions will be personalized to your relationships. So you would get a different question with your mom than you would a friend or partner. Additionally, you’re only able to see each other’s response, once you have both responded.
Although Agapé is easy and only takes a minute a day, it has a tremendous effect on relationships. 97% of users that we’ve surveyed report Agapé positively affecting their relationships.
In addition to the personalization done by our question algorithm, you can further personalize your experience by opting into dozens of optional categories. Such as:
- LONG DISTANCE RELATIONSHIP
Example: What do you miss most about your partner when you are not together?
- RECONNECTING
Example: Share a small accomplishment you've made recently that you're proud of yourself for achieving.
- CHECKING IN 
Example: What do you currently wish you had more time for?
- ENGAGED
Example: If you could make a special wedding vow to your partner that only he or she would hear, what would it be?
- RELIGIOUS
Example: What is a book, reading, passage or verse that had a profound impact on your own path?
- MANAGING FINANCES
Example: What are some of your biggest financial goals or aspirations?
- PARENTING
Example: What is one of the ways your partner really impresses you as a parent?
- PREGNANCY
Example: What are you most excited about after the baby comes?
And more!
WHY AGAPÉ?
Agapé [ah-gah-pay] is a Greek word for unconditional love. At Agapé we believe love is everything. It’s the foundation of all things good in humanity, the catalyst for societal progress, and the nucleus of human desire. That’s why we’ve created a relationship wellness app to make it easy for you to feel + show love.
WHAT IS RELATIONSHIP WELLNESS?
Relationship wellness is the process of actively shifting your mindset, making choices, and pursuing activities to strengthen and enrich your relationships, both romantic, familial, and platonic.
A common misconception is that relationship wellness is best suited for those who are experiencing some sort of dysfunction. But just like the gym isn't exclusive to individuals who are out of shape, relationship wellness should never be limited to individuals who have relationship issues.
Everyone should be actively practicing relationship wellness. Agapé makes it both easy AND fun.
IS AGAPÉ FREE?
Agapé is free to download and free to use. You can answer thousands of questions for free! However, there are premium categories that you can access with a subscription.
If you choose to start a premium subscription, it helps support our small team, our relationship wellness research, and our app development.
Agapé Premium plan payments will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage or turn off auto-renew in your Account settings at any time after purchase.
Terms of Use: https://www.getdailyagape.com/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://www.getdailyagape.com/privacy

bluejetty:00178251:ios.description:
Unwind with Art Story: Jigsaw Art Puzzle, a free, relaxing and beautifully curated experience where classic literature and captivating hand-drawn art puzzles merge. This isn’t just a game; it’s a journey through a novel approach to jigsaw puzzles, a relaxing retreat for art lovers, and a celebration of timeless stories.
Enchanting Features for Relaxation:
- Jigsaw Puzzles meet Coloring: Engage with over 1,200 uniquely designed jigsaw puzzles, each piece a part of a beautiful, hand-drawn picture. Find peace in every slot filled and delight in the serene sense of accomplishment with each completed picture.
- Coloring with a Twist: Revel in the joy of coloring, blending your artistic flair into hand-drawn beautiful art works, and witness your art spring to life with calming animations - a testament to the aesthetic charm of Art Story.
- Classic Literature Immersion: Immerse yourself in the narrative depths of classic novels, each jigsaw puzzle unravelling a piece of beloved stories, lovingly retold with touches of elegance and simplicity while staying true to the classic originals.
- Calming Visuals and Anti-stress Gameplay: Free your mind with an anti-stress adventure jigsaw game designed for tranquility. Our puzzle animations are a calming balm, soothing your senses with every art piece you complete.
- Hand-picked Soundtracks: Each puzzle is complemented by curated music, complementary hand-picked to match the story's mood, enhancing your immersive experience within this free jigsaw puzzle game.
- Collect and Solve: Earn Ink Drops coins to unlock novel puzzles and stories. Collect all the cards and build your own novel library as you advance.
- Hand-drawn Stories to Life: Every puzzle tells a story. Beautiful, hand-drawn scenes from classic novels invite you to a world of aesthetic storytelling - a relaxing escape into stories that shape our culture.
- Daily Challenges and Beautiful Rewards: Face new puzzles with our Daily Challenges, each a chance to add more beautiful, hand-drawn artwork to your collection. Unwind with our Daily Challenges and find solace in the art of stress relief.
With Art Story: Jigsaw Art Puzzle game, enrich your daily routine with a curated selection of relaxing puzzles, coloring pages, and hand-drawn stories. This game is a escape haven designed to provide stress relief and enrich your life with art and classic narratives.
Ready to craft your peace? Download ""Art Story: Jigsaw Art Puzzle"" now and let your daily stresses melt away with every piece placed. Your journey into the art of relaxation awaits!
===
Information about the auto-renewal of subscription:
This is an auto-renewable subscription. A subscription is valid for 1 week, or 1 month, depending on the subscription type selected.
- Payment will be changed to the user's iTunes Account upon confirmation of purchase.
- The subscription will automatically renew every week unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current payment period. If auto-renew remains active during that time, the user's account will be charged.
- Subscription can be managed by the user; auto-renewal can be turned off in the user's iTunes Account Settings after purchase.
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. The cost depends on the selected plan.
For more information, please refer to our Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.
- Privacy Policy: [https://artstory.helpdocsonline.com/privacy](https://artstory.helpdocsonline.com/privacy)
- Terms of Use: [https://artstory.helpdocsonline.com/terms](https://artstory.helpdocsonline.com/terms)

- محاكاة الواقع العيادي
bluejetty:00162283:ios.description:
فامكير منصة افتراضية تغنيك عن العيادات النفسية ومراكز الإرشاد الزواجي، أخصائيين مرّخصين لتقديم الخدمات الاستشارية بخصوصية عالية ورسوم رمزية من مكانك ومتى ماتفضّل!
نقدم في منصة فامكير عدد من القيم المضافة للعملاء:
- محاكاة الواقع العيادي كعيادة افتراضية.
- الإتاحة في تقديم خدمات المنصة في أي وقت ومن أي مكان.
- الخصوصية العالية والسرية التامة لجميع التعاملات داخل المنصة.
- جميع الأخصائيين من النُخبة المعتمدين من الجهات المختصة.
- جميع الخدمات بأسعار تنافسية بمتناول الجميع.
ما يميز منصة فامكير في تقديم خدماتها هو:
- حرية الاختيار في الجلسات ( صوتية أو نصية أو مرئية).
- سهولة حجز الاستشارات أما فورية أو مجدولة.
- سهولة الدفع بتعدد وسائل الدفع وخياراته سواءً ( الدفع لمره واحدة أو الدفع بالتقسيط ).
- تجربة المستخدم سهلة وتثري التجربة.
الاعتمادات والرخص من الجهات المختصة:
- عيادة نفسية معتمدة من وزارة الصحة.
- شركة مجتمعية معتمدة من الهيئة العامة للمنشآت الصغيرة والمتوسطة.
- احدى مبادرات مجلس شؤون الأسرة المشرف على المنصة.
- احدى مبادرات جامعة الأميرة نورة للاستثمار المجتمعي.

bluejetty:00016585:ios.summary: Hey Farmer! On this day, you will meet Jane and her new family farm, which she just bought. Jane's Farm is a whole klondike of treasures and adventures that await you. A real, big, golden farm! Together with Jane, you will build a new, larg
bluejetty:00016585:ios.description:
Hey Farmer! On this day, you will meet Jane and her new family farm, which she just bought. Jane's Farm is a whole klondike of treasures and adventures that await you. A real, big, golden farm! Together with Jane, you will build a new, large and beautiful farm. Her whole big family will help you, too! 
Grandma is a real needlewoman, she knows how to care for various types of plants and will teach you well! She knows everything about the vegetable garden, fields, orchards, and crops. 
Grandpa is an experienced strategist as far as selling of various types of products and crops goes. He knows with whom it is profitable to trade, as well as how to establish contacts with business partners around the world. He will help you transform your farm into a real treasure island! 
Jane's husband always provides real support and protection! He is a jack of all trades, and he knows how to construct buildings. Build a real farm villa for Jane! He knows how to repair animal enclosures, extract stone, cut wood, and he can teach you all about this!

Nation is the ultimate solution for restaurant owners and operators, unifying HR, training, and employee management into one powerful app. Streamline your operations, enhance team efficiency, and keep your business running smoothly—all from the palm of your hand.
Say goodbye to fragmented systems and hello to seamless management with Nation’s robust features.
Key Features:
 • Effortless Onboarding: Manage the onboarding process for your entire team with ease. From headshots to emergency contacts, Nation simplifies getting your employees up and running, even if you’re onboarding hundreds at a time.
 • Comprehensive Training Tracking: Keep tabs on your employees’ training progress. Whether they’re mastering the grill or learning the ropes at the register, you’ll always know who’s trained on what.
 • Proficiency Scoring: Assess your team’s skills with our intuitive proficiency scoring system. Rate employees from one to three stars based on their performance in various roles.
 • Employee Ratings: Gain deeper insights into your team’s strengths with detailed ratings. Managers can evaluate employee aptitude for key positions like cook, cashier, and more.
 • General Notes: Keep everyone on the same page by adding notes to employee profiles. Share kudos, provide feedback, or leave important information for other managers to see.
 • Essential HR Tools: Nation includes built-in HR features like corrective action management. Lock down an employee’s app until they’ve reviewed necessary actions, ensuring accountability and clear communication.
Why Choose Nation?
Nation is more than just an app—it’s your comprehensive solution for managing every aspect of your restaurant’s workforce. By combining HR, training, proficiency tracking, and employee management into one platform, Nation streamlines your operations, saving you time and resources.

listings.description:
Find words hidden in the grid. Similar to classic word search game except the words are not hidden on straight lines. It is simple yet challenging and even more fun with online scoreboard feature on Game Center.

Word Find is a free and popular word game, enjoy it!

Challenge your brain with this puzzle app and improve your brain power!

Features:
- Online leaderboard
- Compete with your friends
- Almost infinite number of random word puzzles
- Supports tablets and all screen sizes

Achieve the highest scores and compete with your friends and also other Word Search Puzzle fans!

There are list of words hidden in the 5X5 grid. Your aim is to find these words as quickly as possible.

Score is calculated based on the length of the found words and the elapsed time. When you find all the words in the puzzle, the score is sent to the online scoreboard on Game Center. You can see the best players daily, weekly or for all times.

If you do not prefer to sign in with Game Center, you can still play the game in offline mode but your score is not submitted to online scoreboard in this case.

Have fun everyone!

bluejetty:00160226:ios.description:
Learn hand embroidery at your own pace, one stitch at a time. Follow along with video lessons and guided courses that take you from your very first stitch to a finished piece you made by hand.
Video Lessons by Stitch and Technique
Browse embroidery videos organized by stitch type, technique or project, so you can find exactly the lesson you need - running stitch, back stitch, stem, satin, chain or French knots.
Guided Courses
Follow guided lessons that teach embroidery stitches and techniques step by step. Pause, rewind and practise as often as you like; nothing moves faster than you do.
Save Your Favorites
Save the lessons you come back to most, so your current project is always one tap away.
Community
Catch up on the latest trending content and see what other stitchers are making.
Articles
Read embroidery tips, tutorials and guides - practical reading for when you are between projects or planning your next one.
Hand embroidery is a quiet, tactile hobby, and this app is built to match it. Start with a simple motif, learn the stitches that make it work, and build up to flowers, lettering, names and cross stitch designs you can wear, frame or give away.
Every stitching lesson suits beginners and improvers alike - no prior needlework experience needed. The embroidery designs you learn to make are yours to keep, whatever color thread you reach for.

bluejetty:00179261:ios.description:
smrtPhone is a full featured, cloud based phone system that allows you to make more calls, send more texts, and close more deals. With smrtPhone, your phone system becomes a fully integrated part of your CRM, accelerating your sales cycle, and improving customer relationships. With no forced long-term contracts, a powerful 4-line auto-dialer, advanced Pro features, and pay-as-you-go pricing, smrtPhone is the clear choice for sales-driven businesses. 
Now you can bring power of smrtPhone to your mobile device. 
Use the smrtPhone Mobile App to: 
> Sync your full CRM contact lists so every contact is available from your handheld device
> Send text messages (SMS and MMS) to any contact and have it automatically log in your CRM
> Make and receive calls and have call data effortlessly tracked, including call recordings 
> Take notes during/after your call and have them automatically sync to the contact record
> Choose from existing call dispositions to mark call outcomes and trigger CRM automations
> Easily switch between phone number Caller IDs to ensure you call from the correct phone line
> Access your text and voicemail inboxes for individual users and groups
> Sync call information (including recent call logs) across platforms, web and mobile
IMPORTANT: 
smrtPhone’s mobile app requires an existing smrtPhone account. 
DISCLAIMERS: 
Call quality can be affected by the strength of your internet/4G/5G/LTE connection. Please ensure you have a strong signal or internet connection to achieve best results. 
Emergency calling may not be available for your number or region.

bluejetty:00121290:ios.description:
Escape to an island getaway filled with adventure, mystery, and fun new mini games from the makers of FarmVille, the number one farming franchise! Play this colorful free-to-play game, now available for iPhone, iPad, and iMessage app.
 Build your very own beachside inn complete with island workshops, tropical crops, and exotic animals. Farm island fruits like pineapples, coconuts, and mangos to delight your guests. Craft delicious recipes and rare goods like piña coladas, grilled fish, and flower leis. 
 Catch fish with Capri the dolphin and explore with Odney the playful monkey! Feed tasty treats to the cute, playful animals on your island to get unique photo ops for your guests. Story-based quests help you explore uncharted areas, learn more about your island and find rare items and goods. 
 Adventure unfolds all around your island! 
 ESCAPE TO THE TROPICS 
 - Seek adventures on your very own tropical island 
 - Farm unique fruits and veggies, craft fun drinks and meet adorable animals 
 - Discover all of the tropical crops and exotic animals that call your island home 
 - Run a beachside inn and start a new life in paradise 
 - Play mini games and have fun with new characters like Ting 
 UNCOVER MYSTERY, SECRETS AND TREASURES 
 - Complete story-based quests with island guides like the archaeologist and surfing expert 
 - Explore the bubbling volcano and ancient monkey temple 
 - Discover hidden treasures and rare goods in the secret chamber 
 - Investigate uncharted areas to find even more island secrets 
 BUILD AMENITIES FOR YOUR GUESTS 
 - Fix up island workshops and create your own personal paradise 
 - Buy a Tiki Bar, Sushi Stand, Artisan Workshop and more 
 - Expand your inn and hire guides to help your guests enjoy the island 
 DISCOVER AND PHOTOGRAPH ADORABLE ANIMALS FOR REWARDS 
 - Build a Wildlife Center on your island with the help of Ting, the wildlife guide
 - Attract rare and exotic animals to your island like the colorful Iguana by feeding them treats 
 - Earn rewards by snapping photos of the animals as souvenirs for your guests 
 TRADE WITH OTHER ISLANDS 
 - Trade with other players using the trade boat 
 - Short on eggs? Buy the goods you need from neighboring islands 
 - Have too many pineapples? Name your price and sell off extra crops and crafts 
 - The more coins you have, the more you can do on your island 
 Escape to a shimmering world of sunshine, adventure and fun in FarmVille: Tropic Escape! Download today and start building your island paradise!

bluejetty:00015529:ios.description:
Nihongo is an offline Japanese dictionary, picture-to-text translator, flashcard app, and reading assistant.
Our app helps you learn Japanese naturally, using the words you encounter in daily life—on menus, signs, manga, emails, books, and more. In addition to the dictionary, you can take a picture of Japanese text or paste it from any source. Nihongo will then translate the text, add furigana or romaji, and create flashcards so you can study and steadily build your vocabulary.
Here are the complete features of the app:
DICTIONARY
* Over 200,000 words, 205,000 example sentences, and 6000 kanji entries.
* Every word clearly marked as common, uncommon, or rare.
* Add your own notes to any dictionary entry.
* Quickly identify transitive/intransitive word pairs.
* Audio pronunciations of words and example sentences (Requires Nihongo Pro)
PHOTO LOOKUP (OCR) [Pro]
* Look up words just by taking a picture.
* Uses Google Cloud Vision to provide high-quality text recognition.
* Just tap on a word to look it up.
CLIPPINGS (READING ASSISTANT) [Pro]
* Adds furigana or romaji to text pasted into the app.
* Tap on any word to see its definition without leaving the clipping.
* Flashcard deck automatically created so you can study the new words in a clipping.
* Display text horizontally or vertically.
* Have Nihongo read any clipping out loud.
FLASHCARDS [Pro]
* Flashcards automatically generated from words you lookup in the dictionary or paste into the app.
* Nihongo learns what words you know, and won't bother you again with words you've mastered.
* Built-in kanji flashcard decks up through Middle School.
* Intuitive spaced repetition flashcard system for vocabulary and kanji drawing.
* Level up flashcards by studying every day.
* No penalty for missing a day of study, come back anytime.
SEARCH
* Search using English, Japanese, or romaji.
* Supports searching for conjugated words in both English and Japanese.
* Search for kanji using radicals and stroke counts.
SAFARI EXTENSION [Pro]
* Add furigana or romaji to webpages.
* Tap on words to see definition within Safari.
Nihongo Pro Terms of Use
Read our full Terms of Service at https://nihongo-app.com/terms_of_use.html.
This app is only possible because of the JMDict (edrdg.org) and Tatoeba (tatoeba.org) projects. I highly encourage you to support these incredible projects that make apps like Nihongo possible!

bluejetty:00145106:ios.summary:

Choose from classic four-player partnership Euchre and three-player cutt
bluejetty:00145106:ios.description:
Whether you’re a seasoned pro or learning Euchre for the first time, Euchre – Expert AI is a great way to play, learn, and master this classic trick-taking card game.
Choose from classic four-player partnership Euchre and three-player cutthroat Euchre, where each player competes individually.
Learn smarter, play better, and master Euchre with powerful AI partners and opponents, plus in-depth analysis tools. Play anytime, even offline. Customization options let you enjoy your favorite rules.
CHALLENGING AND ENJOYABLE FOR ALL
New to Euchre?
Learn as you play with the NeuralPlay AI, which offers real-time suggestions to guide your moves. Build your skills hands-on, explore strategies, and master decision-making in a single-player experience that teaches you every step of the game.
Already an expert?
Challenge yourself against six levels of advanced AI opponents designed to test your skills, sharpen your strategy, and make every game exciting, competitive, and rewarding.
KEY FEATURES
Learn and Improve
• AI guidance: Receive real-time insights whenever your plays differ from the AI’s choices.
• Built-in card counter: Strengthen your counting and strategic decision-making.
• Trick-by-trick review: Analyze every move in detail to sharpen your gameplay.
• Replay hand: Review and replay previous deals to practice and improve.
Convenience and Control
• Offline play: Enjoy the game anytime, even without an internet connection.
• Undo: Quickly correct mistakes and refine your strategy.
• Hints: Get helpful suggestions when you’re unsure of your next move.
• Claim remaining tricks: End the hand early when your cards are unbeatable.
• Skip hand: Move past hands you’d rather not play.
Progression and Customization
• Six AI levels: From beginner-friendly to expert-challenging.
• Detailed statistics: Track your performance and progress.
• Customization: Personalize the look with color themes and card decks.
RULE CUSTOMIZATIONS
Explore a wide variety of ways to play with customizable rule options, including:
• Players: Play with a partner in four-player Euchre or compete individually in three-player cutthroat.
• Joker (Benny) support: Play with the Joker or the Two of Spades as the highest trump.
• Deck size: Choose a 24-, 28-, or 32-card deck.
• Stick the dealer: Decide if the dealer must choose trump when it isn’t determined on the second round of bidding.
• Canadian loner: Optionally require the dealer’s partner to play alone when accepting in the first round.
• Going under: Swap three or more 9s and 10s from your hand with the kitty.
• Need suit to call it: Require that players have a suit in hand to select it as trump.
• First lead when alone: Choose who leads when playing alone.
• Face-up card: Decide who receives the face-up card after bidding.
• Misdeal: Select from multiple misdeal rules, including Ace No Face and No Ace No Face (farmer’s hand).
• Super Euchre: Defenders earn four points for capturing all tricks.
• Call for Best (Partner's Best): Allow a player going alone to swap their worst card for their partner's best card before play begins.
• Maker needs: Customize the minimum number of tricks the makers must capture to successfully make their bid.
• Alone march score: Adjust whether taking all five tricks while playing alone is worth 2, 3, or 4 points.
• Alone must take all tricks: Require the alone player to win every single trick to fulfill the contract, otherwise resulting in a euchre.
DOWNLOAD TODAY
Play, learn, and master Euchre – Expert AI. Enjoy a single-player Euchre experience designed for practice, strategy, or casual play. Whether you want to improve your skills or relax with an offline card game, play your way with a smart AI partner and opponents, customizable rules, and a fresh challenge every game.

bluejetty:00098038:ios.description:
MyCuteBaby ~ AI Baby Generator is the fun, heartwarming, and surprisingly realistic app that lets you glimpse the future by generating adorable AI-powered baby photos from two parent images. Whether you’re a couple curious about your potential child, a friend group playing around with fun predictions, or simply fascinated by genetics and facial blending, this app offers a beautifully crafted and intelligent experience for users of all backgrounds.
Using cutting-edge facial recognition and generative AI technology, MyCuteBaby takes two faces—whether it’s you and your partner, two celebrities, or even two friends—and creates a highly realistic image of what their baby might look like. It’s fast, easy, private, and surprisingly accurate, with customizable age stages and appearance settings to make the results even more exciting.
Imagine Your Future Family
Curious about what your baby might look like with your partner? Wondering if your little one might have your eyes or your partner’s smile? Our proprietary AI model blends facial features from both input photos to generate lifelike baby images. Choose from various baby age stages—from newborns to toddlers—for even more realistic predictions.
Advanced AI, Simple Experience
Behind the scenes, MyCuteBaby uses advanced deep learning models for facial feature extraction, skin tone blending, hair simulation, and more. But you won’t need to worry about any of that. The experience is designed to be intuitive and seamless. Just upload two clear photos and let the app work its magic.
Customize and Share
You can personalize the look of your AI baby with gender options, skin tone adjustments, age settings, and even background themes. Once your baby is generated, save it to your photo library or share it with friends and family directly from the app. Whether it’s for laughs, love, or just curiosity, MyCuteBaby brings joy to every generation.
Key Features:
Note: Some of the below give features are only available after taking paid subscription plan.
Generate realistic baby photos using two parent images
Choose baby gender and age range for more customized results
Explore facial feature blending with powerful generative AI
Adjust skin tone, hairstyle, and facial structure sensitivity
High-quality image output with fast rendering times
Save or share your AI baby photos directly from the app
Use celebrity photos, historical figures, or fictional characters for fun combinations
Secure processing with on-device image handling and optional private mode
Sleek and user-friendly interface designed for all age groups
Regular updates and improvements based on user feedback
Who Is This App For?
Couples imagining their future family
Newlyweds and parents-to-be
Friends looking for a fun, photo-based game
Creators and influencers seeking fun content ideas
Curious minds fascinated by how features mix and match
Anyone who enjoys personalization and AI-powered creativity
Why MyCuteBaby ~ AI Baby Generator?
Unlike many baby face apps that offer cartoonish or unrealistic outputs, MyCuteBaby is designed to deliver genuinely lifelike results using advanced AI modeling. Our development team includes AI researchers, designers, and even child psychologists to ensure the generated images feel authentic, wholesome, and fun. Whether you're using it as a couple’s bonding moment or just having fun with friends, the app is designed to make you smile.

bluejetty:00036135:ios.description:
Discover the Ultimate Ranking Experience – Anytime, Anywhere!
Want to spice up your time with friends, family, or even on social media? Ranking Master is the #1 app where creativity meets fun! Dive into viral ranking trends, challenge your friends and express your unique preferences like never before.
Whether you’re ranking your favorite hugs, the best food, or the funniest habits, Ranking Master transforms every idea into a personalized, shareable video. It’s easy, interactive, and endlessly entertaining!
Why Choose Ranking Master?
Trending Topics: Rank what’s hot today! From favorite songs, dream vacations, funniest memes, to nostalgic childhood memories.
Your Rules, Your Way: Create custom ranking challenges or join global trends—it’s your call!
Effortless Sharing: Save and share your rankings directly to TikTok, Instagram, or Snapchat.
Interactive Fun: See how your rankings compare with others and spark fun debates with friends!
Engage with Friends: Play with your squad and laugh your way through hilarious ranking battles.
Go Viral: Turn your rankings into social media trends—be the next big content creator!
Connect Globally: Join a global ranking community and explore the preferences of people around the world.
How It Works
Choose a Topic: Select from trending challenges or create your own.
Rank It Your Way: Drag and drop items to arrange them in your order of preference.
Save & Share: Turn your rankings into videos and share them across your favorite platforms.
Features That Make Us Stand Out
Daily Challenges: Fresh ranking topics every day to keep the fun going!
Custom Rankings: Add a personal touch by creating your own filters and topics.
Social Comparisons: Discover how your rankings align with the world—or completely stand out!
User-Friendly Design: Designed for effortless fun, perfect for anyone and everyone.
Ready to Rank Like a Pro?
Download Ranking Master now and start creating unforgettable ranking moments!

bluejetty:00120577:ios.description:
Explore the night sky and discover stars, planets, galaxies, constellations, satellites, and other fascinating objects in space. Point your device toward the sky and use an intuitive experience to identify celestial objects, explore their positions, and learn more about the universe around you.
• **Explore the Sky in 3D** 
Interact with stars and planets in an immersive 3D view. Move your fingers across the screen to explore the galaxy and discover fascinating astronomical objects.
• **Identify Stars & Planets** 
Learn the names and details of stars, planets, constellations, satellites, and other celestial objects through an intuitive interface.
• **Discover Objects with AR** 
Find the current positions of planets, stars, and constellations with Augmented Reality. Follow objects as they move and learn more about their position and orbital periods.
• **Find Constellations & Planets** 
Search for constellations and planets, explore their current positions, and discover interesting information about the objects you find.
• **Capture the Sky** 
Save interesting views of space with a simple tap and keep your favorite discoveries in your photo gallery.
• **Create Your Favorites List** 
Build a personalized list of your favorite planets and keep their information easily accessible.
• **Learn About Space** 
Read interesting articles and discover facts about planets, galaxies, black holes, meteorites, comets, and other fascinating space objects.
• **Discover Earth & the Moon** 
Explore interesting facts about our planet, view the real-time position of the Moon, and explore time zones around the world using an interactive globe.
Whether you're curious about the stars above you or want to learn more about our solar system, explore the sky, discover celestial objects, and learn about space in a simple and engaging way.
**View Stars Subscription Options**
• Weekly: 3-day free trial, then $2.99 per week 
• Monthly: 3-day free trial, then $9.99 per month 
• Yearly: 3-day free trial, then $19.99 per year
Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period.
You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal through your iTunes or Apple Account settings after purchase. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period, and the renewal cost will be identified.
Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription where applicable.
Privacy Policy: https://bestbutterllc.wordpress.com/privacy-policy/
Terms of Use: https://bestbutterllc.wordpress.com/terms-of-use/

bluejetty:00092525:ios.description:
ABTBG is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with ABTBG:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the ABTBG app, you must be enrolled as an American Bank and Trust digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00185019:ios.summary: Partia is a SRPG (Strategy Role-playing) video game inspired by Fire Emblem and Tear Ring Saga series. In a high fantasy setting, the game will take players through an adventure where magic and sword collide and friendship and betrayal inte
bluejetty:00185019:ios.description:
Partia is a SRPG (Strategy Role-playing) video game inspired by Fire Emblem and Tear Ring Saga series. In a high fantasy setting, the game will take players through an adventure where magic and sword collide and friendship and betrayal intertwine.
Thank you guys for your reviews and suggestions. Good ones encourage us and bad ones humble us.
I am constantly fixing bugs that are brought up to me and trying to change things that bother people. It takes time since I am just one guy (Imago Software is only two guys) dealing with many issues. Still things will improve in future updates that I'm working on.
Meanwhile, obviously this is a paid game and I don't want to disappoint or cheat people out of their money.
Here's a gameplay video from TouchArcade's Sanuku (Thank you!):
http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=K3O9tw2L5Wg&feature=plcp
This may help with your purchase decision! Also our own video that include game tutorials are at
http://www.youtube.com/user/Playimago
@Matthew Haralson
Yes, the minor character development was very weak. More dialogs will be written in part of effort to more complete game experience!
@Tony Peniyoung
I was going to answer your concern but didn't really get the message!
@Grievlocke
Wow, having big battle animations will be really cool. Number 1 in my wish list too. Simply there was no budget and it looks like there will be no budget in the future, either- looking at the sales.
@Many who wanted more stages
I had random map generation for more guild quests, but I couldn't get the quality right yet. Random really never worked with the element of strategy, and became just a brute fighting.
Partia 2 was planned for 25 stages that wraps up the story, but at 600 games sold, well, I wonder if I could ever get enough budget.
@ErnieBernie876
I know it is not as convenient as having a restart button, but you could suspend the game and load the last save data to restart the stage from the beginning.
@frozencracker
It would be a bug if you have an attack option without having a valid target, but I can't seem to reproduce it. To cancel the attack while targeting, you could press 'B' button (that's the inside button) or you could choose a target then select No.
I will try my best to answer any question! You could also email me to:
admin@playimago.com

bluejetty:00136476:ios.description:
Prompt 3 is our #1 fully-native terminal emulator for Mac, iPhone, iPad, and now, Apple Vision Pro! Yes, with one purchase, you get four platforms. 
Supporting SSH, Mosh, Eternal Terminal, Telnet, and Local Shells (on Mac), you can stay connected even on the most unstable networks. And with Panic Sync, your servers sync everywhere. For terminals, this is the only app you need.
NOW EVEN BETTER:
• SSH, Telnet, and Local (for Mac)
Rock-solid and reliable connectivity to your hosts.
• Mosh and Eternal Terminal
Keep your terminal open even when you get disconnected. Mosh is optimized for high-latency, low-throughput networks. Eternal Terminal is great for when you need to keep your full terminal history on a flaky connection.
• Lower Price
Everything is so expensive right now. So we made Prompt cheaper. Take that, capitalism.
• Superfast Emulation
We retooled the text engine in Prompt 3 to be up to 10x faster, including GPU acceleration, and with improved terminal emulation, you can run nvim inside tmux without breaking a sweat.
• Clips
Put your most-used commands and text bits into clips and access them with a single tap via Prompt’s keyboard bar. Clips can be stored globally or per-server.
• Secure Enclave
Authenticate with FaceID and TouchID. The keys will stay secure on your device.
• Panic Sync
Sync your favorite servers, passwords, private keys, and clips, between Prompt on all of your devices.
• Customizable
Make Prompt perfect with new themes, fonts, and a very configurable iOS keyboard.
• Jump Hosts and Agent Forwarding
Access corporate servers, even at the beach.
• Mouse Support
Use your mouse to interact with TUI-based apps that run through the terminal.
AND YES, A DARK ICON. What more can we say?
TAKE CONTROL FROM ANYWHERE, INCLUDING YOUR MAC AND APPLE VISION PRO.
WE HOPE YOU ENJOY PROMPT 3.

bluejetty:00019191:ios.summary: Little Go is a free and open source iOS application that lets you play the game of Go on the iPhone or iPad. You can play against another human (on the same device), or against the computer. The computer player is powered by the open source
bluejetty:00019191:ios.description:
Little Go is a free and open source iOS application that lets you play the game of Go on the iPhone or iPad. You can play against another human (on the same device), or against the computer. The computer player is powered by the open source software library Fuego (http://fuego.sf.net/). The minimum requirement for running this version of Little Go is iOS 16.0.
Features:
- Board sizes between 7x7 and 19x19 (start a new game to change the board size)
- Let the computer player suggest a move or immediately play the move for you
- Calculate the score at any time during the game (area scoring is the default, territory scoring can be selected at the start of a new game)
- Adjust the computer's playing strength and resign behaviour by selecting from a number of presets, or by fine-tuning advanced settings
- Play even games, or games with 2-9 handicap stones (fixed stone placement)
- Select from 5 pre-defined rulesets when you start a new game, or adjust game rules to your preference (komi, ko rule, area/territory scoring system, number of passes to end game, resume play by alternating/non-alternating play, four passes end game)
- Optionally play with time limits (Main time only, Overtime only, Main time + Overtime), with a choice from 5 Overtime systems
- Place arbitrary black and white stones for initial board setup before a game starts
- View board positions for moves played earlier during the game
- View and create game variations
- Discard moves (aka "undo")
- Display move numbers and coordinate labels
- Zoom & scroll board
- Create and edit board and move annotations (e.g. good/bad move, good position for black/white, etc.) and add textual notes to a position
- Mark intersections on the board with symbols, markers and labels, and draw arrows or lines on the board
- Display player influence (aka territory statistics) for an estimate who owns an area
- Computer vs. computer game for entertainment
- Save & load games to/from the archive using the SGF file format
- Support for almost all properties of the SGF file format, with strict conformance to the specification
- Use file sharing to transfer saved games from your iOS device to your computer, and vice versa
- Import/export game files from/to other apps on your device (e.g. Mail, DropBox)
- In-app user manual
- Submit bug report email from inside the app (yes, this *is* a feature :-))
- For the technically inclined: Watch what happens behind the scenes when Little Go and Fuego talk to each other over the Go Text Protocol (GTP)
Your contribution in any form (coding, UI design, testing, bug reports, creating an app video preview, website design) is welcome - please contact me or visit the support website to find out more.
A note about the project state: Several years of development have gone into Little Go since its inception in January 2011. The app now has a feature set that is, I believe, quite nice :-) for a free program. My main focus therefore lies on fixing any remaining bugs (of which I am sure there are plenty) and keeping the app running under future versions of iOS.
Little Go is released under the Apache License 2.0 (http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0).

bluejetty:00043316:ios.description:
Mi Tigo es la aplicación de autogestión para todos los clientes Tigo, Hogar y Móviles.
La navegación dentro de la App es Gratis, no consume tus megas, ofreciéndote entre otras, las siguientes funcionalidades:
- Disfrutar promociones exclusivas de este canal.
- Consultar saldo y bonos disponibles.
- Realizar transferencias de saldo de tu bolsa de recarga.
- Activar y regalar bonos con el saldo de tu línea.
- Activar y regalar bonos con tarjeta de crédito o débito.
- Recargar tu línea o a otras personas.
- Consultar y pagar facturas (clientes Pospago y Hogar).
- Suscribir débito automático para el pago de factura Pospago móvil y Hogar.
- Consultar detalles de tu plan (clientes Pospago y Hogar).
- Gestiona tu servicio de internet. Podrás cambiar el nombre de red y contraseña, compartir tu internet, reiniciar tu modem, entre otros.
- Activar contenido Premium (Amazon Prime Video) para Pospago y Hogar.
- Cierre de sesiones, ahora podrás realizar el cierre de sesiones abiertas en todos tus dispositivos.
- Centro de notificaciones para mantenerte al tanto de promociones y nuevas funcionalidades.
- Para tu comodidad, ahora podras valorar nuestra App mediante notificaciones internas. 
- Registro y Login: La aplicación permite el registro por medio de:
Contraseña: Te sugerimos este método, que te ofrece todas las funcionalidades y te permite gestionar varios servicios a la vez (uno o varios números de celular + Tigo Hogar). Podras elegir en utilizar tu número de telefono o Correo Electrónico.
Con PIN: registro rápido y sencillo para clientes móviles. Permite gestionar solo la línea correspondiente. Algunas funcionalidades pueden no estar disponibles hasta cambiarse a registro con contraseña o Correo electrónico.
- Accede al App con tu huella dactilar ó Face ID.

Animal sounds for toddlers: Horse, Frog, Hen, Goat, Dog, Cat, Owl, Duck, Chicken and Cricket.

Funny sounds for babies will entertain your kid while developing their perception and attentiveness.
Baby phone is an educational game for pre-k, kindergarten and preschool kids.
Ages: 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 year olds.
Trusted by the largest teacher community in the USA: "We Are Teachers"!
You will never find annoying ads inside our app. We are always glad to receive your feedback and suggestions.

bluejetty:00019184:ios.description:
This isn't just an update. It's the "Reconstruction" of a fallen world.
April 17th, "Rebirth Day" is coming.
-The Vast Open World-
From snow mountain to beach, from forest to desert, from swamp to city... The vast Doomsday World is full of crises, yet offers endless possibilities. Here, you need to scavenge resources, build infrastructure, fend off zombie invasions, and build your own shelter.
-Keep Hope Alive-
When the doomsday came, zombies took over the world, collapsing social order and turning the familiar world unrecognizable. With the zombies craving human settlements, the harsh climate and scant resources, it’s hard to get by. In the doomsday seas, there resides even more dangerous new Infected and colossal mutant creatures that can sink boats effortlessly…...
Danger is all around. You must keep calm and live on by any means necessary!
-Make Survival Friends-
You’ll encounter other Survivors during your doomsday exploration.
Maybe you’re tired of all the zombie crying and night wind howling when you’re traveling alone. Try to open up, break bread with friends, talk all night long, and piece by piece create a peaceful shelter together.
-Experience Half-Zombie Survival-
The organization Dawn Break claims that human still has a chance after being bitten by zombie—to live as a "Revenant", abandon the human identity, appearance and abilities, and change forever.
It sounds risky, but what would you choose if it’s matter of life and death?

bluejetty:00073886:ios.description:
Turn your Apple Watch into a complete training platform.
HealthFit transforms the workout and health data stored in Apple Health into advanced fitness metrics, training insights, and seamless workout syncing—with no account required.
Whether you're training for your next race, improving your fitness, or simply staying active, HealthFit helps you understand your progress, optimize your training, and achieve your goals.
TRAIN SMARTER
Go beyond basic workout summaries with advanced training analytics designed to help you make better decisions.
HealthFit helps you understand:
• Training Load
• Fitness (CTL), Fatigue (ATL), and Form (TSB)
• Training Load Ratio
• Heart Rate Zones and Training Distribution
• Year Comparisons and Trends
• Explorer Score and Training Heat Maps
These are the kinds of metrics and insights typically reserved for premium coaching platforms.
EVERYTHING IN ONE PLACE
HealthFit combines your workouts, fitness trends, and health metrics in a beautifully designed app.
No more jumping between multiple apps. Track your training load, fitness progression, health metrics, and workout history from a single dashboard.
A BETTER ACTIVITY FEED
Browse all your workouts with maps, photos, and key metrics visible at a glance.
Dive deeper into every activity with advanced analysis including:
• Customizable Heart Rate Zones
• Training Load Tracking
• Equipment Tracking (Shoes, Bikes & More)
• Elevation, Pace, Power & Cadence Analysis
• Detailed Charts & Performance Trends
HealthFit can even automatically associate photos taken during your workouts, bringing your activity history to life.
POWER INSIGHTS
Analyze your running and cycling power with advanced metrics including:
• Estimated Critical Power
• Weighted Average Power
• Mean Maximal Power Curves
• Power Distribution Analysis
• Historical Power Trends
Understand how your power evolves and identify your strengths across different durations.
HEALTH METRICS FOR ATHLETES
HealthFit provides a focused view of the health metrics that matter most, helping you understand how your health, stress, and fitness evolve over time.
• Heart Rate Variability (HRV)
• Resting Heart Rate
• Cardio Fitness (VO₂ Max)
• Sleep Metrics
• Weight, BMI & Body Fat
• Baevsky Stress Index
Everything is presented clearly so you can connect your health trends to your training performance.
BUILT FOR EVERY SPORT
Most fitness apps focus on running and cycling.
HealthFit supports all activity types and automatically adapts its statistics, charts, and analysis to your most frequent activities, whether you specialize in a single sport or enjoy a variety of activities.
AUTOMATIC WORKOUT SYNCING
HealthFit automatically syncs your workouts in the background to all your favorite fitness platforms.
Every workout recorded with Apple Watch is uploaded automatically—no manual exports, no extra steps, no missing activities.
You can even sync your entire workout history.
MULTISPORT SUPPORT
HealthFit fully supports multisport and interval workouts and is one of the few apps capable of exporting multisport activities as true multisession workouts.
YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
Privacy is a core principle of HealthFit.
No account required. No login required.
HealthFit works directly with Apple Health and keeps your data on your device—giving you powerful fitness insights without sending your personal data to the cloud.
CONNECTS TO YOUR FAVORITE FITNESS PLATFORMS
Supported services include Strava, TrainingPeaks, Final Surge, Selfloops, Smashrun, Ride with GPS, Cycling Analytics, Today's Plan, Runalyze, Suunto, 2PEAK, Komoot, COROS, Intervals.icu, Nolio, TrainAsONE, Tredict, Stages Link, Map My Tracks, and Xhale.
Export detailed workout reports to Markdown, complete with charts, maps, and workout insights, or export your data in FIT, GPX, CSV, and Google Sheets formats.
Terms of Use:
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00178527:ios.description:
Imagine playing along with your favorite songs and getting real-time feedback—at home or even in the classroom! Now’s your chance to learn the ukulele or learn guitar with instant results!
Start learning to play chords on your ukulele or guitar and see results in just minutes. It’s super fast! Practice for 15 minutes and impress your friends, parents, and music teachers with your newfound skills.
Play along with a library of 160+ songs that are carefully selected to help you progress, and enjoy real-time feedback that guides you every step of the way. Switch between guitar and ukulele at any time! Learn easy chords without worrying about specific strumming patterns, and receive hints from award-winning educators to perfect your playing. Plus, share your progress with your music teacher, who can also use these insights in the classroom!
What’s so cool about Harmony City?
• Start playing your favorite songs on the ukulele or guitar immediately—whether you’re at home or in class.
• Learn music like you’re playing a fun music game. Stay motivated while you develop your guitar and ukulele skills.
• Track your progress and see improvements as you go.
• Impress your parents in just 15 minutes by showing them what you’ve learned!
• Curated song list featuring modern hits that will excite both you and your parents.
• Play along with YouTube musicians—feel like you're performing live!
• Learn anywhere, anytime—with just your instrument and device.
• Unlock interactive high scores and fun gameplay to make learning enjoyable.
• Developed by award-winning educators with real-time feedback to ensure the best learning experience.
• Personalize your experience by adjusting chord colors to match your boomwhackers.
Become the Next Ukulele or Guitar Superstar
• Switch between guitar and ukulele at any time!
• Master your skills with an ever-expanding song library.
• Learn guitar chords and ukulele chords through interactive music lessons.
• Play along with popular songs—share the stage with YouTube stars!
• The app listens to you and offers real-time feedback.
• Earn stars, unlock more songs, and improve your ukulele and guitar skills with each session.
• Watch video tutorials on how to hold and tune your instrument (includes guitar tuner), and how to read guitar tabs and ukulele tabs.
What Do You Get with the Subscription?
• Unlimited access to all 160+ songs—learn your favorite songs on ukulele and guitar.
• Choose from flexible pricing plans: 1-month, 6-month, or 12-month with transparent pricing.
• Free Trial—test out the app before committing.
• Prices may vary by country; contact us if you feel our pricing isn’t fair.
• Easy subscription management with the ability to cancel anytime.
• For music teachers: Get the best deals for you and your school! Reach out for details.
About Us
We are a passionate, young team creating meaningful music apps for kids, parents, and music teachers. Our goal is to introduce kids to music through fun, game-based learning, in collaboration with top elementary music educators. Our award-winning apps are part of the "World of Music Apps" suite, recognized globally, including at Microsoft Educational Forums.

bluejetty:00131270:ios.name: Zen Word® - Relax Puzzle Game
bluejetty:00131270:ios.summary:
Playing Zen Word 10 minutes a day brings you incredible challenging and relaxing experiences.
Zen word is a challenging word game & brain game that helps to train your brain and sharpen your mind. Zen Word is much more challenging than mo
bluejetty:00131270:ios.description:
Playing Zen Word 10 minutes a day brings you incredible challenging and relaxing experiences.
Zen word is a challenging word game & brain game that helps to train your brain and sharpen your mind. Zen Word is much more challenging than most other word puzzle games. Unlike crossword puzzles games or word cross games or word scramble games, all words in Zen Word are uncrossed, without any logical connection that can give you hints to help you solve the puzzles. In Zen Word, you need to search and connect the right letters to find 20 hidden words on average in each level to test your vocabulary. The length of the words is the only clue that will help you find all the words and solve the puzzles. Therefore, Zen Word has very high requirements for your vocabulary and spelling skills. All word puzzles in Zen Word are carefully designed and will definitely give you a completely different challenging experience. 
Also, Zen Word is very different from word-search games. In word search games, your objective is to find and mark all the words hidden inside the letters box. The arrangement of these words in word-search games has clear rules, even if you don't know the spelling of the words, you can still search and find all the hidden words to solve the puzzles. As you find more words, the difficulty of word search games gets easier. However in Zen Word, as you find more words, the difficulty of the game will increase sharply. The rest of the words are extremely hard for you to remember and to spell. In the process of recalling words, you can make your brain sharper. Zen word is a word game for adults to train their brains. 
In addition to bringing you a super challenging experience, Zen Word can also bring you the best relaxing and calm experience.In some crossword puzzles or some word search games or word finder games, you must find all words in limited time, giving you a lot of pressure. Also, in word scramble games, you need to score more points than your friends to win and can not enjoy the word puzzle solving process. In Zen Word, there is no countdown, no competition or any other designs that make you anxious or interrupt your puzzle solving experience. You can fully immerse yourself in word puzzles, accompanied by beautiful and peaceful nature backgrounds and peaceful music. All the backgrounds and music are carefully selected in the style of zen. You can dissipate worries, relieve stress, and relax your mind with Zen Word.
Here is the following subscription period available in our game:
Word Club offers a weekly or monthly or yearly subscription, you will be charged $4.99 per week, $12.99 per month, $49.99 per year. After buying this subscription, you will get daily no ads rights, 2 free lucky spins, 5 free paper planes, props 40% price off. This is an Auto-renewable subscription. The payment is charged to your account after confirmation. The subscription is renewed unless you turn it off 24 hours before the period ends.

listings.description:
Playing Zen Word 10 minutes a day brings you incredible challenging and relaxing experiences.
 
Zen word is a challenging word game & brain game that helps to train your brain and sharpen your mind. Zen Word is much more challenging than most other word puzzle games. Unlike crossword puzzles games or word cross games or word scramble games, all words in Zen Word are uncrossed, without any logical connection that can give you hints to help you solve the puzzles.  In Zen Word, you need to search and connect the right letters to find 20 hidden words on average in each level to test your vocabulary. The length of the words is the only clue that will help you find all the words and solve the puzzles. Therefore, Zen Word has very high requirements for your vocabulary and spelling skills. All word puzzles in Zen Word are carefully designed and will definitely give you a completely different challenging experience. 

Also, Zen Word is very different from word-search games. In word search games, your objective is to find and mark all the words hidden inside the letters box. The arrangement of these words in word-search games has clear rules, even if you don't know the spelling of the words, you can still search and find all the hidden words to solve the puzzles. As you find more words, the difficulty of word search games gets easier. However in Zen Word, as you find more words, the difficulty of the game will increase sharply. The rest of the words are extremely hard for you to remember and to spell. In the process of recalling words, you can make your brain sharper. Zen word is a word game for adults to train their brains. 
 
In addition to bringing you a super challenging experience, Zen Word can also bring you the best relaxing and calm experience.In some crossword puzzles or some word search games or word finder games, you must find all words in limited time, giving you a lot of pressure. Also, in word scramble games, you need to score more points than your friends to win and can not enjoy the word puzzle solving process. In Zen Word, there is no countdown, no competition or any other designs that make you anxious or interrupt your puzzle solving experience. You can fully immerse yourself in word puzzles, accompanied by beautiful and peaceful nature backgrounds and peaceful music. All the backgrounds and music are carefully selected in the style of zen. You can dissipate worries, relieve stress, and relax your mind with Zen Word.

bluejetty:00126019:ios.description:
The Mercè 2026 app has all the information you need about this year's entertainment programme.
When you open the app, it shows some of the programme's highlights, but you can search for any festival activity if you filter by type, venue and time slot. You can search using key words, and by the different programme categories too. You can mark activities as favourites to create a personalised agenda and get notifications before they start so that you don’t miss any of them. You can also see a list of artists classified by category and a list of all the venues with activities.
During the festivities, you can also search using the option “Here and now” to find activities near your current location.
A new feature this year is that each activity includes a check on others nearby, both by location and time, to help you plan your route during the celebrations.

bluejetty:00064911:ios.description:
The FNB Huntsville Mobile App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances.
FEATURES
Multi-Account Aggregation: View all of your financial information (balances, transaction history, merchant spending averages) in one place for on-the-go organization.
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills.
Add Tags, Notes, Images & Geo-Information: By enhancing transactions with custom tags, notes or photos of a receipt or check, you have the ability to stay organized and find exactly what you’re looking for when searching through your finances.
Contact: Locate ATMs or branches and contact First National Bank of Huntsville customer service directly from the app.
SAFE AND SECURE
The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you’re on Internet Banking. The app also features a unique 4-digit passcode setting that prevents unauthorized access.
GETTING STARTED
To use the FNB Huntsville Mobile App, you must be enrolled as a First National Bank of Huntsville Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials. After you successfully login to the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.

• Live prices for the top 250 coins by market cap, plus search for any coin listed on CoinGecko

Welcome to Cocobi Life World!
Be the star of your own story!
Explore awesome places with cute characters and endless imagination.
Will you fly away at the airport, help patients at the hospital, or catch villains at the police station? The choice is yours!
■ 5 New Locations to Explore!
- Check out the Airport, Police Station, Aquarium, Animal Farm, and the Spooky Haunted House! 
- Tons of new characters and items are ready for play.
- Visit your favorite spots: the Hair Salon, Playground, Supermarket, Cafe, Beach, and more!
- We are always adding more fun! Look out for new places and items in future updates.

- There are secret places hidden everywhere!
- Are you brave enough to unlock them?
- Find the secret doors and meet magical fairies and monsters!

- Collection Book: See all the fairies and monsters you've collected! 
- Fast Travel: Use the Map button to teleport anywhere instantly!

- Make your character look just like you—or someone totally new!
- Choose your age, skin tone, hair, eyes, and the cutest outfits.
■ Decorate Your Dream Space
- Pick cool wallpapers, floors, and furniture.
- Design a dream house, a giant toy store, or a yummy restaurant!
- Use your imagination to make Cocobi Life World the best place ever!
■ About Kigle
Kigle's mission is to create the 'first playground for children all over the world' with creative content for children. We make interactive apps, videos, songs, and toys to spark children's creativity, imagination, and curiosity. In addition to our Cocobi apps, you can download and play other popular games such as Pororo, Tayo, and Robocar Poli. 
■ Welcome to the Cocobi universe, where dinosaurs never became extinct! Cocobi is the fun compound name for brave Coco and cute Lobi! Play with the little dinosaurs and experience the world with various jobs, duties, and places.

bluejetty:00120671:ios.name: Train Games for Toddlers FULL
bluejetty:00120671:ios.summary:
Full Version *no additional purchases required*
Toot toot! Hop on board the Rainbow train and have so much fun learning colors and playing with trains! If your little one loves trains then the Train Games for Toddlers FULL app is perfect
bluejetty:00120671:ios.description:
Full Version *no additional purchases required*
Toot toot! Hop on board the Rainbow train and have so much fun learning colors and playing with trains! If your little one loves trains then the Train Games for Toddlers FULL app is perfect for them as it was developed by teachers with over 15 years childcare experience, using their philosophy of learning through play. With over 25 activities and sounds about trains and colors any little conductors will have a delight-filled time learning with this app. 
Train Colors Driving Game
Do you want to drive a train? All little conductors will have a blast keeping the trains on the tracks as they collect coins. Each fun world is based on a color, and the train they are driving is that color also and puffs smoke as it drives. But watch out for the cars and stay on the train tracks to collect the coins and stay safe. It’s a cute and fun interactive driving game and a toot-riffic time with trains! 
Train Colors Sound Pages
 Learn colors and have a super fun time playing with the colors sound pages. Each color has it’s own page and your little conductors can hear the color and see the train that matches the word. This will help develop early reading skills and definitely color recognition. They will also be able to tap everything else on the page and hear a cute sound too, making each page unique and a great way to learn through play. This is also a great tool for testing color blindness, and will also promote: 
-Fine motor skills.
-Memory and recognition skills.
-Vocabulary and language.
- Color recognition.
Train Find the Difference Games
This engaging toot-riffic train find the difference game is again based on each color world. Your little ones will be looking at two scenes on the page and they have to find the difference between the two scenes. Once they find it they win that level and will be taken to the next game in that color series, and with five different levels it makes the Train Games for Toddlers FULL app even more entertaining and fun! 
Playtime With Trains Storybook
Another delightful feature of the Trains Games for Toddlers app is the Playtime with Train Storybook. Find out what each trains color is and their names and then find out what they like to do when they play. Tap the trains in the story and hear their different toots and horns, and when they are playing tap every item on the page and watch it magically turn into something else based on that theme! For example when the aqua train named Party is playing he’s pretending to be at his birthday party and birthday music will be playing and when you tap the balloons they change color, or tap the present and see a different present, and tap the birthday cake to see a different cake. It’s a super fun interactive book that is sure to thrill all little conductors. 
Chug-a-chug-a-choo-choo your way into a rainbow of fun with the Train Games for Toddlers FULL app, and have a toot-riffic time learning colors, driving trains, and playing with trains!

bluejetty:00171788:ios.name: Drive.RS : Open World Racing
bluejetty:00171788:ios.summary:
Welcome to Drive.RS!
A huge open world driving game with console quality graphics and physics. This is a game for real car enthusiasts - get behind the wheel of your favourite supercar or JDM drift machine and take part in a unique and thr
bluejetty:00171788:ios.description:
Welcome to Drive.RS!
A huge open world driving game with console quality graphics and physics. This is a game for real car enthusiasts - get behind the wheel of your favourite supercar or JDM drift machine and take part in a unique and thrilling experience like never seen before on mobile.
We love racing games and you can feel that passion throughout the game. Exciting physics engineered by us to give an incredible sense of speed and capture the true essence of driving - race along highways at high speed, drift along mountain passes with your rear wheels teetering over the edge, tear through fields full of sheep feeling every bump in the terrain. Stop at your favourite beauty spot to watch the sun set after a hard night's drifting on the gruelling touge mountains. Take daredevil jumps or test your skills in the drift playgrounds.
It's your world to explore, with true freedom behind the wheel of your car.
* Explore an absolutely huge 64km2 map with 256km of roads to drive!
* Races, drift zones, and free roam gameplay
* Upgrade system - comprehensive and detailed upgrade system, with a large variety of upgrades allowing you to completely change the performance and handling of your car
* AI traffic to bring the world to life, with realistic physics and auto overtaking behaviour
* Day to night cycle
* Asphalt, dirt roads, highway, and touge style mountain roads for a real world driving experience
* Stunning landscapes and vistas, with huge mountains, rolling hills, and a beautiful rugged coastal area
* A variety of animals to encounter on your journey
* Cutting edge visuals with high end lighting and shadows, realtime reflections, and highly realistic trees and vegetation
* Console standard car physics engineered from scratch, geared towards a fun but realistic simcade experience. It's designed to bring the feel and experience of real driving to mobile games
* True to life advanced drift dynamics with realistic inertia and friction. Engineered to simulate real drift physics, requiring careful countersteering and throttle control. Requires skill, 
 but it's a detailed and convincing physics model that's very rewarding and fun once you learn
* Runs at 60fps on recent flagship devices
* Controller support
* Livery system coming soon
* Multiplayer coming soon
* More maps and off map drift tracks coming soon
