bluejetty:00001041:android.name: تعلم الإنجليزية بسرعة
bluejetty:00001041:android.summary: Learn English Fast is a premium educational program that aims to help users acquire English language skills quickly and easily, from basic to professional levels. The application provides an opportunity to learn English from scratch for fre
bluejetty:00001041:android.description:
Learn English Fast is a premium educational program that aims to help users acquire English language skills quickly and easily, from basic to professional levels. The application provides an opportunity to learn English from scratch for free, while providing comprehensive and excellently organized lessons and educational materials.
English is a global language spoken by millions of people around the world, and it is the language of science, technology, business and international communication. Mastering the English language is vital in the modern era, as it opens doors to many opportunities in various vital fields. It facilitates communication and understanding with people of different cultures and nationalities, and enhances career and educational opportunities in the global labor market.
Through the Learn English Fast application, users can access a variety of educational resources such as daily lessons, common English sentences and conversations, and the most important English phrases and vocabulary. The application provides you with simplified lessons with a simple and easy-to-understand explanation of English grammar, which helps enhance understanding of concepts and application of acquired skills.
In addition, learning English enhances an individual's ability to access sources of knowledge, scientific and cultural resources available in English. The English language also provides opportunities to study at international universities and participate in international programs for cultural and academic exchange. So regardless of the level of the user, whether beginner or advanced, Learn English Fast offers comprehensive lessons to meet the needs of all individuals. The application includes English grammar in a simplified and clear manner, in addition to a countless number of basic and most used vocabulary, sentences and phrases in daily life, which help in enhancing learning and applying the rules practically in daily conversations, enabling you to speak English at lightning speed and master English speaking.
By learning English, you will be able to easily integrate into the global community and participate actively in global dialogues on today's issues. In addition, learning English enhances opportunities for travel and cultural exploration, where individuals can interact with other cultures and gain new experiences and diverse cultural values. By using the Learn English Fast application, you will gain the confidence and skills necessary to communicate in English with confidence and ease, whether the goal is to improve the general level of the language, prepare for certain tests, or participate in daily conversations, meet new friends, and gain new knowledge in the world.
In short, learning English for children, young and old is a valuable investment in one's future, providing you with endless opportunities in education, work and international communication. That is why we present to you the application to learn English quickly from scratch to professionalism, which is characterized by its simple and easy-to-use design, and from which users can benefit from all its content, including rich lessons for beginners and English phrases and vocabulary translated into Arabic without the need for an Internet connection, which makes it an ideal accompaniment for learning at any time and in any place. Anywhere. The application also provides a comprehensive and continuous learning experience, as it helps you speak English in 5 minutes a day by continuing and persevering in learning a new word and a new phrase every day, which is a new method that makes the learning process more effective and not boring.
The application to learn English quickly for free from scratch provides a wide range of English vocabulary and phrases most used in daily conversations with translation into Arabic, which makes it work like an Arabic-English dictionary or an English-Arabic dictionary. Thanks to the search feature, you can easily search for the words you want to translate, whether in Arabic or English. This feature also helps you access the required information quickly and effectively, which facilitates the process of searching for relevant vocabulary, phrases, and lessons.
Thanks to these valuable features and the diversity of content, the Learn English Fast application becomes an ideal partner for all people seeking to learn English easily and effectively, whether for study, work, travel, or making new friends around the world.
If you like the content of the application, you can support us by rating it 5 stars and writing positive comments. Thanks.

bluejetty:00136535:ios.name: Stock+: Stock Market Heat Map
bluejetty:00136535:ios.summary: Welcome to Stock+, where your financial aspirations take flight. The most popular stock indexes are in your fingers. Explore the stocks sector by sector with interactive visualized map. Look at S&P500, Dow Jones and Nasdaq 100 stock map (he
bluejetty:00136535:ios.description:
Welcome to Stock+, where your financial aspirations take flight. The most popular stock indexes are in your fingers. Explore the stocks sector by sector with interactive visualized map. Look at S&P500, Dow Jones and Nasdaq 100 stock map (heat map, treemap). Whether you're a seasoned investor or just starting on your financial journey, Stock+ is your trusted partner in building a secure and prosperous future.
Features,
- Interactive Stock Map
Easily understand with color-coded according to daily results.
- Deepdive Sector Stocks
Lots of stock in a screen. Click to any sector and new map will draw with that sector stocks. Easy to use and more understandable especially in large number of stock based indexes like S&P 500.
- Stock Detail
Choose the whatever you want stock and get more price information like well-designed candlestick graphic, daily, weekly, monthly, yearly minimum and maximum price movements.
- Favorite Stocks
Add all of your favorite stocks to list and you can easily access with them. The new list will start with your favorite stocks.
- Reliable and Secure
Your privacy and security are our utmost priority. Your favorites are kept in your phone. Holdings are transferred to our database and kept encrypted.
- User-Friendly Interface
Navigate the complexities of investing with ease. Our intuitive interface ensures that you can monitor your investments, track performance, and make informed decisions—all from the palm of your hand.
- Technical Analysis
Follow simple, weighted, exponential daily moving averages in 5, 10, 20, 50, 100, 200 day periods.
- Technical Indicators
Also follow best resulted indicators like RSI, MACD, STOCH, CCI, STOCHRSI, ATR, ADX, OU, ROC, WilliamsR and get easily signals.
- Stock Holdings
How to Work?
The stocks on a map are grouped in hierarchies. A market contains multiple sectors. A sector contains multiple industries. An industry contains multiple stocks. 
For example, S&P500 index has 11 sectors (Utilities, Real Estate, Materials, Information Technology, Industrials, Health Care, Financials, Energy, Consumer Staples, Consumer Discretionary, Communication Services). All of sectors can have lots of different industries. Utilities is one of sectors and has 5 different industries (Independent Power Producers & Energy Traders, Electric Utilities, Multi-Utilities, Water Utilities, Gas Utilities). Each utilies has one or more stock.
On the other hand, different indexes has different rules. Dow Jones does not have sectors. It is only divided by industries. It contains 17 different industries (Telecommunications industry, Semiconductor industry, Retailing, Pharmaceutical industry, Petroleum industry, Managed health care, Insurance, Home Improvement, Food industry, Fast-moving consumer goods, Drink industry, Construction, Conglomerate, Clothing industry, Chemical industry, Broadcasting, Biopharmaceutical, Aerospace). Like others, each industries has one or more stock.
Stock Map visualizes the stock market with a market heat map (a.k.a. market treemap). The size of a block is determined by the market cap of that company. And the whole map is sorted by the market cap in descending order.
Subscription and Pricing:
If you choose to purchase, payment will be charged to your iTunes account, and your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. Auto-renewal may be turned off at any time by going to your settings in the iTunes Store after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable
Current subscription starts from $2.99 USD/month.
Subscriptions can be deactivated at the following link: https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039
Privacy Policy: https://kemalbakacak.com/agreements/stock-plus-stock-map-heatmap/privacy_policy.html
Terms of Use: https://kemalbakacak.com/agreements/stock-plus-stock-map-heatmap/terms_and_conditions.html

bluejetty:00014868:ios.name: Magnit VMS Mobile
bluejetty:00014868:ios.summary: Magnit VMS Mobile is for managers, workers, and suppliers using Magnit's integrated vendor management system (VMS), Magnit VMS. Download this app if your company uses Magnit VMS and is headquartered in the Americas, Middle East, Africa, or
bluejetty:00014868:ios.description:
Magnit VMS Mobile is for managers, workers, and suppliers using Magnit's integrated vendor management system (VMS), Magnit VMS. Download this app if your company uses Magnit VMS and is headquartered in the Americas, Middle East, Africa, or Asia.
Magnit VMS Mobile allows contingent workforce managers to quickly review and approve timecards, expenses, statement-of-work (SOW) billing, and other notifications and requests, from their phone. Workers can easily enter new timecards, submit expenses (including receipts). Suppliers - including account managers, recruiters, sourcing and billing specialists - may coordinate and schedule interviews, view pending engagement requests, review and confirm expenses, manage candidates, manage projects, and more.
SAFE AND SECURE
• 100% native mobile application that leverages the full capabilities of the device
• Log into Magnit VMS Mobile using your Magnit VMS credentials provided by the Magnit Client Services Team
• Securely access all of your data from the Magnit VMS, with no syncing necessary
KEY MAGNIT VMS MOBILE FEATURES FOR MANAGERS
• Push notifications that alert managers of new action items requiring their attention
• Timecards that managers can review in detail before approving or rejecting with a simple and intuitive swipe interface
• Approve or reject financial and change requests (includes Headcount Requests, Project/SOW, Expenses, etc.)
• Provide worker feedback with a few taps using an intuitive, star-based rating system
• Compare candidates side-by-side, review resumes, and schedule interviews
• Real-time rate benchmarking powered by Magnit VMS’s Market Rate Module
• Review assignment details, days and funds remaining, and billing history
KEY MAGNIT VMS MOBILE FEATURES FOR WORKERS
• Submit timecards quickly and easily, by copying them from prior weeks
• Submit expense reports and receipts using the device’s built-in camera
• View your full billing and expense history
KEY MAGNIT VMS MOBILE FEATURES FOR SUPPLIERS
• Review and update interview details, such as selecting dates and times, monitoring activities and withdrawing candidates from consideration
• Send interview times to candidates by email or text (workers may reply without having to log into Magnit VMS)
• View the latest job requests and speed response time
• Review key request details, such as rate info and desired candidate qualities
• Forward requests to recruiters with a quick tap
• Review submitted expenses and receipts right from your device
• Confirm or reject expenses with a single tap
• Easily create and submit project billings
• Receive notifications about project milestone due dates and project billing reminders in real time
NOTE:
• Suppliers - This application requires a Magnit VMS Supplier username and password to log in. Only suppliers that service clients as part of a Magnit program will have access. Additionally, the Magnit VMS Supplier App must be enabled at the program you are servicing in order to function.

bluejetty:00089435:ios.name: Burn by Cara Loren
bluejetty:00089435:ios.summary:
Are you ready to ignite your fitness flame? Get ready to challenge yourself like never before with the Burn App’s innovative programs, designed around progressive overload to maximize your results.
Whether you’re training in the gym or at
bluejetty:00089435:ios.description:
Are you ready to ignite your fitness flame? Get ready to challenge yourself like never before with the Burn App’s innovative programs, designed around progressive overload to maximize your results.
Whether you’re training in the gym or at home, the Burn App offers eight dynamic programs, plus rotating challenge options—all included with your subscription. With smart technology that "levels you up" as you hit your weight and rep goals, the app ensures you're always pushing yourself to new heights. As you unlock new exercises and progressions, you'll continue to experience fresh, exciting workouts that are strategically designed to build muscle and burn fat, keeping your fitness journey endlessly effective.
So how does it work? 
After downloading and creating your account, we’ll ask you a few questions to understand your fitness goals better. Once you’ve completed your questionnaire, the Burn App will analyze your preferences and pair you with a program best suited for you. 
Within our programs, you will experience various training styles including:
• HIIT (High-Intensity Interval Training)
• Circuit Training
• Muscle Burnout Challenges
• Bodyweight Exercises
• Strength Training
• Powerbuilding
• Cardio
• LISS (Low-Intensity Steady State Cardio)
• Pregnancy and postnatal 
• Rep Challenges
• AMRAP (As Many Reps as Possible) Challenges
• EMOM (Every Minute on the Minute) Challenges 
These programs are designed to help you reach your fitness goals whether that is losing weight, getting toned, or building lean muscle. 
You will also be able to take full advantage of our cutting-edge features, including: 
• Difficulty levels to gamify your workout and keep you engaged as you accomplish more challenging exercises
• Adjustable scales to input your weight and rep amounts completed within each exercise
• Tracking history to see previous weights and rep amounts completed so you can monitor and celebrate your progress
• Simple but pretty app design allowing you to easily navigate the app 
• Easy-to-follow workouts that allow you to focus more on the exercise itself 
• Real-time muscle group visualization for each exercise 
• Categorized workouts based on fitness goal
• Ability to go at your own pace during your workout
• Ability to listen to your own audio during your workout
• Exercise video demonstrations
• At-home and in-gym programs
• Share selfies at the end of your workout 
• Share your workout completion 
• 24/7 access to the Burn Community
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING & TERMS
The Burn App is free to download. Ongoing use requires an active subscription which is available in monthly, quarterly, or yearly models. All users are eligible for a free trial period regardless of which subscription model they choose! 
Payment will be charged to your credit card through your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours prior to the end of the subscription period. There is no increase in price when renewing your subscription. 
Subscriptions can be managed in Account Settings in iTunes after purchase. Once purchased, refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term. Read our full Terms and Conditions as well as our Privacy Policy for more information. 
Terms & Conditions: https://getburnapp.com/terms-conditions/
Privacy Policy: https://getburnapp.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00131281:ios.description:
Understand your body. Plan around your cycle. Know what’s coming next.
Clue is the #1 women-led period and cycle tracker – science-backed, privacy-first, and built to help you live in sync with your cycle.
Trusted by millions of people worldwide, Clue gives you the knowledge and personalized insight to make confident health decisions, from first period to perimenopause.
Headquartered in Berlin, your data is protected by strict European privacy law (GDPR).
Track your period and cycle
Know when your period is coming, and get personalized predictions based on your unique cycle length, flow, and patterns.
See how your cycle affects how you feel
Track 200+ symptoms and experiences – cramps, PMS, pain, energy, cravings, mood, skin, sleep, sex drive, discharge, and more. Your patterns, in clear charts.
Get ahead of symptoms
See what might be coming, from PMS and cramps to energy dips, so you can plan ahead. Set custom reminders so nothing catches you off guard.
Understand your fertility
Get personalized ovulation and fertile window predictions, based on a clinically-validated algorithm designed to help you conceive.
Stay on track with birth control
Log your method – pill, IUDs, ring, patch, and more. Track your cycle symptoms even without regular bleeding.
Get real answers, backed by science
Explore 400+ articles on your cycle, fertility, sex, pregnancy, perimenopause, and reproductive health.
Use Clue through every life stage
Switch between modes as your needs change. Period tracking, trying to conceive, pregnancy, and perimenopause.
Connect a wearable
Layer your cycle data with temperature, sleep, and heart rate for deeper health insights. Works with Apple Watch, Oura, WHOOP, Withings, Fitbit, and more.
Get more from every cycle with Clue Plus — deeper analysis, advanced predictions, and personalized insights that get smarter the more you track.
A few legal details:
After you choose the Clue subscription that’s right for you & confirm your purchase, the credit card associated with your iTunes Account will be charged. Once purchased, your subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. If you currently have a free trial, any unused time will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
If you want to renew your subscription, your account will be charged the same amount you paid for your initial subscription, 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or change your subscription at any time, including turning off auto-renewal, by going to the ‘Account Settings’ on your device after the purchase.
Note: Clue should not be used as a contraceptive. Clue is made to help people understand their menstrual and reproductive health by tracking their data, as well as predicting fertile days to aid conception. The app does not substitute professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Your healthcare provider can give you advice on your specific needs and situation.
Helloclue.com
support.helloclue.com
Terms of Service: www.helloclue.com/terms
Privacy Policy: www.helloclue.com/privacy

bluejetty:00036817:ios.name: Loop Route Planner
bluejetty:00036817:ios.summary:
Plan better delivery runs with less manual work. Loop Route Planner helps drivers organize multi-stop routes faster, stay on top of each stop, and keep repeat runs easy to manage.
If you run local deliveries every day, Loop helps you move
bluejetty:00036817:ios.description:
Plan better delivery runs with less manual work. Loop Route Planner helps drivers organize multi-stop routes faster, stay on top of each stop, and keep repeat runs easy to manage.
If you run local deliveries every day, Loop helps you move from stop list to ready-to-drive route without extra back-and-forth. Import your original file, optimize stop order, save repeat addresses, and update delivery status as you go.
What you can do with Loop:
- Import your original file without rebuilding a template
- Optimize multi-stop routes for daily delivery runs
- Save customer and frequent addresses for reuse
- Mark each stop as completed during the route
- Reuse previous routes when similar runs come back
FAQ
Can I import my own stop list?
Yes. Loop supports importing your original file, so you do not need to rebuild everything in a new template before planning the route.
Can I save repeat addresses and reuse routes?
Yes. Loop lets you save frequent customers and locations, and you can reuse previous routes when similar delivery runs come back.
How many stops can I plan for free?
The free version supports up to 10 stops per route.
【Auto-subscription instructions】
Loop route planner - Free
The free version of Loop route planner gives you unlimited access to route optimization, but routes are limited to a maximum of 10 stops.
Loop route planner - Pro
Supports unlimited route planning, up to 200 stops, and custom import formats. Try Loop route planner Pro and see how much time and fuel you can save in a week with a 7-day free trial.
7-day trial complete? Subscribe to Loop route planner Pro for just £9.9 per month or £79.9 per year, and your subscription will give you access to unlimited features, stops, and routes. Save time, money, and fuel by using a delivery route planner that helps you do more and finish your route faster.
Subscriptions auto-renew monthly and are charged to your iTunes account. Cancel anytime by turning off auto-renew in your iTunes account 24 hours before the renewal date. Rates vary by country, and the local price for your region will be provided before you complete payment.
Support: support@looprouteplanner.com
Privacy policy: https://www.looprouteplanner.com/privacy.html
Terms of use: https://www.looprouteplanner.com/subscription.html

bluejetty:00172318:ios.description:
Are you looking for an affordable home in your neighborhood? Or just houses for sale or apartments for rent elsewhere? We´re convinced the home of your dreams exists, however, it might be tough to find it. 
That´s why the new Mitula Homes app is available in 41 countries and 15 languages. It allows you to explore the market of property sales and find homes advertised on sale and for rent throughout the world. 
Mitula Homes offers thousands of real estate listings so you can search for a flat, house, apartment, room, attic, duplex, studio, chalet, loft, bungalow, townhouse, garage, office, land, etc. The Mitula Homes app is very intuitive and user friendly to make your property search easier.
If you search for a home for sale or rent you can filter your results by date of listing, and important criteria such as area or location, house price, size or number of square meters, number of rooms, bathrooms, keywords and much more. 
What could you do with the Mitula Homes app? 
- Swap between property for sale or for rent within the same location. 
- Modify your property searches just removing your filter tags directly from the listing list view. 
- Save your searches and your favorite listings and share them to your partner or friends.
- Discard the listings you´re not interested in to make your property search easier.
- Choose from any of the 15 languages available.
- Receive notifications with relevant information on your favourite searches. It lets you know when new interesting properties or bargains matching your preferences come onto the market, or even, there is a drop in house prices.
- Quick access to your recent searches to see the listings in a faster way.
- Share listings on social networks or send them via email. 
- Locate homes within the neighborhood you choose by searching for properties near the location you've entered or your current location.
- View properties that interest you on the map. You can choose a specific area by drawing it and finding the local info nearby. 
- Home search by voice.
- Contact the real estate advertiser directly.
- If you are house-hunting with someone you can see the listings that you have shared. Also from the detail of the listing you will be able to see the location on the map and places of interest nearby as hospitals, education, public transport and supermarkets.
- Additional services that help to your proper

bluejetty:00059556:android.description:
Welcome to Dice Match Line Puzzle Games – the ultimate classic dice puzzle adventure where strategy meets fun! Challenge your mind and reflexes in this addictive merge puzzle game that puts your skills to the test. Your objective? Match dice of the same color and shape to create longer chains and rack up massive scores!
But wait, there's more! Harness the power of exciting power-ups to blast dice vertically, horizontally, and even unleash a bomb power-up to clear dices around. Strategize your moves wisely to create spectacular combos and reach new heights in this dice puzzle merge puzzle experience!
With a whopping 600+ levels to conquer, the excitement never ends! Each level is a race against time, where you must merge dices within a specific time frame to meet your targets. Need more time? Don't worry, you can earn extra time as a bonus at the end of each level – just another twist to keep you on the edge of your seat in this offline dice board game!
And the fun doesn't stop there – spin the wheel daily to collect awesome bonuses and power-ups to aid you on your journey through this fun classic dice game rush! Whether you're a fan of board games or simply love a good dice game, Dice Match Line Puzzle Games has something for everyone. Download now and start rolling your way to victory in this lite dice game that's perfect for players of all ages!

bluejetty:00062038:ios.name: Bucha học tiếng Trung Mandarin
bluejetty:00062038:ios.summary: ► Bucha học tiếng Trung Quốc là game học tiếng Trung tốt nhất với phương pháp học mới vô cùng hiệu quả và thú vị: HỌC MÀ CHƠI - CHƠI MÀ HỌC. Người học sẽ chơi game và vượt qua những câu hỏi từ vựng, ngữ pháp tiếng Trung thông dụng giúp trau
bluejetty:00062038:ios.description:
► Bucha học tiếng Trung Quốc là game học tiếng Trung tốt nhất với phương pháp học mới vô cùng hiệu quả và thú vị: HỌC MÀ CHƠI - CHƠI MÀ HỌC. Người học sẽ chơi game và vượt qua những câu hỏi từ vựng, ngữ pháp tiếng Trung thông dụng giúp trau dồi vốn từ vựng, luyện phát âm tiếng Trung chuẩn và luyện nghe để nâng cao trình độ giao tiếp tiếng Trung. Chỉ cần dành một ít thời gian mỗi ngày để chơi game đồng thời học thêm thật nhiều từ vừng tiếng Trung để chuẩn bị cho các kỳ thi trình độ Hán ngữ Trung Quốc (HSK), luyện thi TOCFL hay thi đại học vào các chuyên ngành tiếng Trung.
► Bộ dữ liệu ôn luyện tiếng Trung:
- 326 từ vựng giáo trình Hán ngữ quyển 1
- 460 từ vựng giáo trình Hán ngữ quyển 2
- 395 từ vựng giáo trình Hán ngữ quyển 3
- 388 từ vựng giáo trình Hán ngữ quyển 4
- 571 từ vựng giáo trình Hán ngữ quyển 5
- 831 từ vựng giáo trình Hán ngữ quyển 6
- 704 từ vựng giáo trình Boya Sơ cấp 1
- 791 từ vựng giáo trình Boya Sơ cấp 2
- 333 bài học video tiếng trung theo các chủ đề
- 1262 mẫu câu giao tiếp tiếng Trung cơ bản
- 19 chủ đề giao tiếp tiếng Trung hàng ngày
- 101 câu thành ngữ, danh ngôn tiếng Trung hay và ý nghĩa
► Chức năng chính:
- Mẫu câu tiếng Trung giao tiếp hàng ngày
- Sưu tầm thành ngữ, danh ngôn tiếng Trung, tìm hiểu văn hóa Trung Quốc
- Flash Card với hình ảnh minh họa sinh động, dễ nhớ
- Đầy đủ thông tin nghĩa, giải thích, pinyin, phát âm
- Trò chơi trắc nghiệm tiếng Trung; tự kiểm tra khả năng ghi nhớ từ vựng
- Luyện viết tiếng Trung qua trò chơi xếp chữ
- Luyện nghe tiếng Trung với những đoạn hội thoại cơ bản
- Nhắc nhở học từ vựng thông minh mỗi ngày
- Đua TOP và chia sẻ điểm số với bạn bè
- Chơi và học tiếng Trung MIỄN PHÍ hoàn toàn, OFFLINE không cần INTERNET
Từ vựng và phát âm rất quan trọng đối với việc đọc hiểu, giao tiếp tiếng Trung thông dụng nói riêng và học ngoại ngữ nói chung. Bucha học tiếng Trung gồm hàng trăm bài học vui nhộn được biên soạn từ những giáo trình học tiếng Trung tốt nhất. Kết hợp chơi game với việc học tiếng Trung Quốc giúp vừa giải trí, vừa ghi nhớ từ vựng tiếng Trung cơ bản. Đồng thời còn giúp luyện nghe, học cách phát âm, ghi nhớ cấu trúc ngữ pháp và cách sử dụng trong giao tiếp. Bộ từ vựng Hán ngữ đầy đủ các cấp độ sẽ hỗ trợ tốt cho việc ôn luyện, chuẩn bị bài thi tiếng Trung THPT quốc gia, thi chứng chỉ tiếng Trung HSK hoặc tiếng Trung giao tiếp du lịch hay lao động tại Trung Quốc.
► Game rất thích hợp với những người:
- Tự học tiếng Trung cơ bản
- Người mới bắt đầu học làm quen với tiếng Trung
- Học sinh cấp 3 đang chuẩn bị ôn thi tiếng Trung
- Luyện thi HSK, TOCFL hoặc học tiếng Trung giao tiếp
- Bố mẹ dạy con học tiếng Trung
- Học tiếng Trung Quốc cấp tốc
- Ít động lực học tiếng Trung một cách bài bản
- Thích chơi game và tự học/kiểm tra tiếng Trung mọi lúc mọi nơi
- Thích cách học tiếng Trung mới và hiện đại
- Ít thời gian tự học tiếng Trung tại nhà
- ĐẶC BIỆT thích hợp cho trẻ em làm quen với tiếng Trung
► Sử dụng Bucha học tiếng Trung thường xuyên sẽ giúp bạn:
- Học tốt Hán văn mà không mất quá nhiều thời gian
- Hiểu rõ các cấu trúc tiếng Trung
- Học viết tiếng Trung tốt hơn
- Củng cố lại vốn từ vựng tiếng Trung
- Giảm căng thẳng của cách học cổ điển
- Rèn luyện kỹ năng nghe căn bản
- Cải thiện phát âm tiếng Trung theo phiên âm PINYIN
- Ghi nhớ các mẫu câu tiếng Trung thường được sử dụng
► Liên hệ:
- Trang chủ: https://teamhoppi.com
- Email: teamhoppi@gmail.com
- Fanpage: https://facebook.com/teamhoppi

bluejetty:00185238:ios.description:
Test your brain with this fun and free logo trivia puzzle game! Identify famous and iconic logos from brands around the world.
Challenge yourself with thousands of logos that will test your brain and keep you entertained for hours. This fun and free trivia puzzle game lets you explore logos from a wide range of categories, including tech, fashion, food, sports, and more. Whether you’re identifying famous brands you see every day or uncovering lesser-known logos, each level offers a new and tricky challenge. Perfect for trivia crack lovers, puzzle enthusiasts, or anyone looking for a brain-teasing good time, this game guarantees fun for all ages!
The Classic mode will get you addicted with 1500+ logos to recognize. That's a 100-level safari that will make you feel nostalgic, confident, frustrated, happy, and relieved. If you're stuck, don't worry! Reveal a letter to get out of a sticky situation or unveil the entire solution to move on to the next level!
The Rush mode will keep you on edge. Once the game starts, the countdown timer begins. But don't panic! You'll earn more time for every logo you recognize, and you can always skip to the next logo if you're stuck.
The Categories option is a great way to expand your journey. Choose between the Flags, Soccer, and US Sports categories.
The Flags category provides an opportunity to discover and identify 150 unique flags from countries around the world. Whether you're recognizing the flag of a prominent nation or a more obscure territory, put your knowledge of world geography to the test.
The Soccer category offers an extensive collection of 225 club logos from major leagues across the globe. From the UK and Europe to the United States, South America, Africa, Asia, Australia, and New Zealand, challenge yourself to identify the crests and emblems of various soccer clubs.
The US Sports category caters specifically to fans of American sports, featuring 150 logos from popular leagues such as the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLB, and MLS. Showcase your expertise in American sports by identifying team logos from the vibrant sporting culture in the United States.
Logo Quiz 2026 provides a visually appealing and user-friendly interface, allowing players to navigate through different logos seamlessly.

bluejetty:00061189:ios.name: Catholic Vietnamese Holy Bible
bluejetty:00061189:ios.summary: The Catholic Bible includes books of the Old Testament and New Testament and several books excluded by Protestant Bibles. The specific richness and history of our Catholic faith can be found in several Roman Catholic Bible translations. One
bluejetty:00061189:ios.description:
The Catholic Bible includes books of the Old Testament and New Testament and several books excluded by Protestant Bibles. The specific richness and history of our Catholic faith can be found in several Roman Catholic Bible translations. One of the most popular Catholic Bibles is the New American Bible (NAB). Some earlier translations include the Revised Standard Version - Catholic Edition (RSV-CE), the Douay-Rheims (the earliest translation from the original Latin), and the Navarre Bible.
The Bible in the Catholic tradition differs in the number and order of books from those typically found in Bibles used by Protestants, because it includes the deuterocanonical books, which Protestants call the Apocrypha. Its canon of Old Testament texts is somewhat larger than that in translations used by Protestants, which are typically based exclusively on the shorter Hebrew and Aramaic Masoretic Text. On the other hand, its canon, which does not accept all the books that are included in the Septuagint,[16] is shorter than that of some churches of Eastern and Oriental Orthodoxy, which recognize other books as sacred scripture.
This app is Catholic Vietnamese Audio Bible.

bluejetty:00023583:ios.summary:
SKY TONIGHT is a brand-new astronomical app for exploring the sky. It helps stargazers answer the three most common questions:

bluejetty:00023583:ios.description:
SKY TONIGHT is a brand-new astronomical app for exploring the sky. It helps stargazers answer the three most common questions:
⁕ What is that bright dot in the sky?
⁕ What astronomical events can I see tonight?
⁕ How can I find the object I'm interested in?
Made by the developers of Star Walk apps, Sky Tonight is a customizable stargazing tool, that is designed for users with different needs and wants. You can adjust the constellation's appearance, set a reminder for any space body configuration, explore the unique relative to observer trajectory, set up a magnitude limit to filter out space objects, and much more.
SKY TONIGHT FEATURES:
► Point your device at the sky to see the real-time positions of space objects on the interactive sky map.
► Activate the Time Machine and determine the position of celestial bodies at different time periods.
► Use the augmented reality mode and see the sky map overlaid on the image from your device's camera.
► Get extended information about any sky object by tapping on its name.
► Stay updated on the latest news from the world of astronomy with the What's new section.
► Turn on the night mode to make your sky observation in the nighttime more comfortable.
► Filter the objects that appear on the sky map according to their visual brightness.
► Regulate the brightness of objects on the sky map.
► Spot dozens of asterisms along with the official constellations. 
► Adjust the visible constellations and customize their representation on the screen.
UNIQUE FEATURES:
◆ INTERACTIVE TRAJECTORIES RELATIVE TO AN OBSERVER
Instead of the classic trajectory that shows the object’s trajectory in the celestial sphere relative to the Earth’s center, the app presents the object’s trajectory in the sky relative to an observer. A long touch on the trajectories relative to the observer will move the sky object to the selected point. While holding the touch, move your finger along the trajectory to change the time.
◆ FLEXIBLE SEARCH
Make use of the flexible search — quickly find space objects, easily navigate across different objects and events’ types. Look for "stars", "mars moons", "mars conjunctions", "solar eclipse", and the app will show you all related objects, events, and articles!
There are also Trending and Recent categories in the search section. The first one presents the currently most popular objects, events, or news; the second category contains objects you recently selected. 
◆ FULLY CUSTOMIZABLE EVENT REMINDERS
Set event reminders on any time and date not to miss a solar eclipse, a Full Moon, or a star-planet configuration you're interested in.
◆ ASTRONOMY CALENDAR WITH A STARGAZING INDEX AND WEATHER FORECAST
Check out the calendar of celestial events that includes lunar phases, meteor showers, eclipses, oppositions, conjunctions, and other exciting events. Learn what astronomy events will occur this month or see what happened in the sky a year ago!
Verify the Stargazing Index calculated from a Moon phase, light pollution, cloudiness, and time when an object is visible. The higher this index is, the better the observation conditions are.
You don’t need several apps for your stargazing planning anymore; Sky Tonight contains all the info you need.
Premium Access:
* The app includes paid Premium Access. Get Premium Access to use Sky Tonight with no limits! Without the subscription, you can’t see most of the interface items in various sections such as Visible Tonight, Calendar, and Search. Therefore, you’re limited in planning and improving your observations. Premium Access will allow you to unlock all the interface items in any view and make the most of all the app’s features. Advertisements will also be removed not to interrupt your stargazing experience.
Privacy policy: https://vitotechnology.com/privacy-policy
Terms of use: https://vitotechnology.com/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00144249:ios.description:
Welcome to Calorie Scanner AI, your ultimate tool for effortlessly tracking and analyzing your meals by scanning photos of them. Whether you're aiming to lose weight, gain muscle, or simply maintain a healthy lifestyle, Calorie Scanner makes it easy to monitor your nutritional intake with just a snap of a photo.
Calorie Scanner has some key features:
1. Photo-Based Meal Analysis:
Simply take a photo of your meal, drink, or any food item, and let us do the rest. Our advanced AI technology analyzes the image to estimate the calorie, protein, fat, and carbohydrate content. No more tedious calculations just snap and get instant insights!
2. Daily Log:
Keep a detailed record of everything you consume throughout the day. Log your meals with time stamps, health scores, and detailed nutritional information. Add personal notes to each entry for a more comprehensive tracking experience.
3. Nutritional Insights:
Calorie Scanner provides you with a daily summary of your nutritional intake. Easily see how many calories, carbs, proteins, and fats you've consumed. Monitor your diet with weekly statistics to stay on track with your health goals. 
4. Easy Meal Logging:
Track your meals effortlessly by snapping photos or manually entering the nutritional details. Add notes and health scores to each meal, helping you make better dietary choices over time.
5. Personalized Statistics:
Get valuable insights with personalized statistics. See your average daily calorie intake, the number of meals consumed, and more. Perfect for understanding your eating habits and making informed decisions.
6. Privacy-Focused:
Your data is stored locally on your device, ensuring your privacy is protected. We prioritize your privacy and do not store your data on external servers.
How It Works:
Snap a Photo:
Take a clear photo of your meal using the Calorie Scanner app.
Instant Analysis:
The app analyzes the image to estimate calorie, protein, fat, and carbohydrate content.
Log Your Meal:
Save the nutritional information to your daily log with time stamps and additional notes if desired.
Monitor Your Progress:
View daily and weekly summaries and charts of your nutritional & calories and macros intake, helping you stay on track with your health goals.

bluejetty:00063881:ios.description:
= = =
Coloring is a great way to relax and reduce stress and anxiety. Just 10 minutes of coloring can provide the same benefits as meditation. It helps you practice mindfulness, stay present, enhance concentration, build creativity, and is a great alternative to games!
Pigment, an award-winning coloring app, is a sanctuary for relaxation, nourishing your creative spirit, and providing daily inspiration. Within its vibrant community of artists, you'll discover a wealth of positivity and wholehearted encouragement.
Enjoy thousands of coloring pages and tools and brushes you won’t find anywhere else. Immerse yourself in a coloring experience that lets you draw, paint and color as you would on paper, with 30+ different pencils, markers, and brushes. 
Beginner? Try our Tap-To-Fill mode. Advanced? Check out Freehand, Automatic, and Advanced modes for a more nuanced experience.
Import your own images, or choose from our huge collection of illustrations and grayscale images including flowers, mermaids, people, animals, landscapes, anime, mandalas, and tons more! Or start with a blank page and use Pigment as a sketchbook.
Easily share your creations with friends and family via social media, email, text - even print them for framing!
= = =
10,000+ PAGES
* The largest artwork collection available with over 10,000 professionally illustrated pages. Over 800 pages for free users.
* Gorgeous hand-drawn coloring pages from independent artists.
* New coloring pages added daily, and new books added every week!
* Access to exclusive Marvel content.
AWARD-WINNING TOOLS
* Pigment is the only coloring book app that simulates pencil, markers, and paintbrush strokes for a realistic coloring experience.
* More than 30 kinds of coloring tools - including Colored Pencil, Marker, Paint Brush, Glitter, Pastel, Airbrush, Watercolor, Wood Grain, Blender, Fade, Bloom and more!
* "Tap-to-fill" and traditional coloring modes.
* An unlimited number of colors are available using the color wheel and innovative shade control slider.
* Try our professional color palettes, or create and save your own!
* Premium Access provides unlimited access to the entire library, premium brushes, and exclusive color palettes.
THE GALLERY
* Find inspiration in the Pigment Gallery, a supportive community where you can share your work and see pages colored by others. 
* Make real friendships with people who share your interests – chat, tag, and learn from each other.
* Learn tips and improve your skills with tutorials and tips from the community. 
BFF with iOS
* Share your work by printing pages, through email, text, Facebook, Instagram, Pigment Gallery, and other social networks.
* Fully supports finger, Apple Pencil, and third-party stylus inputs.
* Adjust pressure, direction, and size of stroke using Apple Pencil.
Some screenshots feature work by Cindy Primeau, Elaine Durham and Angela Zeman.

Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. You may manage Premium Access subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when you purchase a Premium Access subscription.

Play Games. Win Cash. Challenge Real Players.

Win Real Money.

(Must be 18+ to play for cash prizes.)
TOURNAMENTS
Live Multiplayer - Arena style battle against multiple real-time opponents.
1v1 Mode – Go head-to-head. Winner takes the pot.
Blitz Mode – Every point earns you instant cash. The faster you score, the more you win.  Streak Mode - Beat all point targets to get a massive payout
Limited-Time Challenges – High-stakes events with massive prize pools.
LEAGUES
Climb the ranks in competitive leagues by collecting crowns! The higher your league, the bigger the cash prizes. Each match is skill-based and fair, so everyone has an equal shot at winning. Will you make it to the top? 
Boosts
Unlock exclusive deposit offers, prize boosts, and stack up bonus cash for even larger tournament entries.
Invite your friends and get free bonus cash to boost your balance.
SUPPORT:
Access live chat support directly in the app anytime! Remember to have enough battery and time to complete your game.
List of games included:
Chicken Run - Cross the road and avoid cars, busses, and other obstacles. 
Chaos Cannon – Blast asteroids and survive the chaos in this space shooter. 
Golf – Sink putts, chip close, and shoot your lowest score possible. 
Pop Shot – Test your timing and accuracy in this fast-paced basketball challenge. 
Galaxy Gunner – Blast enemy ships and survive waves of interstellar combat. 
Snake Royale – Grow your snake, collect food, and avoid deadly collisions. 
Obby – Jump, dodge, and parkour your way through challenging obstacle courses. 
Word Link – Connect letters to form words and clear the board.

Brick Breaker – Smash your way through layers of bricks. 
Shapes – Match and merge shapes to survive. 
Solitaire – The iconic solo card game, just as you remember it. 
Bear Blaster – Take aim in this fast-paced, first-person hunting challenge. 
Bingo – Daub the right tiles fast to win in this high-speed game of reflex! 
21 Blackjack – Stack cards to make 21 again and again. How long can you keep the streak alive?
HAVE FUN!

Do you have trouble going to sleep? Are you traveling on a plane and need a quick power nap? Does your newborn baby wake up in the middle of the night? There are numerous benefits to using White Noise:
• Helps you sleep by blocking distractions
• Relaxes and reduces stress
• Pacifies fussy and crying babies
• Increases focus while enhancing privacy
• Soothes headaches and migraines
• Masks tinnitus (ringing of the ears)
Even when you’re asleep, your brain is constantly scanning and listening for sounds. If it’s too quiet, unwanted noises such as faucet drips or police sirens can interrupt your sleep. White Noise generates sounds over a wide range of frequencies, masking those noise interruptions, so you can not only fall asleep, but stay asleep.
Relax. Sleep better. Feel better.

bluejetty:00187954:ios.name: BusyCal: Calendar & Tasks
bluejetty:00187954:ios.summary: BusyCal is a calendar and task planner built for busy schedules. It connects to every account you already use, shows your events and tasks side by side, and bends to the way you work: pinch to see more days or weeks, type events the way you
bluejetty:00187954:ios.description:
BusyCal is a calendar and task planner built for busy schedules. It connects to every account you already use, shows your events and tasks side by side, and bends to the way you work: pinch to see more days or weeks, type events the way you would say them, and keep everything in sync with BusyCal for Mac.
One-time purchase. No subscription.
YOUR CALENDAR, YOUR WAY
• Day, Week, Month, Year and List views, plus a dedicated Task list
• Pinch to zoom: 2 to 14 days per week and 2 to 8 weeks per month, with separate portrait and landscape layouts
• Customize colors, text size, weekend shading, week numbers and working hours, or show a Chinese, Hebrew, Islamic or Japanese calendar alongside
• Year view as a wall planner or heat map, with Highlights that reveal your busiest months, top calendars and meeting stats
TYPE IT THE WAY YOU WOULD SAY IT
• Type "Lunch with Sam next Tuesday at noon" or "Standup every weekday at 9:30" and BusyCal fills in the date, time and repeat as you type
• Understands alarms, time zones, calendars (/work) and links, in English, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Dutch, Japanese, Korean and Simplified Chinese
TASKS IN YOUR CALENDAR
• Dated, timed and undated tasks appear right in your calendar and carry forward until done
• Priorities, repeats, and a Task list you can sort by due date, priority, calendar, tag or by hand
• Works with Apple Reminders, iCloud, Google Tasks, Todoist and Fastmail
EVERY ACCOUNT, ONE APP
• iCloud, Google Calendar, Microsoft 365, Outlook.com, Exchange, Yahoo, Fastmail, Fruux and any CalDAV server, plus WebDAV subscriptions for holidays and sports
• Push updates where your server supports them, and accounts you add once are offered to your other devices
• Syncs with BusyCal for Mac, Apple Calendar and any other app on the same accounts
MEETINGS AND INVITES
• Invite attendees, and accept, decline or reply Maybe straight from the Inbox
• Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Google Meet, Webex and GoTo links become one-tap join buttons, and you can create Zoom and Teams meetings from inside the app
• Block time on a second calendar in a couple of taps, with or without the details
WIDGETS, WATCH, SIRI AND SHORTCUTS
• Home Screen widgets for what is next, your agenda, the week, two weeks, three weeks, and tasks you can complete from the widget
• Lock Screen widgets and Control Center buttons for new events and tasks
• Apple Watch app with calendar, today, up next and tasks views, plus complications for your watch face
• Siri: "Add lunch with Sam tomorrow at noon", "What's coming up", "When am I free"
• Shortcuts actions to find, create, move, defer and complete items, and a Focus filter that switches calendar sets
TRAVEL TIME, MAPS AND TIME ZONES
• Add travel time to an event and get a leave-now alert based on real driving or walking time
• Maps inside event details, with directions in Apple Maps, Google Maps, Waze, Citymapper or TomTom GO
• Favorite time zones, and events that start and end in different zones
TAGS, CALENDAR SETS AND PRIVACY
• Color-coded tags to track projects, people and priorities across calendars
• Calendar sets: named groups of calendars, each with its own default calendars and preferred view, synced across your devices
• Lock the app, or just certain calendar sets, with Face ID or Touch ID
AND MORE
• Weather and moon phases on your calendar
• Birthdays and anniversaries from Contacts, with age and years
• Search titles, locations, notes and tags across past and future
BusyCal has been trusted by Mac users for more than a decade. The iPhone and iPad app is its full-featured companion, made by the same team.
Questions? Visit busymac.com/docs or write to us from within the app.

Whether you’ve misplaced your physical remote or simply want a more convenient way to control your TV, this app gives you instant access to all key features — right from your phone.
KEY FEATURES:
- Full Remote Control: Power on/off, change channels, adjust volume, and control playback.
- Touchpad Navigation: Smooth and responsive control with an intuitive touch interface.
- Quick App Launch: Open your favorite Roku channels with one tap.
- Keyboard & Voice Input: Type or speak for faster search and navigation.
- Fast Pairing: Instantly connect your phone to any Roku device on the same network.
- Simple & Clean Interface: Designed for ease of use and quick access to controls.
Download Roku TV Remote, Control Play today and enjoy a smarter, more convenient way to control your Roku experience!

Payment will be charged to the credit card connected to your iTunes Account when you confirm the initial subscription purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current subscription period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and the cost of the renewal will be identified. You may manage your subscription and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your Account Settings after the purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription, where applicable.

bluejetty:00143960:ios.description:
AB.MONEY is a meditation app for the moments when you need to ease stress, clear your head or simply take a break. Meditations, calming music, Tarot and daily affirmations are gathered in one quiet place, ready whenever you are.
Meditations
Guided meditations for real-life moments: easing anxiety, finding focus, breaking habits that hold you back and learning to be present. Each one is deep inner work, one session at a time.
Music for Your Home
Melodies to play in the background, so your space feels warmer and your mind stays focused.
Voices of Nature
Nature soundscapes that carry you back to warm memories, far away from the noise of the city.
Pure Silence
A meditation without words or music, for the minutes when you want to hear nothing but your own breath.
Alpha, Theta and Delta Waves
Sound tuned to the state you need: clarity in the morning, deep rest in the evening. Best experienced with headphones.
Tarot and Osho Zen
Cards that help you see your question from a new angle when the next step isn't clear.
Daily Affirmations
Turn on notifications to receive a kind message every day, and set an affirmation wallpaper as a gentle reminder of your own strength.
Start with one meditation and see where it takes you.
Terms of use https://ab.money/app_terms_of_use_eng

Transform your expense tracking with My Expenses, the complete app to manage your personal finances intelligently and practically!
Quick and Intuitive Recording
With My Expenses, logging your spending has never been easier. Record amount, description, category, and date in seconds, keeping your budget always organized and up to date.
Financial Graphics and Analysis
Monitor your financial control of expenses through powerful graphic visualizations. See monthly comparisons, percentages by category, and quickly identify where your biggest expenses are. Transform numbers into valuable insights for your savings.
Interactive Expense Calendar
View all your spending in a detailed calendar. See how your finances are distributed throughout the month and better plan your financial commitments. Never lose control of your expenses again.
Personalized Categorization
Adapt My Expenses to your lifestyle! Create and organize custom categories that reflect exactly where your money is being invested. Whether for food, transportation, entertainment, or your emergency piggy bank - everything under your control.
Smart Savings
Identify opportunities to increase your savings through detailed analysis. With My Expenses, you make smarter financial decisions based on real data from your budget.
Modern and Functional Interface
Clean design, intuitive navigation, and fluid experience make expense control an enjoyable task. The interface was designed to facilitate your daily finance management.
Download My Expenses now and start your journey toward financial stability! Organize your finance, control your spending, and achieve your goals with the best expense control app available.

apple-macos:6822504870.name: Mercury HF Modem
apple-macos:6822504870.description:
Mercury is a software modem for sending email, files and messages over HF radio, the kind of link you have when there is no internet, no phone network and no power grid worth speaking of.
Connect your phone or tablet to a single-sideband transceiver through an audio interface, and Mercury turns the radio into a data link: it handles the waveform, the error correction, the retransmissions and the speed, and gives your application an ordinary TCP connection. It speaks the VARA TNC protocol, so Winlink clients such as Pat, and chat programs, can use it.
• Adaptive speed, from a robust 32-tone MFSK mode that works below the noise up to 16-QAM on a good channel.
• Files arrive intact or you are told they did not.
• Broadcast mode for one-to-many traffic.
• Interoperates with every other Mercury station, including Mercury on the Mac.
Mercury is free software (GPL-3.0) from the HERMES project of Rhizomatica. It needs an amateur-radio licence to transmit.
